jobs.title: Chief Data Officer (CDO) — Insurance & Investments
jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Chief Data Officer (CDO) is responsible for the organization's enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, quality, analytics, AI, and data-driven transformation.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Chief Data Officer (CDO) is responsible for the organization's enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, quality, analytics, AI, and data-driven transformation.

Within an Insurance & Investments organization, the CDO ensures that data is treated as a strategic asset across underwriting, claims, customer management, investment/asset management, risk, finance, compliance, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise data strategy and roadmap.

Establish enterprise-wide data governance, ownership, standards, policies, and controls.

Improve data quality, consistency, accuracy, availability, and accessibility.

Lead the organization's data management and data architecture strategy.

Establish data models, data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, and data integration capabilities.

Lead Business Intelligence (BI), analytics, reporting, and advanced analytics.

Develop and oversee AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics initiatives.

Support data-driven decision-making across insurance, investments, finance, risk, and operations.

Establish data governance frameworks covering data privacy, security, lineage, classification, and access.

Partner with the CIO/CTO and technology teams on data platforms and architecture.

Support regulatory and management reporting through reliable and controlled data.

Develop data capabilities for underwriting, claims, pricing, fraud detection, customer analytics, and risk management.

Support investment teams with portfolio analytics, market data, performance reporting, and investment intelligence.

Establish data KPIs and monitor data quality and governance performance.

Lead data transformation and modernization initiatives.

Manage relationships with data, analytics, AI, and technology vendors.

Build and lead data, analytics, BI, governance, and data-science teams.

Promote an enterprise-wide data-driven culture.

Present data strategy, risks, opportunities, and transformation progress to executive leadership and the Board.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, technology, information management, or financial-services data.

5+ years in CDO, Chief Data Officer, Head of Data, Director of Data, Head of Analytics, or equivalent senior leadership positions.

Experience in insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, wealth management, or financial services preferred.

Strong expertise in:

Enterprise data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Data quality & master data

Business intelligence

Advanced analytics

AI / machine learning

Data privacy & security

Data management

Data integration

Regulatory data

Cloud data platforms

Strong understanding of financial-services data and regulatory requirements.

Experience managing enterprise data transformation programs and large multidisciplinary teams.

Strong C-suite, Board, and business stakeholder engagement.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or related discipline; master's degree/MBA preferred.

jobs.title: Listing Grafiker (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: ÜBER NEOLYMPNeolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads.
jobs.description:
ÜBER NEOLYMP

Neolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse.

Als Listing Grafiker (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns die komplette operative Grafikarbeit, bist Ansprechpartner für alle grafischen Themen und setzt Briefings aus Marketing und E-Commerce eigenständig um. Du arbeitest alleine als Single-Contributor, ohne Teamverantwortung oder Personalführung. Es geht nicht darum, ein Team zu leiten, sondern darum, Aufgaben selbstständig umzusetzen und sauber abzuarbeiten.

Aufgaben

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Grafik- und Creative-Erstellung: Du entwickelst eigenständig verkaufsstarke Amazon-Listings – von Produktbildern über A+ Content bis hin zu Grafikmodulen – und setzt Briefings aus Marketing und E-Commerce professionell um.
  • Content-Produktion mit KI: Du erstellst hochwertige Creatives mithilfe moderner KI-Tools wie Midjourney oder Firefly und optimierst diese mit Programmen wie Photoshop, Illustrator und Lightroom.
  • E-Commerce-Visuals: Du gestaltest Shop-Banner, Produktsektionen und weitere visuelle Inhalte für unseren Shopify-Store und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Markenpräsenz auf allen Kanälen konsistent und hochwertig erscheint.
  • Analyse & Optimierung: Du analysierst Wettbewerber und Zielgruppen, entwickelst daraus wirkungsvolle Gestaltungskonzepte und setzt diese eigenständig in überzeugende Visuals um.
  • Verantwortung für den Grafikbereich: Als zentrale Ansprechperson für alle grafischen Themen arbeitest du eigenverantwortlich als Single Contributor und unterstützt den Aufbau unseres internen Grafikbereichs sowie KI-basierter Creative-Prozesse.

Qualifikation

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

  • Erfahrung im Bereich KI-gestützte Content-Erstellung: Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen und hast Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren.
  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams, bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein und schaffst es, gemeinsam optimale Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Eine offene, wertschätzende Kommunikation ist für dich selbstverständlich und du verstehst es, unterschiedliche Perspektiven konstruktiv zusammenzubringen.
  • Fundierte Design-Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest sicher mit Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator und Lightroom. Kenntnisse in Blender sind ein zusätzliches Plus.
  • E-Commerce-Verständnis: Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im E-Commerce-Umfeld (Amazon, Shopify) oder im Performance Marketing mit und verstehst, wie verkaufsstarke Creatives aufgebaut sein müssen.
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und setzt Briefings zuverlässig in fertige Visual-Pakete um.
  • Gespür für Conversion und Gestaltung: Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis für Conversion-Psychologie, Produktinszenierung und markengerechtes Design.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst den Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs und gestaltest aktiv den Bereich KI-basierter Creative-Produktion mit.
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Wenn wir damit dein Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Job Title

CMMS System Administrator

Job Description Summary

The FAMIS 360 CMMS System Administrator plays a critical role in ensuring the successful implementation, configuration, and ongoing management of the FAMIS 360 system within the CW Account. This position involves collaborating with the account team, participating in training sessions, and overseeing system administration tasks. The administrator serves as the primary point of contact for FAMIS 360-related inquiries and support issues.

  • Attend FAMIS 360 training sessions, including guest and full user trainings.
  • Participate in 360 Systems Administrator training sessions.

  • Configure property settings (accounting codes, language designation, business hours, contacts).
  • Manage user security profiles.
  • Assist with data loading and configuration adjustments.
  • Own the FAMIS 360 system and ensure its proper use and configuration.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for account team members regarding FAMIS 360-related questions and support.

  • Support account team users with password resets, security changes, and general inquiries.
  • Coordinate with C&W IT for system issues, maintenance, and enhancements.
  • Inactivate properties no longer managed by C&W (update quarterly billing).
  • Manage user additions and removals based on SOP and SOC compliance.
  • Oversee pick list values and configuration options.
  • Maintain Vendor, Asset, Schedule, Inventory, and other deployed modules.

  • Strong understanding of FAMIS 360 and related integrated systems.
  • Self-driven, organized and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Data Specialist Infection Prevention - Part-Time
jobs.excerpt: OverviewAs the healthcare industry shifts to value-based care, quality data abstraction has become critical in identifying positive, patient outcomes.
jobs.description:
Overview

As the healthcare industry shifts to value-based care, quality data abstraction has become critical in identifying positive, patient outcomes. In fact, medical record abstraction is the preferred data collection method for clinical research, quality improvement, performance measurement, disease surveillance, and other secondary data uses. Our Senior Clinical Data Specialists use Q-Centrix proprietary technology to contribute to healthcare’s most exciting advancements.

Job Summary: The Infection Prevention Senior Clinical Data Specialist delivers quality solutions to hospital partners across the country. They approach each hospital engagement as an opportunity to apply their clinical expertise with precision to advance patient outcomes and research. Join our team of Senior Clinical Data Specialists!

Responsibilities

Main Duties/Responsibilities: Our SCDS are staffed with multiple hospital partners to...

  • Apply specialized, clinical knowledge to hospital partners: categorize, code, summarize, interpret and calculate registry/case information from nuanced, patient medical records.
  • Ensure quality submission of all data in specified registries or measure data repositories, maintaining a high accuracy threshold.
  • Prioritize, organize, and meet tight deadlines for multiple concurrent tasks and team requests; uses tact and judgement to manage expectations, flag obstacles and propose solutions in a timely manner.
  • Navigate new technical systems: electronic medical records (EMR) and registry/case entry tools; use team resources to troubleshoot technical issues with systems and applications with a focus on solutions.
  • Contribute to team best practices, data dictionaries, abstraction guidelines, and other business rule documents; identifies process improvement opportunities to help streamline tasks and processes.
  • Keeps up to date on mandated regulatory/publicly reported data requirements as specified by federal, state, payer and other agencies.
  • Any or other additional responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Direct clinical surveillance experience
  • An active CIC certification
  • Exposure to multiple patient medical record systems (EMRs) and clinical databases
  • Intermediate proficiency with MS Office (Microsoft Excel)
  • Applicants for employment with Q-Centrix must be legally authorized to work in the United States now or in the future without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct clinical experience working as an Infection Preventionist
  • RN, LPN, RT RVT, or RCIS credentials

Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to approach problems in a systematic method using the ability to synthesize data and suggest recommendations
  • Demonstrates high standards for accuracy and attention to detail
  • Demonstrates technical savvy and strong desire to learn new systems and technology
  • Thrives working independently and takes ownership of projects/patient records
  • Consistently and clearly communicates, adjusting style and tone as needed to effectively collaborate with hospital partners, peers, team leads and others
  • Demonstrates strong self-organizational and time management skills to concurrently manage multiple accounts, adjusting as needed to shifting timelines and priorities
  • Adapts to changes in hospital partner timelines, requirements, and project assignments
  • Maintains a high degree of responsibility in keeping PHI secure and confidential

Pay Range

USD $30.00 - USD $33.00 /Hr.

jobs.description:
About Svetness

Svetness is a nationwide in-home personal training company helping clients achieve their fitness, health, and wellness goals by matching them with certified personal trainers in their local area.

We are growing and looking for a fast, organized, and proactive Personal Trainer Recruiting Specialist / Talent Sourcer to help us source, screen, and schedule qualified personal trainers across the United States.

About the Role

This is a high-volume recruiting and sourcing role focused on building a strong pipeline of personal trainer candidates.

The main responsibility is to source personal trainers through platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, Greenhouse, and other recruiting channels, conduct initial phone screens, and schedule qualified candidates for interviews with our onboarding team.

Our clients are actively waiting to be matched with trainers, so speed, organization, communication, and follow-up are critical. The right candidate must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and moving candidates quickly through the pipeline.

Responsibilities

  • Source personal trainer candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, Greenhouse, and other recruiting platforms.
  • Review candidate profiles, resumes, certifications, experience, location, and availability.
  • Conduct initial phone screens with trainer candidates.
  • Confirm candidate interest, certifications, location coverage, availability, and overall fit.
  • Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with the onboarding team.
  • Maintain accurate notes, candidate statuses, and follow-up activity in Greenhouse or the company recruiting system.
  • Follow up consistently with candidates to reduce drop-off.
  • Prioritize recruiting activity based on markets where Svetness has active client demand.
  • Communicate daily progress, challenges, and pipeline updates to the team.
  • Work quickly while maintaining candidate quality and professionalism.

Requirements

  • Experience sourcing candidates through Indeed is required.
  • Recruiting, staffing, talent sourcing, or appointment-setting experience preferred.
  • Experience recruiting personal trainers, fitness professionals, healthcare workers, field-service providers, or 1099 contractors is strongly preferred.
  • Comfortable making phone calls and conducting candidate phone screens.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple candidates and markets at once.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Experience using Greenhouse, LinkedIn, Indeed, or similar recruiting tools preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and stay accountable to daily activity and results.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of personal training certifications such as NASM, ACE, ISSA, ACSM, NCSF, or similar.
  • Experience recruiting 1099 contractors.
  • Experience working with remote teams.
  • Prior high-volume recruiting or sourcing experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • You are sourcing new personal trainer candidates daily.
  • Qualified candidates are being screened and scheduled quickly.
  • Candidate notes and statuses are updated accurately.
  • Urgent recruiting markets are prioritized based on client demand.
  • The onboarding team has a consistent flow of qualified candidates to interview.
  • The trainer pipeline remains active and moving.

Why Join Svetness

  • Remote 1099 opportunity.
  • Stable monthly compensation.
  • Opportunity to work with a fast-growing national fitness company.
  • Direct impact on client fulfillment and company growth.
  • Mission-driven company focused on making the world a healthier place.
  • Fast-paced environment where execution, speed, and results matter.

Compensation

This is a 1099 contractor position with compensation of up to $2,500 per month, based on experience, availability, and performance.

jobs.description:
Job Description: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)

Department: Enterprise Security & Technology Risk Management Location: Regionwide

Reports To: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client from banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

  • PCI DSS Compliance Management:
    • Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.

Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.

  • Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.
  • Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCI DSS certification audits.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.
  • Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or

equivalent work experience).

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in information security, PCI compliance, or a related field.
    • Previous experience as an ISA, QSA, or a similar role is highly desirable.
  • Certifications:
    • Certified PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) or Certified PCI Professional (PCIP) certifications preferred.

Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH are a plus.

  • Skills and Competencies:
    • Deep understanding of PCI DSS requirements and data security best practices.
    • Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, encryption, etc.).
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross- functionally.
    • Proficiency in using security assessment tools and techniques (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM).

Other Requirements:

Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information confidentially.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Occasional travel may be required for audits or compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation:
    • Identify and assess potential risks to cardholder data environments and provide recommendations for risk mitigation.
    • Implement and enforce necessary security controls to address gaps identified during assessments.
    • Ensure vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security reviews are conducted to identify weaknesses and ensure continuous compliance.
  • Training and Awareness:
    • Conduct internal PCI DSS training for staff to ensure a deep understanding of the importance of compliance and security measures.
    • Provide ongoing guidance and support to departments regarding security best practices related to PCI DSS.
  • Collaboration and Communication:

Du ansvarar för att skapa tydliga ramar och förutsättningar för framgång genom att effektivt fördela ansvar och resurser samt säkerställa en strukturerad uppföljning av mål, prestationer och verksamhetens utveckling.

Genom nära dialog, konstruktiv feedback och aktiv sparring bidrar du till att stärka ledarskapet och skapa engagemang som leder till goda resultat.

Tillsammans med din region arbetar ni för att behålla och utveckla jem & fix ställning på marknadensom Nordens ledande lågprisbyggmarknad!

Requirements

👤Vi söker dig som:

Är en engagerad, ansvarsfull och prestigelös ledare som trivs med att skapa resultat genom andra. Du har en naturlig förmåga att inspirera, coacha och engagera dina medarbetare samt är tydlig i din kommunikation och ditt ledarskap. Du motiveras av att utveckla människor och ser det som en självklar del av ditt uppdrag att bidra till både individers och verksamhetens framgång.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:

  • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av ledarskap.

  • Är mål- och resultatorienterad med förmåga att omsätta mål till konkreta aktiviteter och resultat.

  • Har ett starkt eget driv och en hög arbetsmoral.

  • Trivs med att ta stort eget ansvar och fatta beslut i vardagen.

  • Har erfarenhet av att planera, samordna och genomföra arbete utifrån uppsatta mål och verksamhetskrav.

  • Har god förmåga att coacha och utveckla medarbetare och ledare.

  • Är strukturerad och arbetar självständigt samtidigt som du skapar goda samarbeten.

Ansvarsområden

  • Omsätta jem & fix strategi och affärsmål till konkreta planer, prioriteringar och mål för regionen samt säkerställa att dessa förstås och drivs vidare genom regionens butikschefer.

  • Coacha, vägleda och utveckla regionens ledare genom dialog, sparring, feedback och utvecklingssamtal för att stärka deras ledarskap, kompetens och förmåga att nå resultat.

  • Säkerställa en tydlig ansvarsfördelning och främja samarbete, kunskapsdelning och erfarenhetsutbyte mellan butiker och funktioner i regionen.

  • Prioritera och fördela resurser på ett effektivt sätt för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för verksamheten att nå sina mål.

  • Hantera prestations- och utvecklingsfrågor på ett professionellt och tydligt sätt samt säkerställa att ledare ges rätt stöd och förutsättningar att leva upp till förväntningarna i sina roller.

🛠️Hos oss får du

En informell och professionell organisation som agerar snabbt med korta beslutsvägar, tillit samt frihet under ansvar. Som Regionschef hos jem & fix arbetar du flexibelt, med stöd från engagerade och erfarna kollegor som brinner för detaljhandel och har en lösningsorienterad inställning. En stark kultur som präglas av samarbete, utveckling och framgång. Goda anställningsvillkor och personalförmåner.

Arbetet är huvudsakligen förlagt måndag-fredag. Helgarbete kan förekomma. Resdagar inom Sverige förekommer och tjänsten kan kräva övernattningar under arbetsveckan. Tjänsten ställer krav på B körkort.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare, med 6 månaders provanställning.

Placering: Anställd på jem & fix huvudkontor i Svalöv, men utgår ifrån hemmet.

Lön: Enligt överenskommelse

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

🛠️Om oss

jem & fix är en lågprisbyggmarknad inom bygg, hem och trädgård. Sedan vi öppnade vår första butik i Sverige 2005 har vi expanderat stadigt och bygger nya butiker löpande. I dagsläget har vi över 200 butiker spridda över Sverige, Danmark och Norge. Det gör oss till Nordens ledande lågprisbyggmarknad.

Övrigt:

Vi samarbetar med Svensk Bakgrundsanalys för en säker rekrytering och trygg arbetsplats. Läs mer om deras tjänster här.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Workday Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Workday and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on hands-on integration delivery using EIB, Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and Workday APIs, with strong attention to reliability, security, and data quality. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Workday integrations in production, navigates Workday’s tenant model and security framework with confidence, and writes well-structured Studio integrations that are easy to maintain. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Develop XSLT transformations within Workday Studio integrations, applying disciplined templating practices, reusable helper libraries, and careful test coverage to keep complex mappings maintainable.
  • Implement integrations using Workday REST and SOAP web services where appropriate.
  • Design error handling, retry, and notification strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Develop and maintain integration system users, ISSGs, security configurations, and tenant-level setup for integrations.
  • Build and maintain calculated fields, custom reports, and report-as-a-service integrations.
  • Implement Workday business processes and condition rules that support integration logic, ensuring the upstream and downstream sides of each integration agree on routing, approvals, and state transitions.
  • Participate actively in Workday tenant refresh planning and integration regression testing, ensuring critical integration paths are exercised in lower environments before each tenant move and any drift is caught early.
  • Collaborate with HR, payroll, IT, and finance stakeholders to translate business needs into integration designs.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Participate in Workday release planning and regression testing, reviewing upcoming feature changes for impact, scheduling validation cycles, and coordinating with stakeholders so adoption proceeds smoothly.
  • Stay current with Workday product releases and integration platform evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12 or more years of Workday integration development experience.
  • Deep expertise in EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.
  • Strong XSLT skills and experience with Workday Studio orchestrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of the Workday data model and tenant configuration.
  • Experience with Workday security model including ISU/ISSG patterns.
  • Familiarity with calculated fields and custom report design.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro Integrations certification.
  • Experience with PICOF, PECI, or Cloud Connect for Payroll.
  • Familiarity with Workday Extend.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience integrating Workday with major SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce).

jobs.excerpt: Turn complex data into clarity.  Build models that businesses can trust.
jobs.description:
Turn complex data into clarity. Build models that businesses can trust.

We're a global technology consultancy helping organisations solve complex challenges through modern software solutions, data platforms, AI and intelligent automation.

We're looking for an experienced Data Modeller to join our NZ team. Whether you're an established contractor or looking for your next permanent opportunity, we're open to finding the right fit.

This is an opportunity to work on meaningful client engagements, shaping how organisations structure, govern and use their data to make better decisions.

We're not just looking for someone who can write SQL or build tables. We want someone who understands how to turn complex data into reliable, well-designed models that deliver real business value.

What does the role look like?

You'll spend your time doing what great modellers do: making complex information logical, consistent and genuinely useful.

Working across Microsoft Fabric engagements, you'll turn source data and business requirements into governed, analytics-ready Gold models. One day you might be designing fact and dimension tables, the next resolving data inconsistencies, defining reconciliation rules or collaborating with analysts to ensure reporting delivers accurate, meaningful insights.

You'll work with engineers, BI teams and client stakeholders to understand how data is used, challenge existing structures and design models that are scalable, maintainable and fit for purpose.

This isn't about simply recreating legacy databases in a new platform. We want someone who can think critically about data design, make sound modelling decisions and confidently explain the reasoning behind them.

You'll have the support of experienced colleagues, but we value people who take ownership, ask the right questions and bring solutions to the table.

What we're looking for

Strong dimensional modelling experience is essential. This is a modelling-first role, not a general data engineering or Power BI development position.

Technically, you'll bring:

  • Proven experience designing dimensional and star-schema models, ideally using Kimball methodologies in production environments.
  • Strong SQL skills, including data validation, reconciliation and transformation.
  • Deep understanding of fact grain, dimensions, keys, relationships, SCD Type 1/2 and fact table patterns.
  • Experience translating source mappings and data requirements into governed, analytics-ready models.
  • Experience designing data structures for BI and reporting, ideally including Power BI Semantic Models.
  • Understanding of data quality, lineage, governance and reconciliation as part of good model design.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Gold Lakehouses, Delta Lake and Direct Lake is highly desirable. Familiarity with Spark SQL, PySpark and modern CI/CD practices would also be beneficial.

Beyond the technical skills...

We're a consultancy, and how you work matters just as much as what you know.

You'll be someone who:

  • Communicates confidently: Builds trust with clients and can explain complex data concepts in practical, understandable terms.
  • Takes ownership: Makes sound decisions, follows through and delivers quality outcomes without constant direction.
  • Thinks commercially: Understands the business purpose behind the data, not just the technical design.
  • Challenges constructively: Asks good questions, identifies gaps and isn't afraid to recommend a better approach.
  • Adapts and solves problems: Comfortable navigating different client environments, priorities and delivery challenges.
  • Embraces innovation: Brings an AI-first mindset and actively explores better ways of working.
  • Works well with others: Collaborates effectively with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders.

Previous consulting or professional services experience is highly valued, particularly where you've balanced technical quality, stakeholder expectations and delivery commitments.

Why Provoke?

You'll join a collaborative team working with clients across different industries and markets, helping shape modern data and AI solutions.

We value curiosity, accountability and people who get things done. You'll have the flexibility to work your way, support from experienced colleagues and opportunities to keep learning and growing.

A few important details:

  • Location: Anywhere in New Zealand. You must be NZ-based.
  • Engagement: Contract or permanent.
  • Working arrangements: Some availability required to collaborate with US-based clients (Pacific Time).

Interested?

If you're an experienced Data Modeller who enjoys solving complex problems, working with clients and taking pride in the quality of your designs, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let's talk.

Job Title: People Operations & Development Lead

Company: Pro Coffee Gear

Full-time

We specialize in providing top-tier espresso machines and related parts to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond our products; we're committed to building a talented team that shares our passion for coffee and exceptional customer service.

About the Role

We’re looking for a People Operations & Development Manager who will design, manage, and continuously improve how we hire, onboard, and develop great people. You’ll be the operational backbone of our talent processes, ensuring every hire is made through a rigorous, data-driven process (using the WHO method), and every team member has a clear development roadmap aligned with company standards and performance expectations.

This role blends strategic HR, people development, and operations. You’ll collaborate with leadership and hiring managers to drive excellence across the full employee lifecycle, from interview and onboarding workflows to ongoing performance and growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hiring & Interview Management

  • Own and manage the WHO hiring process, from scorecard creation to structured interviews and reference checks.

  • Partner with hiring managers to clarify role outcomes and competencies before searches begin.

  • Maintain a consistent, high-quality candidate experience across roles.

  • Train interviewers on the WHO methodology and ensure compliance with scorecard-based decision-making.

2. Onboarding & Integration

  • Create and manage end-to-end onboarding workflows, including:

    • Systems access and setup (email, software, tools)

    • Role-specific onboarding plans and checklists

    • 30/60/90-day success milestones

    • Support hiring managers in setting personal development roadmaps for new hires, tied directly to their hiring scorecards.
    • Monitor onboarding success metrics and continuously improve ramp-up efficiency.

3. People Development & Performance

  • Establish a consistent cadence of performance reviews, feedback sessions, and growth planning across all teams.

  • Coach managers on how to develop, evaluate, and hold their teams accountable to performance standards.
  • Build and maintain company-wide frameworks for:
    • Learning and development initiatives
    • Competency and behavioral standards
    • Track and report on performance health metrics and engagement indicators.
    • Career progression

4. HR Operations & Compliance

  • Manage HR operations such as benefits administration, time-off policies,

    and employee records.
  • Support leadership in managing sensitive HR processes (e.g., promotions, releases, or disciplinary actions).

  • Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policy documentation.

  • Implement and maintain HR systems that support scalability and automation.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR, or Talent Development roles (preferably in growth-stage companies).
  • Deep familiarity with the WHO Hiring Method (Geoff Smart & Randy Street) and scorecard-based hiring.
  • Proven experience designing onboarding programs and performance management systems.
  • Strong coaching, facilitation, and communication skills, able to influence managers and uphold standards.
  • Operationally-minded excels at creating processes, templates, and systems that scale.
  • High integrity and discretion when managing sensitive people matters.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with tools such as Asana, Notion, HubSpot, or similar systems for managing onboarding workflows.
  • Background in leadership development, coaching, or organizational psychology.
  • Knowledge of modern HR software (e.g., Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, Deel).
  • Prior experience in an e-commerce, operations, or high-growth startup environment.

Success in This Role

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • Every new hire follows a standardized WHO-based hiring and onboarding process.
  • Managers have clear scorecards, structured reviews, and people development roadmaps for their teams.
  • Employees are engaged, performing to high standards, and developing in measurable ways.
  • HR operations run smoothly and proactively, not reactively.

jobs.title: Technical Readiness & Communities Director
jobs.excerpt: Customer Excellence Group — Product Delivery & Innovation Role overview ServiceNow is standing up a dedicated Communities of Practice function within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG).
jobs.description:
Customer Excellence Group — Product Delivery & Innovation

Role overview

ServiceNow is standing up a dedicated Communities of Practice function within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG). This function is designed to multiply expertise across 3,400+ practitioners worldwide. The Director, Community of Practice will own the strategy, design, and day-to-day operation of this community ecosystem, scaling AI and technical readiness across every GEO and every customer-facing role.

This role sits at the convergence of three disciplines - readiness, content standardization, and communities and serves as the amplification layer in the PD&I Readiness Engine. Product experts earn hard-won lessons in the field; the readiness team packages them; you multiply them across CEG so expertise is scaled.

You will report to the Director of Technical Readiness and partner closely with GEO leadership, Product, Engineering, and ServiceNow University to build something CEG has never had: a self-sustaining, accountable system for scaling practitioner expertise at speed.

Relationship to CEG Role & Org Excellence

This role is distinct from, and works in close partnership with, the Director, CEG Role & Org Excellence. That role owns role mandates, competency frameworks, and organizational design - defining what roles exist across CEG and what they are accountable for. This role owns the community operating model -how practitioners build, share, and apply expertise within those roles once they are defined. You will define the competency framework, and you will keep community programming aligned as role mandates evolve.

Key responsibilities

Community strategy and governance

  • Define the community operating model, charter, and success metrics for all communities of practice across CEG- scoped to how practitioners engage and share expertise, not organizational role design or reporting structure
  • Design and implement community types mapped to certification roles/personas.
  • Build the cadence, rituals, and contribution mechanisms (community governance) that keep each community healthy, productive, and self-sustaining over time.
  • Establish community health dashboards with leading and lagging indicators—participation rates, content contribution velocity, certification correlation, and practitioner engagement scores

Practitioner engagement and relationship building

  • Recruit, develop, and support GEO Community Practice Leaders- practitioner-facing roles distinct from GEO Business Leads who embody the practice at the regional level, dedicating approximately two days per month to community leadership
  • Cultivate a global network of practitioner champions who co-author best practices, peer-review, technical readiness and serve as closed feedback loop chairs.
  • Build trusted partnerships across GEO leaders, Product leadership, and PD&I to ensure communities are co-owned rather than centrally imposed
  • Partner with the Director, CEG Role & Org Excellence to ensure community programming reflects current role mandates and competency frameworks as they evolve
  • Maintain an active feedback loop so field lessons flow all the way back to Product, informing the next release cycle

AI readiness and technical enablement at scale

  • Embed AI adoption frameworks, use cases, and best practices into every community channel—making AI readiness a natural part of practitioner workflow, not a separate training event
  • Partner with AI architects and the Product Excellence team to translate technical complexity into community-ready content - adoption frameworks, value realization playbooks, executive briefing guides, and implementation patterns
  • Leverage AI-powered tools (Yoodli simulations, AI-assisted expertise registries, automated field-voice reporting) to scale community operations without proportional headcount
  • Stay current with AI developments across the industry- not just ServiceNow products - and bring external perspectives into community programming

Content and knowledge amplification

  • Operate the fan-out layer of the readiness engine—taking packaged expertise from PD&I and distributing it through communities so a single asset reaches hundreds of practitioners
  • Coordinate with the Content Standardization Lead to ensure community-generated content meets quality, structure, and voice standards
  • Contribute to the repository and discovery mechanisms for community-sourced learning assets, playbooks, and field-tested patterns

Community adoption and behavior change

  • You will partner with the Director of CEG Field Readiness to lead the adoption and behavior change required to make communities of practice stick.
  • Build the executive narrative that makes the value of communities visible and repeatable- linking community health to certification rates, time-to-proficiency, customer outcomes, and revenue impact
  • Present community strategy, progress, and impact to SVP/VP-level audiences, including CEG leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Champion a culture where peer-led learning is valued alongside formal training - making the 70-20-10 model real rather than aspirational

Measurement and continuous improvement

  • Define and track metrics across four dimensions: learning metrics (completion, certification velocity), engagement metrics (monthly active contributors, peer participation), business impact (AI attach rates, implementation cycle time, CSAT), and community sustainability (self-sustaining contribution rates, champion readiness)
  • Run quarterly capability reviews with skills gap analysis to ensure community programming stays ahead of role evolution
  • Report monthly on community health, course correct quickly, and scale what works

Critical skills and competencies

Relationship building

You build trust quickly across levels and functions. You know that community adoption depends on relationships - not mandates - and you have a track record of earning co-ownership from regional leaders in matrixed organizations.

Presentation and executive communication

You present strategy, data, and impact to VP/SVP audiences with clarity and confidence. You tailor your message to the room whether that is a GEO all-hands, a leadership review, or a practitioner workshop.

Influence without authority

You drive outcomes through persuasion, credibility, and coalition-building rather than positional power. You have led practitioner-facing initiatives at enterprise scale where success depended on getting buy-in from leaders who did not report to you - distinct from formal organizational design authority.

Technical community leadership

You have built, scaled, or operated technical communities of practice in large organizations. You understand the mechanics of healthy communities: cadence, rituals, governance, contribution incentives, and sustainability planning.

AI fluency and applied AI experience

You are a practitioner of AI - not just an observer. You use AI tools daily, understand adoption barriers, and can credibly lead AI readiness programming for technical and customer-facing roles. Experience with AI enablement, AI-powered learning platforms, or AI adoption frameworks is essential.

Change management at scale

You have led adoption and behavior-change initiatives that stuck - not just launched. You understand resistance patterns, executive sponsorship models, incentive alignment, and the difference between communication plans and real change management. This is distinct from enterprise organizational design or role architecture, which sits with a separate CEG function.

Enablement Focus/ Learning design sensibility

You do not need to be an instructional designer or a master trainer, but you do understand adult learning frameworks (70-20-10, Bloom’s Taxonomy, spaced repetition) well enough to ensure community programming reinforces rather than duplicates formal learning paths. You have experience with skills and competency frameworks.

Data-driven decision making

You define success metrics before you launch, track leading indicators, and course correct based on evidence. You can build and present dashboards that make community health visible to leadership.

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in enablement, community management, learning and development, or technical program management in enterprise technology organizations
  • 5+ years leading communities of practice, centers of excellence, or practitioner networks at scale (500+ participants across multiple regions)
  • 2+ years of direct experience with AI technologies - either enabling AI adoption across organizations, building AI-powered learning or enablement programs, or leading technical communities focused on AI/ML capabilities
  • Demonstrated success building community programs from scratch in large, matrixed organizations -including defining governance, recruiting volunteer leaders, and sustaining engagement beyond the initial launch
  • Experience presenting strategy and results to VP/SVP-level audiences with measurable business impact
  • Track record of leading change management initiatives that produced durable behavior change - not just awareness campaigns
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience

Preferred

  • Experience building technical certification programs
  • Experience at a top-tier enterprise technology company (SaaS, cloud, platform) in a customer success, professional services, or post-sale organization
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow products, the Now Platform, or the ServiceNow ecosystem
  • Experience with AI-powered enablement tools (e.g., conversation intelligence, AI coaching simulations, adaptive learning platforms)
  • Certifications or formal training in change management (Prosci, ADKAR) or community management (CMX, Community Roundtable)
  • Experience operating hub-and-spoke enablement models across global GEOs
  • Degree in organizational development, learning science, business administration, or a related field

Location and work arrangement

This role supports a flexible work persona. ServiceNow offers flexibility in how and where work is performed, based on the nature of the role and team needs. This position may be based in a ServiceNow hub office or work remotely, with periodic travel to GEO locations and ServiceNow events (estimated 15–20% travel).

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Personalized Support Engineer

About the job

The Personalized Support Engineer (PSE) is a member of the Global Personalized support team supporting our top tier customers. They are responsible for handling a variety of Twilio products while also working and collaborating with the Technical Account Managers (TAMs.) The Global PSE team advocates for our TAMs’ customers as if they are their own while providing 24x7x365 coverage, managing specializations and guarding the queue.

This position requires working in a shift, EMEA - 1300-2200 IST. We work 5 days a week, and could include one or both weekend days. (Tue-Sat, Sun-Thur, Mon-Fri etc)

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • BE AN OWNER: Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER SHOES: Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • EMPOWER OTHERS: Collaborate with your teammates, the Twilio Product and Engineering teams including filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
  • RUTHLESSLY PRIORITIZE: Be ready to assist our customers when they need us. This position may require working an irregular shift, including the weekend/holidays (Shifts are subject to change based on evolving team and customer needs).

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Fluent in English language (both oral and written)
  • 2+ years’ experience in a client-facing technical role, preferably in supporting REST API and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
  • Experience working with top tier customers.
  • Supporting customers with service level agreements (SLAs) of 3 hours or less, utilizing a ticket system such as Zendesk.
  • Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
  • Advanced time management skills and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
  • Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.

Desired:

  • Previous exposure or knowledge of Twilio products
  • Experience working with JIRA, Confluence, Airtable and other project tools.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues
  • Prior telecom (Carrier, SIP, PBX) including reviewing PCAPs/using Wireshark or messaging platform experience

Location

This role will be remotely based in India(Karanatka, Telangana, Delhi, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra)

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.description:
Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Financial Controller

Compensation range: $3,500 AUD - $4,500 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: 8:30 AM– 5:00 PM Queensland Time (AEST, UTC+10) / 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM Manila, Monday to Friday, no daylight-saving shift

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian distribution business working with a portfolio of international and local suppliers and a growing network of retail and commercial partners across the country.

The business is focused on building a reliable, well-managed supply operation that supports its customers and partners through consistent product availability, strong supplier relationships, and efficient internal processes. As the company continues to grow, it is investing in better systems, planning, and operational structure to support the next stage of the business.

Role Overview: The Financial Controller owns the accounts function end to end: accurate books every day, a clean close by working day 5 every month, and a management pack, rolling three-way forecast and 13-week cash forecast the business is run against. Until the Senior Bookkeeper is hired, the Controller performs the transactional work personally; after that hire, the Controller supervises it and spends the freed time on analysis, controls and insight.

This is an ownership role. The Controller decides the exceptions (the unmatched supplier invoice, the disputed dealer credit, the landed cost that does not tie to the shipment) rather than escalating them, and is accountable for the numbers being right. Board-level judgement work, including capital allocation cases, lender and investor packs, acquisition due diligence and scenario modelling, sits with the CEO and the fractional CFO; the Controller supplies the numbers and the first draft.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Bank and cards: Daily reconciliation of all bank and card accounts across AUD, USD, EUR and other trading currencies using bank feeds and matching rules; clear exceptions the same day.
  • Accounts Payable: Enter supplier invoices; three-way match of purchase order, goods receipt and invoice on inventory purchases; code indirect expenses; prepare payment-run schedules for CEO approval; maintain supplier master data and terms; manage supplier prepayments and settlement timing.
  • Accounts Receivable and credit: Allocate customer receipts; issue statements; prepare overdue lists and reminder correspondence; set and apply customer credit limits and overdue thresholds within policy; provide a weekly exposure dashboard to the Customer Service Manager.
  • Expenses, cards and payroll: Reconcile corporate cards and expense claims; prepare payroll data for review; reconcile superannuation and leave balances.
  • Inventory and landed cost: Post goods receipts and landed-cost allocations (freight, duty, insurance); stock valuation; slow-moving and obsolete stock provisions; reconcile system inventory to physical counts with the Warehouse Coordinator.
  • Month-end close: Reconciliations and schedules by working day 3 (bank, AP, AR, prepayments, accruals, fixed assets, GST); close by working day 5; monthly management pack with P&L by brand and channel, balance sheet, cash, inventory days, DSO/DPO and a one-page narrative.
  • Budgets, forecasts and variance: Build the annual budget with each manager for CEO approval; maintain a rolling 12-month three-way model re-forecast quarterly; own the 13-week cash forecast; monthly budget-versus-actual by department and brand with root causes and corrective actions agreed with the responsible manager.
  • Commercial insight: Gross margin by brand, channel, customer and product at landed cost; fixed versus variable cost and breakeven by brand; support Sales and Brand Management on pricing, rebates and supplier terms with numbers.
  • Foreign exchange: Execute FX transactions and track open positions within the company’s FX Risk Management Policy; monthly revaluation of open foreign-currency balances.
  • Controls and compliance: Segregation of duties and delegation-of-authority matrix; audit trail in NetSuite; quarterly fraud and leakage review; prepare BAS, FBT, payroll tax, ASIC and year-end working papers for the Australian accountants and manage their annual review; fixed-asset register.
  • NetSuite and systems: Own the NetSuite finance module: cleanse MYOB data (debtors, creditors, open purchase orders, unreconciled items), load and verify opening balances, chart of accounts, roles and approvals, bank feeds, saved searches and reports; specify Power BI finance reporting; specify and supervise AI-assisted workflows for bank reconciliation, collections and report drafting; document every recurring process.
  • Procurement interface: Line-manage the Procurement & Supply Chain Manager; approve purchase orders outside the budget envelope; receive the procurement document pack and process payments (Procurement raises no payments).
  • People: Select, onboard and lead the Senior Bookkeeper when the trigger is reached; train managers to read and own their own numbers.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Philippine CPA (Australian CPA or CA an advantage).
  • Minimum 8 years in accounting, including at least 3 in a product-based business (wholesale, distribution, import, retail or manufacturing) with hands-on inventory, landed-cost and multi-currency accounting.
  • Has worked for an Australian or New Zealand business or client: understands BAS/GST coding, superannuation, payroll tax and the 1 July – 30 June financial year.
  • Has personally run a monthly close end to end and produced a management pack for an owner or managing director.
  • Has built or maintained a budget and a rolling three-way model (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and run monthly variance reviews with operating managers.
  • Hands-on NetSuite experience in the finance module (AP, AR, bank reconciliation, period close). Experience on a NetSuite migration or data-cleansing project is strongly preferred; MYOB experience is an advantage.
  • Decides exceptions rather than escalating them, and can show it with examples.
  • Builds systems: documents processes without being asked; has used automation or AI tools in finance work.
  • Strong written and spoken English; comfortable presenting numbers to a CEO and a management team and disagreeing in writing when the numbers call for it.

Nice to Have:

  • Led the finance side of a NetSuite go-live, including opening-balance reconciliation.
  • NetSuite OneWorld, multi-subsidiary or consolidation exposure.
  • Power BI or NetSuite SuiteAnalytics.
  • Has supervised a bookkeeper or small finance team across time zones.
  • Experience with Australian customs, Deferred GST and import documentation.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Junior Business Analyst(Data & Integration) with a strong data analysis background to support NOAA Fisheries data mapping, interoperability requirements, and compliance documentation on a federal data integration program. This role focuses on the technical business analysis activities that bridge data engineering and regulatory compliance.

The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Work Location: Remote

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Conduct detailed source-to-target data mapping analysis for NOAA Fisheries species datasets, documenting field-level transformation rules, data type conversions, and null-handling logic.
  • Analyze NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion and document remediation requirements.
  • Support the Metadata and Authoritative Source Registry by researching and documenting NOAA Fisheries data source attributes, refresh cadences, and data stewardship contacts.
  • Assist in the development and documentation of interoperability testing requirements including API connectivity, data exchange protocols, and metadata alignment test cases.
  • Support compliance validation checklist development by documenting validation criteria for species list generation, decision logic, and template content completeness.
  • Analyze live consultation feedback from production and document actionable requirements for system updates.
  • Support the Prototype Ingest Results Report by documenting NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion, including defect descriptions, root cause analysis, and remediation requirements.
  • Assist in the development of training metrics dashboard requirements and reporting specifications.
  • Support the compilation of final operational documentation by documenting NOAA Fisheries data refresh procedures.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 0 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 6 years of professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
  • Experience supporting business analysis experience with a focus on data integration or data migration programs.
  • Experience with source-to-target data mapping and data quality analysis.
  • Familiarity with API integration concepts and interoperability testing requirements.
  • Strong analytical and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting federal IT programs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with NOAA Fisheries or other federal environmental data systems.
  • Familiarity with ETL concepts, data pipelines, or cloud data platforms.
  • Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs.
  • Experience contributing to program status reports or monthly progress reports.
  • ECBA or CCBA certification.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: About VantageVantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises.
jobs.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


Product Engineering Department

The Product Engineering team is building a repeatable, product-led approach to designing, delivering, and operating data centers at a global scale. The team partners across architecture, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, construction, and regional delivery functions to develop scalable solutions that improve reliability, constructability, speed-to-market, and operational performance.


Position Overview

This role can be based in Denver, CO following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office, 2 days flexible). Or US remote.

Vantage is seeking a Principal Structural Engineer to lead structural design for mission-critical data center facilities, with a strong emphasis on prefabricated and modular construction methods.

This is a Principal-level technical leadership role for an experienced engineer who can set structural strategy, establish design standards, and guide complex structural decisions from concept through construction. The role will balance speed-to-market and constructability with the rigorous safety, reliability, and performance requirements of data center infrastructure.

The Principal Structural Engineer will serve as the technical authority for structural design across foundations, steel and concrete framing, floor systems, equipment support structures, and modular deployments supporting data center builds, expansions, and retrofit programs.

This position is remote within the United States, with travel required for site visits, construction observations, and visits to fabrication facilities.


Essential Job Functions

  • Provide Principal-level technical expertise for the structural design of foundations, structural framing, and floor systems supporting data center builds, expansions, retrofits, and modular deployments.
  • Establish structural requirements, reference design approaches, technical standards, and design guardrails that can be applied across data center platforms and multiple jurisdictions.
  • Design structural systems optimized for prefabricated and modular construction, including modular skids, precast components, factory-built PODs, and off-site assembled MEP yards.
  • Incorporate requirements for off-site manufacturing, transportation, lifting, rigging, installation, tolerances, and interfaces between factory-built modules and site-built infrastructure.
  • Review and perform load analyses for raised floors, equipment racks, generators, cooling infrastructure, and rooftop or ground-mounted mechanical equipment.
  • Set technical direction for seismic, wind, and building-code compliance strategies across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate with architectural, civil, MEP, manufacturing, and fabrication partners to integrate structural designs into prefabricated delivery workflows.
  • Lead structural design reviews, shop drawing reviews, constructability assessments, and the resolution of complex structural interface issues.
  • Review fabricator calculations, shop drawings, and submittals, resolving tolerance and interface challenges between prefabricated modules and site-built structures.
  • Lead constructability and value-engineering reviews focused on modular sequencing, transportation logistics, installation constraints, safety, reliability, and speed-to-market.
  • Evaluate existing facilities and develop practical structural solutions for upgrades supporting increased power and cooling density.
  • Partner with Product Engineering, construction, manufacturing, and regional delivery teams to improve cross-functional alignment and technical execution.
  • Mentor engineers, elevate structural design quality, and establish disciplined review practices for calculations, design packages, and technical decisions.
  • Conduct site visits, construction observations, and visits to fabrication and off-site manufacturing facilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer license required.
  • 10 or more years of structural engineering experience.
  • At least four years of structural engineering experience supporting data centers or other mission-critical facilities.
  • Hands-on experience designing structural systems for modular or prefabricated construction.
  • Demonstrated experience designing foundations, steel and concrete framing, floor systems, and equipment support structures.
  • Experience with foundations supporting heavy equipment with varying vibration, movement, and operational requirements.
  • Experience managing structural requirements associated with the transportation, lifting, and rigging of prefabricated modules.
  • Deep working knowledge of ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC, IBC, and other applicable structural design standards and building codes.
  • Proficiency with structural analysis and design software such as ETABS, SAP2000, RISA, or RAM.
  • Strong knowledge of seismic and wind design requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience reviewing structural calculations, design packages, fabricator shop drawings, technical submittals, and construction documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical decisions and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, technical problem-solving, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, priorities, and technical workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel for construction observations, site visits, and visits to fabrication facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Structural Engineer license, particularly for work within high-seismic markets.
  • Direct experience partnering with modular fabricators or off-site manufacturing facilities.
  • Experience leading structural design across multiple concurrent hyperscale or colocation data center projects.
  • Revit and BIM coordination experience, including clash detection across prefabricated and site-built interfaces.
  • Experience coordinating structural systems that support physical security, equipment movement, move-in and move-out requirements, prefabrication, and other trades.
  • Experience developing repeatable structural standards and reference designs for use across multiple projects or global platforms.
  • Experience supporting retrofit projects and infrastructure upgrades within operating mission-critical facilities.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $170,000- $175,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)
  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.
  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package.
