jobs.description:
College Board – OCEP/Digital Product

Location: This is a remote role, aligned to core EST hours. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The Digital Product division is driving the evolution of College Board’s digital assessment experience, providing opportunities that shape futures and open doors. As AI reshapes education, we are preparing students for the future by ensuring our digital assessments remain secure, meaningful, and reflective of the knowledge and skills needed to thrive in an AI-enabled world.

The Digital Product Operations team exists to bring clarity, structure, and measurable outcomes to how College Board’s Digital Product organization plans, delivers, and improves. We are a small, high-performing team that owns the operational systems, practices, and cross-functional coordination that enable 15+ product teams to deliver meaningful digital assessment experiences to millions of students and educators every year. We partner closely with Product, Technology, Design, and go-to-market functions, and we hold ourselves to the same bar we help others reach: rigorous, data-informed, and always improving.

Together, we are transforming College Board’s trusted assessment platform into a next generation digital assessment experience that is secure, user-centered, and built to evolve with the future of learning and assessment.

About the Opportunity

As Director, Analytics & Business Intelligence, you are the measurement infrastructure behind how Digital Product Operations understands and improves its impact. You build the dashboards, define the metrics, and create the coaching conditions that let product teams and the ProdOps function itself operate on evidence rather than instinct. You're comfortable building in a still-forming space, defining what "healthy" and "adopted" look like before anyone else has, and you don't stop at delivering a dashboard: you take a position on what the data means and own driving the change that follows.

In this role, you own the evidence layer that tells Digital Product whether it is improving, not just whether it is busy. Your work spans three domains at once: the health of 15+ product teams' planning and delivery practices, tracked through measures like roadmap completeness and Productboard field discipline; how well those teams are adopting ProdOps-driven ways of working; and whether the ProdOps function’s own change management efforts are gaining traction or falling short. You make the call on what the data means and what should happen next, then act on it, from diagnosing why an initiative is underperforming to designing and driving the intervention. You keep the Senior Director informed as a thought partner in that process, not a gatekeeper for it. What you build doesn’t wait to become useful until it reaches the Senior Director. Your dashboards, frameworks, and coaching directly change how product teams plan, prioritize, and improve.

In this role, you will:

Product Metrics & Dashboard Development (40%)

  • Define and build product metrics dashboards tracking roadmap maturity, Productboard field completeness, and roadmap change patterns across all 15+ Digital Product teams

  • Partner with Product leaders and PM/POs to define what “healthy” looks like for each metric, establishing baselines and targets that reflect meaningful improvement, not just activity

  • Design dashboards that are self-serve and easy to interpret, so product teams can understand their own health data without requiring ProdOps to translate it for them

  • Prepare executive-ready dashboards with minimal oversight from the Senior Director

  • Identify gaps in available data and partner with the Planning & Tooling Governance Director to ensure tooling standards support the metrics the function needs to track

ProdOps Effectiveness & Change Management Measurement (30%)

  • Build and maintain a measurement framework that tracks how effectively the product group is adopting ProdOps-driven ways of working, including new planning practices, tooling standards, and process changes

  • Define adoption metrics for each major ProdOps initiative before it launches, establishing what “adopted” looks like and how it will be measured from day one

  • Take a documented position on what the adoption data means, not just what it shows: diagnose whether gaps in adoption stem from awareness, capability, process design, or resistance, then bring a recommended course of action to the relevant stakeholders, partner with the relevant director to design the response, and own the follow-through to confirm whether the intervention worked

  • Track change management signals across the product group: awareness rates, behavior change indicators, and the difference between leading and lagging adoption signals

Dashboard Maintenance & Data Governance (20%)

  • Own ongoing maintenance of all dashboards across product and ProdOps metrics, ensuring data is current, accurate, and trustworthy at all times

  • Establish governance standards for metric definitions, ensuring consistent interpretation across teams and preventing measurement drift as the organization evolves

  • Conduct regular audits of data quality; identify and address gaps, inconsistencies, or stale data before they surface in leadership reviews or team conversations

  • Partner with the Planning & Tooling Governance Director to ensure metric definitions align with tooling standards and that field governance decisions support accurate measurement

  • Document all metric definitions, calculation methods, and data sources in the ProdOps Info Hub so the measurement framework is transparent and maintainable

Metrics Coaching & Adoption (10%)

  • Coach PM/POs on how to read and act on their roadmap health dashboards, translating data signals into product decisions and planning adjustments they can make independently

  • Coach the ProdOps team on how to interpret function effectiveness metrics, helping the team understand what the data is telling them and where to focus improvement efforts

  • Design coaching approaches that build genuine data literacy, not just tool familiarity, so teams develop the capability to operate independently rather than depending on ProdOps for interpretation

  • Identify patterns in how teams are misreading or ignoring their metrics; surface these patterns to the Senior Director and the relevant director as input for targeted interventions

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 5+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis within a digital product or technology organization

  • Experience measuring and driving organizational change: you understand the difference between awareness and behavior change, track both, and take ownership of designing and following through on the intervention when adoption stalls

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, defining what to measure and how for a function still establishing its own ways of working

  • Demonstrated experience building dashboards and metrics frameworks that teams actually use, not just technically sound, but genuinely adopted and acted on

  • Strong understanding of product management practices: you know what roadmap maturity, backlog health, and planning consistency look like in practice, and can design metrics that reflect them accurately

  • Strong data governance instincts: you define metrics precisely, document them clearly, and prevent measurement drift over time

  • Familiarity with Productboard, Jira, and Confluence as data sources: you know how to extract meaningful signals from product management tooling

  • Comfort with SQL and APIs to extract and validate your own data, even if you're not a technical builder yourself

  • Strong coaching and communication skills: you can translate data into clear, actionable guidance for non-technical audiences without losing accuracy

  • The ability to travel 5-7 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $88,000 - $145,000.

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

About the Role

As a Business Enablement Specialist, you will design, document and operationalise repeatable processes and the systems that support them. Working across Product, Engineering, Operations and Commercial teams, you will simplify complex workflows, reduce manual work, and ensure teams have reliable tools, clear procedures and the data they need to operate at scale. This is a hands-on role that combines process design, systems configuration, integration work and cross-functional change management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Map, document and optimise end-to-end operational workflows across multiple products and platforms, identifying automation opportunities and failure modes.

  • Configure and maintain internal systems and tooling (CRM, ticketing, workflow orchestration, admin panels and integrations) to support streamlined operations.

  • Design and implement integrations and automations using APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT patterns and third-party platforms to reduce manual handoffs and data reconciliation.

  • Create clear, scalable process documentation, runbooks and SOPs so teams can operate independently and consistently.

  • Author tracking and instrumentation requirements to ensure operational observability: logs, metrics, alerts and dashboards for key process health indicators.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to prioritise system improvements, scope development work and validate that releases meet operational needs and reliability standards.

  • Lead change management and training for new processes and systems, including stakeholder communication, onboarding materials and hands-on support during rollouts.

  • Own incident playbooks and contribute to incident response readiness: triage steps, escalation paths and post-incident reviews with actionable remediation plans.

  • Maintain data quality and access controls across operational systems, ensuring privacy-sensitive information is handled according to policy.

  • Continuously measure process performance and iterate: reduce cycle times, error rates and manual interventions through disciplined experimentation and monitoring.

How You’ll Do It

  • Develop clear process maps, decision trees and acceptance criteria that translate business workflows into system requirements.

  • Implement and maintain integrations using standard patterns (webhooks, message queues, scheduled jobs) and document failure/retry behaviours.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and alerts for operational KPIs, and perform routine QA to detect regressions or instrumentation gaps.

  • Create and maintain runbooks and training materials; run workshops and drop-in clinics to increase adoption and reduce support load.

  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to scope deliverables, set success metrics and verify post-deployment outcomes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years’ experience in operations, business systems, process improvement or a related role supporting cross-functional teams.

  • Practical experience with business systems such as CRMs, ticketing/workflow tools, analytics platforms and common SaaS integrations.

  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT, event-driven architectures) and a pragmatic approach to automation.

  • Strong documentation skills — able to produce unambiguous process specs, runbooks and training guides that scale across teams.

  • Solid analytical skills with experience instrumenting and monitoring processes using metrics, dashboards and alerts.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business audiences.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments and taking ownership of cross-functional initiatives from discovery through to operational handover.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms, low-code automation tools, or integration platforms (Zapier, Make, Workato, n8n, or similar).

  • Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting (Python, Google Apps Script) to build small automations and perform data validation.

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Looker/Looker Studio or similar) for operational metrics and alerting.

  • Experience designing processes in privacy-conscious environments and implementing appropriate access controls.

  • Previous experience leading cross-functional change programmes or training initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational workflows are well-documented, measurable and reliably executed with minimal manual intervention.

  • Systems and integrations reduce cycle times and error rates, and internal teams trust the tools and runbooks provided.

  • Incidents are resolved according to playbooks, root causes are addressed, and recurrence is demonstrably reduced.

  • Process and system improvements are delivered iteratively with clear metrics demonstrating impact on scalability and efficiency.

Why Join Us?

You’ll join a collaborative team where your work directly improves how the business operates at scale. This role offers exposure to multiple product lines, the chance to shape tooling and process standards, and the opportunity to make measurable impact by reducing operational complexity and enabling teams to move faster.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

Data Capability Coach (DP3/DL3)

Reports to: Delivery Director

Location: UK, Remote, with national travel as required

About Corndel

Corndel is a unique, multi award-winning UK management and technology training provider that focuses on delivering the highest quality programmes throughout an employee’s career. We partner with some of the UK’s largest and most exciting businesses to help drive organisational and personal performance through transformational learning.

Our mission is to inspire people to think bigger and shape the future, and our vision is to expand minds and create a world of unlimited potential. We are one of the fastest growing companies in the UK and provide a great platform for proactive and motivated individuals to take the next exciting step in their career. You will be joining an organisation with a fun, entrepreneurial and supportive environment, providing fulfilling work and an open, informal culture.

Purpose of the Role

The DP3 Coach (Data Driven Professional & Leader) exists to help learners build confidence in using data to inform decisions, generate insight, and drive tangible business impact.

In this role, you will coach, mentor, and teach learners on Corndel’s Level 3 data technician programmes, supporting them to move from data awareness to confident, practical application. You will help learners understand not just how to work with data, but why it matters, how to communicate insight clearly, and how to apply sound judgement when working with data in real organisational contexts.

You will combine strong data capability with a coaching mindset — empowering learners to take ownership of their development, challenge assumptions, and apply data ethically and effectively in their roles.

Core Responsibilities

Learner Coaching & Development

  • Manage a caseload of learners, building trusted relationships through highquality coaching, mentoring, and structured teaching.

  • Deliver engaging onetoone sessions and workshops that make data concepts accessible, relevant, and practical.

  • Empower learners to develop confidence with data by encouraging curiosity, critical thinking, and reflection.

  • Create an inclusive, psychologically safe learning environment where learners feel comfortable asking questions, testing ideas, and learning from mistakes.

Data Literacy & Insight

  • Support learners to develop core data skills, including data preparation, analysis, visualisation, and interpretation.

  • Coach learners to use tools such as Excel, Power BI, and related platforms to generate meaningful insights and communicate them clearly.

  • Help learners connect data analysis to real business questions, decisionmaking, and outcomes.

  • Model integrity and good judgement in how data is used, interpreted, and communicated, including awareness of data quality, bias, and ethical considerations.

Progress, Quality & Outcomes

  • Guide learners through programme milestones, assessments, and portfolio development, ensuring consistent progress and timely completion.

  • Support learners to produce highquality, compliant evidence that genuinely reflects their capability and workplace impact.

  • Engage constructively with learners’ line managers to align learning with organisational priorities and support progression.

  • Take ownership for quality and compliance, balancing learner support with high standards and clear expectations.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across Operations, Product, and Curriculum to deliver a consistent and highquality learner experience.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve delivery approaches, learner engagement, and outcomes.

  • Stay curious and committed to continuous development, keeping up to date with data tools, practices, and ways of working that enhance learning.

Technical Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Practical experience working with data in a professional context.

  • Strong working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and analysis techniques.

  • Knowledge of Power Query and how it can be used for data cleansing, importing data and automation of repetitive tasks.

  • Experience using Power BI or similar tools to analyse data and create clear, intuitive visualisations.

  • Confidence using Microsoft tools such as Teams, Word, and PowerPoint to support communication and learning.

  • Experience coaching, mentoring, teaching, or facilitating learning in a professional environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts clearly to learners with varied confidence levels.

Desirable

  • Familiarity with efficiently using AI tools to support data-driven insights

  • Experience with Power Pivot, Power Automate, other Microsoft Power Platform tools.

  • Familiarity with Google Suite (Google sheets, docs, slides and looker)

  • Familiarity with digital engagement tools including Miro, Whiteboard

  • Teaching or coaching qualifications, or experience delivering structured learning.

  • Experience supporting learners in apprenticeship or vocational learning contexts.

What Success in This Role Looks Like

In this role, success means that you:

  • Consistently support learners to complete their programme and End Point Assessment successfully and on time.

  • Are trusted by learners as a knowledgeable, supportive, and approachable expert.

  • Enable learners to apply data confidently to inform decisions and create business impact.

  • Maintain high standards of quality, professionalism, and learner care.

  • Contribute positively to a collaborative, inclusive, and highperforming team culture.

What Brilliant Looks Like

At its best, this role creates impact beyond individual learners:

  • Learners describe your support as pivotal in building their confidence and capability with data.

  • You spot patterns across cohorts and proactively improve learner experience and outcomes.

  • You help learners move beyond reporting to insight, judgement, and influence.

  • You challenge learners constructively, helping them make better decisions rather than just better charts.

  • Your influence supports organisations to embed datadriven thinking in a responsible, sustainable way.

Who This Role Is For

This role is ideal for a data practitioner, analyst, or educator who:

  • Enjoys helping others develop confidence and capability with data.

  • Believes good data use combines technical skill with judgement and integrity.

  • Values inclusion, empowerment, and impact alongside technical competence.

  • Wants to shape how individuals and organisations use data to make better decisions.

Why join Corndel?

  • Work flexibly and stay connected – most of our people work remotely, supported by regular Regional Connect Days and our annual all-company Cornfest.

  • See the impact of your work – every role at Corndel shapes how organisations grow, so you’ll see your contribution translate into stronger leaders and teams.

  • We're a leader in our field, with quality and excellence at the heart of what we do.

We're committed to having a fully inclusive, welcoming and safe culture and always striving to improve.

As part of our commitment to create an inclusive workplace where all colleagues can be their true selves, excel in their roles and progress in their careers, we recognise the importance of embracing the diversity in the working population and making Corndel a fully accessible employer.

If you have a disability that might affect any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know about any help or reasonable adjustments you need before any interview or assessment. We’ll work with you to make sure any appropriate support is in place and make the application process a more positive experience.

About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

jobs.excerpt: What You Can Expect As a Premier Support Manager, you will lead a team of Technical Account Managers delivering high-touch support for Zoom's most strategic enterprise accounts, with direct influence over customer outcomes and the ongoing strength of our Premier Support portfolio.
jobs.description:
What You Can Expect


As a Premier Support Manager, you will lead a team of Technical Account Managers delivering high-touch support for Zoom's most strategic enterprise accounts, with direct influence over customer outcomes and the ongoing strength of our Premier Support portfolio. Day to day, you will coach and develop your team, set performance goals, and act as an executive escalation resource for complex customer situations, working in close partnership with Customer Success, Service Engineering, and Sales. This role suits a leader who combines data-driven accountability with genuine investment in people, someone who finds meaning in growing talent alongside delivering results. You will report to senior leadership within Zoom's Global Premier Support organization, and the role may require occasional travel to Zoom offices and customer sites.


About the Team


The Premier Support team delivers high-touch technical account management for Zoom's most strategic enterprise customers, helping them realize the full value of Zoom Workplace. The team works at the intersection of technical expertise and relationship management, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to address complex challenges and drive proactive outcomes. As a key part of Zoom's customer experience strategy, the team plays a meaningful role in retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the Premier portfolio.


Responsibilities


  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Account Managers, building the skills and competencies needed to deliver outstanding Premier Support experiences.
  • Recruit, onboard, and grow talent within the TAM team, ensuring all business processes and quality standards are upheld.
  • Define and drive team KPIs, quarterly goals, and strategic initiatives aligned to the broader Premier Services program.
  • Analyze team performance data and process metrics to proactively identify risk factors, growth opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement.
  • Serve as an executive-level escalation point for complex customer situations, partnering with Customer Success Managers, Escalations, and Service Engineering to drive timely resolution.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to strengthen customer relationships and support retention and growth across the Premier Service portfolio.
  • Identify underperformance trends and lead structured improvement plans with appropriate senior support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to deliver data-driven decisions that enhance team processes and strengthen the Premier Services program.

What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams in a customer-facing organization, with a track record of developing high-performing talent.
  • 5+ years of experience in the SaaS industry and/or Unified Communications space, with deep familiarity with enterprise collaboration environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence stakeholders at the executive level, including delivering compelling presentations and driving strategic alignment.
  • Proven track record of executing strategy at an operational and organizational scale, using data and performance metrics to inform decisions.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and solutions to deliver measurable improvements in team efficiency and service delivery.
  • Familiarity with Unified Communications technologies such as Zoom Workplace, Cisco, Microsoft, or equivalent platforms; knowledge of IP telephony, SIP, or API/SDK integration is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$97,600.00

Maximum:

$225,700.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application!

Anticipated Position Close Date:

10/16/26

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.


About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.


Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

jobs.excerpt: What You Can ExpectAs Program Manager, Customer Advocacy, you will lead Zoom's end-to-end customer reviews strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, building a sustainable, always-on program that transforms customer evidence into a strategic engine for market proof and competitive differentiation.
jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

As Program Manager, Customer Advocacy, you will lead Zoom's end-to-end customer reviews strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, building a sustainable, always-on program that transforms customer evidence into a strategic engine for market proof and competitive differentiation. This role sits at the intersection of customer advocacy, marketing strategy, and analyst relations, with direct responsibility for elevating the customer voice into AI visibility, marketing narratives, and sales enablement at scale. You will move Zoom's approach from episodic, award-driven solicitations to a strategic program that serves analyst evaluation cycles, supports AEO/GEO visibility, and feeds cross-functional marketing initiatives across content, demand generation, and social. For a strategist who is equally comfortable setting direction and executing in the details, this role offers the scope, visibility, and organizational impact to build something genuinely differentiated.


About the Team

The Content and Customer Advocacy team sits at the center of Zoom's marketing engine, shaping the stories, strategies, and digital experiences that connect Zoom's brand with its most important audiences. We own content strategy, editorial programs, customer advocacy, and the digital experience on zoom.com, working across Sales, Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, and Analyst Relations to turn customer evidence into a competitive advantage. We are a high-impact, cross-functional team that stays relentlessly focused on measurable outcomes and business impact.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end customer review strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, shifting from episodic award-driven solicitations to a strategic, always-on program that drives market proof and competitive differentiation.
  • Own the customer review calendar, balancing continuous review generation across key product categories with strategic alignment to analyst evaluation periods and market priorities.
  • Prioritize AEO/GEO visibility of customer reviews to maximize AI citations, support core marketing narratives, and influence technology buyer evaluations across the dark funnel.
  • Manage Zoom's presence across all subscribed and non-subscribed review platforms, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strategic positioning while tracking volume, quality, ratings, sentiment, and competitive standing.
  • Support key Analyst Relations market evaluations including Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Magic Quadrant with high-quality customer references, partnering with Product Marketing and AR to match references to specific product, industry, and geographic requirements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Content, Integrated Marketing, Social Media, and Digital teams to drive multi-channel promotion and consumption of customer reviews.
  • Partner with reviews vendors to shift relationships from tactical solicitation to a strategic content engine, leveraging comparison reports, customer story generation, and reference identification.
  • Surface growth opportunities by integrating customer reviews into internal AI search tools, identifying key strategic focus markets, and building organizational expertise across review platform capabilities including intent leads, content licensing, and emerging features.

jobs.title: ASL/BASL Video Contributor – Remote Paid Project ($700)
jobs.excerpt: About the ProjectDataForce by TransPerfect is looking for American Sign Language (ASL) and Black American Sign Language (BASL) signers across the United States to participate in a paid remote research project.
jobs.description:
About the Project

DataForce by TransPerfect is looking for American Sign Language (ASL) and Black American Sign Language (BASL) signers across the United States to participate in a paid remote research project.

The goal of this project is to help make technology more accessible for everyone and promote greater inclusion of Deaf and signing communities in the development of future technologies.

We believe that projects involving ASL, BASL, and the Deaf and Hard of Hearing communities should include meaningful representation from the communities themselves. Our project team includes Deaf and Hard of Hearing professionals who are directly involved in the administration and development of the project.

Their perspectives help us make informed decisions, advocate for the interests of the community, and ensure that accessibility, cultural considerations, and participant experience are represented throughout the project.

What You’ll Do

Participants will record approximately 1,000 short ASL/BASL videos from home, including phrases, numbers, fingerspelling sequences, and conversational prompts.

Each recording is approximately 10 seconds long. Completing the full set is expected to take approximately 10 hours in total.

The project can be completed remotely from home using a compatible Apple device.

Compensation

$700 USD for completing the project according to the study guidelines.

This is a project-based opportunity and not a full-time employment position.

Who Can Participate

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older

  • Be fluent in American Sign Language (ASL) and/or Black American Sign Language (BASL)

  • Currently reside in the United States, excluding Texas, Illinois, and Washington

  • Be able to understand written English instructions

  • Be comfortable recording yourself on video

  • Have a suitable environment at home for recording

  • Have access to a compatible Apple device:

    • iPhone 12 or newer

    • iPad 9th Generation (2021) or newer

    • MacBook with M1 chip or newer

    • iMac with M1 chip or newer

Why Participate?

Your contribution will help support the development of technologies that better recognize and represent ASL, BASL, and diverse signing communities.

You'll participate entirely from home, complete the recordings on your own schedule according to the project instructions, and receive $700 USD upon successful completion of the project according to the study guidelines.

How to Apply

Click Apply and complete the short application.

Our DataForce team will review your information and contact eligible participants with the next steps and detailed project instructions.

Work Location: United States (Remote – East Coast preferred)

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday; up to 40 hours per week

Engagement Model: Fixed-term/Temporary Employment

Estimated Start Date: September/ October 2026

Estimated Project Duration: until May 2027 (extension possible)

DataForce by TransPerfect is seeking a UX Research Analyst to support ongoing user research initiatives fora temporary, full-time engagement. This role will focus primarily on operationalizing and managing questionnaire-based research studies, with an emphasis on Text-to-Speech (TTS) quality and potentially Translation quality.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. The selected candidate will work closely with the client’s research team to administer studies, manage survey workflows, collect responses, and analyze results. The research design will be provided by the team; the analyst will ensure studies are properly built, launched, monitored, and analyzed.

Role Summary

The UX Research Analyst will be responsible for implementing and managing questionnaire-based research studies from setup through reporting. This includes building surveys in Qualtrics based on predefined designs, configuring workflows and logic, monitoring live studies, ensuring data quality, and analyzing results. The role requires strong organizational skills and attention to detail to ensure studies run smoothly and findings are accurately documented and communicated to stakeholders.

Role Responsibilities

  • Build, configure, and manage questionnaire-based research studies using Qualtrics (or similar tools).

  • Implement complex survey logic and workflows based on predefined study designs

  • Launch and monitor studies to ensure smooth execution and data quality

  • Collect, organize, and validate survey responses

  • Clean, validate, and organize survey responses to ensure accuracy and reliability of findings

  • Analyze study results, identifying trends, patterns, outliers, and key drivers in the data

  • Produce structured summaries, visualizations, and reports that communicate results clearly to stakeholders

  • Collaborate directly with client stakeholders (East Coast US) on study execution and reporting

  • Maintain documentation and ensure research processes are organized and repeatable

Role Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience supporting or running questionnaire-based research studies

  • Demonstrated experience collecting and validating survey responses and producing insight-driven summaries and reports

  • Strong working knowledge of Qualtrics, including survey logic and workflow configuration

  • Fluent English (written and verbal)

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to clearly communicate findings

  • Ability to follow structured research plans and execute independently

Preferred Role Requirements

  • Strong preference for experience in Text-to-Speech (TTS), voice testing, translation quality, or related domains

  • Experience in software, technology, or digital product environments

  • Understanding of statistics for survey analysis

  • Familiarity with user interfaces and UX concepts

  • Experience working with distributed or international teams

jobs.excerpt: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.
jobs.description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

Location: This role can be based anywhere globally, with preferred locations in Canada, USA, Tel Aviv, or Australia.

Position Summary:

TrendAI is seeking a Vulnerability Researcher to join our team of security researchers here in the Zero Day Initiative. The Zero Day Initiative is radically changing the enterprise security landscape with its unique brand of industry-leading vulnerability research. The Vulnerability Researcher role will leverage the intelligence coming in from a globally distributed network of vulnerability researchers to deliver actionable guidance to the product teams inside of TrendAI. This role produces the intelligence that ensures that TrendAI products can detect and block zero-day threats to an enterprise. It will also support the sales and marketing teams within TrendAI through the publication of research, white papers, and blogs that will be presented at top security conferences and tradeshows around the world.

If you enjoy analyzing, finding and exploiting vulnerabilities, researching exploit techniques and mitigations, and building systems to streamline reverse engineering analysis tasks then we'd love to hear from you.

We're primarily seeking experienced Senior, Staff, and Principal-level researchers. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise and the ability to operate at a Staff level or above. We are also open to exceptional Senior Vulnerability Researchers who demonstrate the potential to grow into a Staff or Principal role.

Responsibilities:

  • Research newly discovered vulnerabilities in a wide range of software products

  • Reverse engineer and research network protocols, file formats, and software

  • Develop and verify proof-of-concept files and exploit code

  • Produce reports describing software vulnerabilities and detection of attack vectors

  • Monitor security industry publications, news groups and other online sources for newly discovered security vulnerabilities and emerging threats

  • Implement new and improve existing tools to automate and streamline the vulnerability research process

  • Collaborate with other vulnerability researchers on research, analysis and report production

Required Knowledge:

  • Functional understanding of TCP/IP protocol stack and higher-level networking protocols (wire-level protocols, RF communications, BGP, routing protocols, or others).

  • Experience in static and dynamic reverse engineering binaries ((x86, x64, ARM, PPC, MIPS, SPARC, 68k, or others)

  • Knowledge in a variety of operating systems internals

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Ability to analyze and describe vulnerabilities and attack methods

We are currently looking for contributors for our Ronia Raw Photo Collection Project.

We invite photographers, photo hobbyists, visual creators, and anyone passionate about photography to participate in our RAW Photo Collection project.

Do you regularly capture high-quality photos in RAW format to expand your photo library? If the answer is yes, this project allows you to earn extra income by contributing your photos to the development of advanced AI and computer vision technologies. Your images can have a real-world impact beyond your personal library.

Participants may submit both existing photos from their personal archives and newly captured images in RAW format. We’re looking for a wide variety of subjects, styles, lighting conditions, and environments—including nature, events, everyday scenes, objects, and more.

Photos may be captured in RAW and other supported formats using eligible iPhones or digital cameras. Uploading is quick and easy via our mobile app or browser-based data collection tool.

We will be collecting the following types of photos:

  1. RAW Images: individual, unedited images captured directly from the device.

  2. Image Pairs: pairs of identical unedited photos, with specific objects present in one and absent in the other photo.

Accepted Formats:
The photos should be native RAW and DNG where applicable (including CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, and PEF). These files retain the raw data captured by the device at the moment the photo was taken.

All submitted photos must be original and taken by you. Photos downloaded from the internet or generated using AI will not be accepted.

Intellectual Property Rights:Participants retain full ownership of all submitted photos, which will be used exclusively for internal purposes by our client and will not be distributed, or published.

Who is eligible?

To participate you should meet the following qualifying criteria:

  • Be 18 years or older.

  • Be a resident of the United States.

  • Be able to upload RAW images or a pair of two images following our instructions.

  • All images should be taken with one of the following devices:

    • iPhone models accepted:

      • 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max

      • 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max

      • 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max

        All accepted iPhone models should run iOS 14.3 or later.

        No other smartphones are permitted.

    • Digital Cameras

      • Full-frame mirrorless

      • Full-frame DSLR

      • APS-C mirrorless

      • APS-C DSL

Where is the project taking place?

This is a fully remote project. You can participate from the comfort of your home or preferred location within the US.

Please note the following location-based limitations:

  • Public Images

Public Images are photos taken in publicly accessible places and/or featuring identifiable individuals. We can accept Public Images only if they were captured in the following U.S. states: AL, AK, AZ, AR, FL, GA, HI, ID, KS, LA, ME, MA, MI, MS, MO, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, VT, WV, WI, WY.

  • Non-Public Images

Non-Public Images (for example, photos taken in private settings without public access) are accepted from all U.S. states, except IL, WA, and TX.

Image

How much is the compensation?

You will receive $1.50 USD per each accepted photo. Participants may submit as many photos as they wish across all open categories. Please note that some categories may have submission limits, and once a category is filled, it will be closed. Submissions are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.

Example earnings:
50 accepted photos x $1,50 = $75 USD

100 accepted photos x $1.50 = $150 USD

Please note that all submissions will be checked by our Quality Assurance team, and compensation will be provided for submitted and accepted photos. The project team will provide you with feedback once the Quality Check process is completed.

As payment methods we offer Wire Transfer, PayPal, Gift Card and Check according to your preference.

We offer a referral bonus of $15 USD for each participant you refer to the project who submits a minimum of 50 accepted photos.

DataForce by TransPerfect is seeking Freelance Short Story Writers!

What is the project about?
The purpose of this project is to create high-quality story content to help test and improve Machine Translation technology. Submissions will not be published or distributed, and writers retain the right to use their work as they wish after submission.

Task description:
The project task is to complete 1 short story of approximately 9,600 words.

After being selected, the task begins with submitting a brief plot for approval. Once approved, writers can proceed to complete the story within the specified timeframe. If needed, revisions may be required based on feedback received.

The short story must be in one of the following genres, and the genre will be assigned based on your selected preference:

  • Thriller/Mystery

  • Sci-fi/Fantasy

  • Self-help

  • Romance

  • Memoir/Biography

When will the project start?
This project is estimated to start during the week of Aug 31, 2026.

How long does it take?
We estimate it will take approximately 16.75 hours over a 2-week period to complete this project.

This is a fully remote project. You can participate from the comfort of your home.

jobs.title: Sr. NetSuite Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain.
jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

We are seeking a hands-on individual contributor to take ownership of the performance, reliability, and evolution of our NetSuite environment and financial systems. This role is ideal for someone who wants to become the organization’s definitive NetSuite subject-matter expert – not by managing a team, but by serving as the strategic and operational owner of the platform.

You will lead the configuration, integrations, data integrity, controls, and overall roadmap for NetSuite, ensuring the platform effectively supports our finance function and broader business needs. This is an opportunity to have significant ownership and influence over how our financial systems operate, while building deep expertise in one of the company’s most critical platforms.

You'll sit at the intersection of accounting, finance, and technology (with operational visibility). Some of your time will be strategic: shaping the platform roadmap, identifying opportunities for automation, and deciding what we should build next. Other days will be highly tactical: sitting with the AP team, Procurement, AR to understand why a workflow is broken and fix it before lunch.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable getting into the details of how the business actually operates. You'll uncover the shadow spreadsheets, manual workarounds, and process gaps that have accumulated over time; understand why they're there; and turn them into scalable solutions within the system.

The best improvements won't always come from a perfectly written requirements document. They'll come from your ability to see where work is unnecessarily difficult and determine how technology, process, or both can make it better.

Key Responsibilities

Own and Administer the Platform

  • Serve as the primary administrator for our NetSuite environment OneWorld / multi-subsidiary / including users, roles, permissions, security, and segregation of duties.
  • Own the NetSuite release cycle: evaluate semiannual releases, manage sandbox environments, test changes, and control deployments into production.
  • Maintain a clean, scalable system architecture across custom fields and records, forms, lists, workflows, and other configurations.
  • Establish and maintain configuration standards and system hygiene as the platform evolves.
  • Manage relationships with NetSuite Support and third-party SuiteApp and technology vendors.

Improve and Build

  • Own and drive the NetSuite platform roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, automation, and user experience.
  • Design and build solutions using SuiteFlow, saved searches, custom records, and SuiteScript as appropriate.
  • Automate manual processes and close operational gaps while balancing business needs with long-term system maintainability.
  • Prototype quickly, iterate based on feedback, and measure whether changes produce meaningful improvements.
  • Evaluate whether a problem is best solved through configuration, automation, process redesign, or a combination of all three.

Partner with the Business

  • Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, and Operations to understand how work actually gets done – not simply how documented processes say it should happen.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business needs into practical, scalable system solutions.
  • Bring sound judgment to solution design, including challenging requests when a process change is more appropriate than another customization.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate the monthly and quarterly close, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.
  • Build strong relationships with system users and become a trusted advisor on how NetSuite can support the business.

Own Data, Reporting, and Analytics

  • Build and maintain saved searches, reports, dashboards, and KPIs that provide Finance and leadership with reliable, actionable information.
  • Own data integrity across the platform, including reconciliations, imports, data cleanup, and ongoing data-quality standards.
  • Establish practices that ensure NetSuite data remains accurate, consistent, and fit for downstream reporting and analytics.
  • Provide clean, well-structured data to downstream BI and data-warehouse platforms as applicable.

Own Integrations

  • Maintain and improve integrations between NetSuite and the broader technology ecosystem, including CRM, expense, procurement, billing, payroll, banking, and data-warehouse platforms.
  • Monitor integration health, troubleshoot issues, and identify opportunities to improve reliability and scalability.
  • Work with existing vendors to maintain existing integrations and develop new capabilities as the business grows.
  • Partner with internal and external technical resources when integrations require specialized development or support.

Govern, Document, and Enable

  • Maintain SOX-relevant controls, audit trails, and segregation-of-duties standards (if applicable).
  • Document key configurations, processes, integrations, and system decisions so the environment remains understandable and maintainable.
  • Establish appropriate change-management and testing practices for production changes.
  • Provide training, documentation, and enablement to help Finance and other teams get more value from NetSuite.
  • Serve as the internal subject-matter expert and primary point of escalation for NetSuite-related questions and issues.

Operating Principles

AI-Native by Default

You instinctively look for ways AI can make you faster and more effective. You use AI tools to draft and debug SuiteScript, analyze datasets, generate documentation, investigate configuration issues, and work through complex problems. You experiment with NetSuite's native AI and automation capabilities as well as external AI tools, and you're constantly looking for the next manual task that can be automated.

Curious and Eager to Learn

NetSuite is deep, complex, and constantly evolving. You enjoy learning how the platform works and staying current with new capabilities, releases, and best practices.

Autonomous and High-Judgment

You can take an initiative from discovery through design, development, testing, rollout, and adoption without needing someone to define every next step. You bring judgment and ownership, not just execution.

Comfortable in Ambiguity

You don't need perfect requirements to get started. You're comfortable sitting with the people doing the work, asking questions, investigating edge cases, and finding the improvement underneath the problem.

Practical and Outcome-Oriented

You care less about making the system look sophisticated and more about making the business work better. You measure success by reduced manual effort, better data, faster processes, fewer errors, and a better experience for the people using the system.

What You Bring — Must-Haves

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, FinTech, or related field required.
  • Equivalent practical experience with NetSuite, financial systems, and business applications will be considered in lieu of a degree.

Experience

  • 6+ years of experience administering NetSuite in a finance or accounting environment, ideally including OneWorld / multi-subsidiary.
  • Strong command of NetSuite configuration, including SuiteFlow, saved searches, custom records and fields, forms, roles and permissions, and reporting.
  • Solid understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including GL, AP, AR, and the monthly/quarterly close, and how those processes map to NetSuite.
  • Demonstrated ability to own improvement initiatives end to end – from stakeholder discovery and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and adoption.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to distinguish between problems that require technology and problems that require process change.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and a genuine curiosity about how the business works.
  • Fluency with AI tools and demonstrated examples of using them to improve productivity, problem-solving, automation, or system development.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • SuiteScript (JavaScript) development experience.
  • NetSuite certification, such as SuiteFoundation, Administrator, or ERP Consultant.
  • Experience integrating NetSuite with BI or data-warehouse platforms.
  • Experience leading or supporting a NetSuite implementation, subsidiary rollout, major upgrade, or significant transformation.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

You understand our NetSuite environment, finance processes, close cycle, integrations, and biggest sources of manual effort. You have established relationships with key stakeholders and identified the highest-value opportunities for improvement.

By 6 Months

You've delivered several meaningful improvements, reduced manual work in key processes, and established a prioritized, credible roadmap for the platform.

By 12 Months

NetSuite is measurably doing more of the work than it was when you started: fewer manual steps, cleaner and more reliable data, stronger controls, better reporting, and a faster, less painful close.

Why Join Us?

Join a growing organization where finance is a strategic business partner. As a Sr. NetSuite Administrator, you will have ownership without people management. You'll have the autonomy to shape how our finance systems operate, the opportunity to work directly with the business, and the mandate to continuously improve the platform rather than simply keep it running. You’ll play a key role in ensuring financial accuracy, strengthening operational processes, and developing high-performing teams. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives while building scalable revenue accounting operations that support long-term growth.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for long periods of time, use hands to type, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Prefer candidates who can type at least 35 words per minute with 97% accuracy.

  • Although very minimal, flexibility to travel as needed is preferred.

  • This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc.

Why Work for Valeris?

We’re committed to supporting the well-being and success of our team members. As part of our organization, full-time employees can expect:

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans, including HSA- and FSA-eligible options, with Valeris contributing toward premium costs

  • Additional health support, including telehealth and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services

  • Company match on Health Savings Account contributions

  • Free Basic Life and AD&D coverage equal to your annual earnings, with a minimum of $50,000 and a maximum of $300,000

  • Company-paid Short-Term Disability coverage, with the option to purchase Long-Term Disability

  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% match on the first 5% you contribute, with immediate vesting

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave to support work-life balance

  • Team members receive nine paid holidays plus two floating holidays

  • Opportunities for advancement in a company that supports personal and professional growth

  • A challenging, stimulating work environment that encourages new ideas

  • Work for a company that values diversity and makes deliberate efforts to create an inclusive workplace

  • A mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work makes a meaningful impact

Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and, depending on the position, a drug screen in accordance with company standards. Please note that this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or activities associated with the position. Responsibilities and tasks may be modified at any time, with or without notice.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Valeris, we don’t just accept difference – we celebrate it, support it and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. Valeris is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Controller Job Description

Company: Pro Coffee Gear
Location: Remote (Global)
Employment Type: Full-time

About Us

Pro Coffee Gear is a rapidly growing e-commerce company specializing in espresso machines and related parts. Our passion for coffee drives us to provide top-tier products and exceptional customer service to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. With a dedication to quality and innovation, we aim to elevate the coffee experience for our customers and become a leading authority in the industry. As a dynamic and diverse team, we value collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement, and we're committed to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Controller to join our leadership team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in financial management, reporting, and analysis, with the ability to drive financial strategy and provide executive-level insights to support business growth and decision-making.

Responsibilities

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Oversee all aspects of financial operations including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Payroll management
  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes with accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare and present comprehensive financial statements, management reports, and board-level presentations
  • Develop and maintain robust financial controls, policies, and procedures to ensure compliance and accuracy

Strategic Analysis & Planning

  • Provide strategic financial analysis and recommendations to executive leadership
  • Lead annual budgeting and forecasting processes, including variance analysis and performance metrics
  • Develop sophisticated financial models and pro forma analyses for business initiatives, product launches, and strategic investments
  • Conduct profitability analysis by product line, customer segment, and business unit

Systems Integration & Process Optimization

  • Ensure seamless integration of inventory management, e-commerce platforms, and payment systems with the general ledger
  • Lead ERP system optimization and financial system implementations
  • Drive process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Establish and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial dashboards

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, tax regulations, and reporting requirements
  • Oversee internal controls and SOX compliance (if applicable)
  • Identify and mitigate financial risks across the organization

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and mentor finance team members, fostering professional growth and development
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, sales, marketing, and executive teams
  • Provide financial training and support to non-finance departments

Requirements

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required
  • CPA certification strongly preferred

Experience

  • Minimum 7-10 years of progressive accounting and finance experience
