Technical Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, and financial modeling
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (NetSuite, QuickBooks Enterprise, SAP, etc.)
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems
  • Strong understanding of business intelligence and reporting tools

Core Competencies

  • Deep understanding of US GAAP and IFRS accounting principles
  • Comprehensive knowledge of US tax system, regulations, and reporting deadlines
  • Proven track record of successful month-end and year-end close processes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail
  • Experience in process improvement and change management
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for executive-level reporting

Work Requirements

  • Must align with Central Time business hours for collaboration with US-based team
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, remote environment with minimal supervision
  • Strong project management skills and ability to handle multiple priorities

Benefits

  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding company
  • Remote work with flexible hours, allowing for healthy work-life balance
  • Goal-oriented work culture providing autonomy and opportunities for personal and professional development

If you're an experienced finance leader with a passion for driving business growth and a love for coffee, we want to hear from you! jobs.excerpt: At Feeld, we are creating a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.
jobs.description:
At Feeld, we are creating a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves. We are building an inclusive, human-centred product and are looking for a Product Manager to become part our remote team and our mission to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships.

You will be responsible for driving the Web product roadmap at Feeld, helping more prospective members understand the value of Feeld and successfully move from web to app.

To be right for this role, you should have experience owning and delivering web product experiences, ideally in a consumer or growth-focused environment. You’ll be comfortable working autonomously, using data to make decisions, and partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Marketing and other stakeholders to move quickly from opportunity to impact.

This is a part-time (3 days per week) and fixed term contract position (6 months).

Applications for this role will close on 19 October 2026.

What you will do:

  • Own the day-to-day product management of Feeld’s Web roadmap and backlog
  • Translate strategic priorities and growth opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design throughout discovery and delivery to define the right solution and scope
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion across the journey from landing on Feeld’s website through to installing and joining the app
  • Work with Data to understand funnel performance, identify opportunities and establish clear success measures
  • Develop and run experiments to improve conversion, engagement and overall web performance
  • Partner with SEO, Brand and Marketing teams to ensure web experiences support acquisition campaigns, organic growth and the evolving Feeld brand
  • Maintain a clear and prioritised backlog, balancing new opportunities, optimisation, bugs and technical improvements
  • Manage dependencies, risks and trade-offs, ensuring stakeholders have visibility of progress and decisions
  • Define launch plans, monitor performance after release and use learnings to inform subsequent iterations

Requirements

About you:

  • You have good Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and delivering web products or experiences
  • You have worked on consumer-facing products, ideally in a growth, marketplace, subscription or app-led environment
  • You have experience improving conversion funnels through experimentation, optimisation and data-informed decision-making
  • You are comfortable working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing and other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes
  • You have experience operating autonomously in fast-moving environments, quickly building context and turning opportunities into clear priorities and shipped work

Benefits

About us:

Feeld is an independent, experimental and fully remote organisation reshaping the dialogue on dating and sexuality. The company was founded in 2014 and has evolved since to become the open, distributed structure it is now. We have a naturally agile and fluid culture. The whole team is fully remote, which means you work where and when helps you perform at your best. We regard autonomy highly and treat our organisation as a product – we iterate, improve and test things internally to see what works best for everyone.

Our culture:

We believe in creating a safe work environment through humanity, fluidity, safety, transparency and progressiveness. When hiring, we look for culture add rather than culture fit.

Because we are a fully remote team, it’s especially important that we create an environment where our colleagues feel included and connected as humans.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging at Feeld:

Feeld promotes open-mindedness, inclusion, diversity and kindness, both in the world and among our own workforce.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with a history of marginalisation, whether because of race, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, national origin, disability (seen or unseen) or any confluence of intersectional identities.

Our goal is a barrier-free application process and working environment. If you require further details or assistance or have any questions about this process, please let us know at .

Compensation and perks:

We are conscious of how our work and decisions impact other humans and the environment. We design our product and organisation with consideration for the wellbeing of our Members and colleagues. Feeld’s way of working is designed to proactively prevent burnout and an “always on” culture. We believe in technology and working environments that enable people to live a meaningful, fulfilled life.

Therefore, we offer our staff:

  • Flexible working hours
  • A fully remote working situation
  • On demand therapy sessions and mental health support via Spill

Our compensation system is one of the ways we work to uphold equity and inclusion at Feeld. Just as we strive to enable honest expression on our platform, we strive for openness of information within the organization. Internally, we keep decision-making transparent to keep each other accountable and make sure all voices are heard. That is why we offer a compensation system that is transparent, honest, and equitable. Additionally, we believe all humans deserve to earn a competitive wage, so we offer a Baseline Freedom Salary of £60,000 GBP per year for any role that indexes below £60,000 GBP per year.

This is a part-time (3 days per week) and fixed term contract position (6 months).

  • Total cash compensation for this role varies by geographic location. We estimate the market-competitive compensation range for this position to be £650 GBP per day.

Our interview process:

  • Your first conversation with Feeld will be a screening call with our recruiter, where you’ll be able to ask - and receive answers - regarding any general questions you have and to confirm the role is a fit for what you’re seeking.
  • Your second conversation will connect you directly with the hiring manager for the role you’re applying to. Here, you’ll have a chance to ask more questions about the work you’ll be doing. This conversation will also focus on your past work experiences.
  • The next step for most of our roles is a candidate challenge. This is an evaluation of the skills relevant to be successful in this role and generally takes about an hour to complete.
  • Your third conversation allows you the opportunity to meet the team members you might be working with on a daily basis. Here, you’ll be able to ask questions about team processes, workflow, and the employee experience at Feeld.
  • We generally make an offer within 2 weeks of our final call, and offer a flexible start date that can begin as early as the next Monday after you sign our offer documentation.
  • Of note: all of our interviews are conducted remotely, and our interviewers will work with you to find an agreeable interview time based on mutual availability.

We understand we're asking you to invest your time and best efforts in our process, and are appreciative of getting the chance to better know who you are as a person and candidate. In return, we’re committed to offering transparent communication and prompt feedback as you navigate this application with us.

Applications for this role will close on 19 October 2026.

To find out more about Feeld, download our app (available on iOS and Android).

The Opportunity:


CACI’s growing Agile Digital Solutions Operating Group is searching for SAP Materials Management (MM) Functional Analyst supporting the modernization and transformation of a large portfolio of enterprise business solutions used by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). The candidate will be part of a team where complex problem solving, and communication skills are critical to success.

Responsibilities:
The analyst will work closely with NASA stakeholders, process owners, and cross functional SAP teams to ensure the accurate transformation of ECC Materials Management processes into the S/4HANA Universal Journal and enhanced Materials Management (MM) architecture. Selected candidate(s) will:
• Review NASA’s current ECC Materials Management (MM) and G-Invoicing business processes during As‑Is workshops.
• Participate in To‑Be Design Workshops to validate and refine future-state Materials Management (MM) and G-Invoicing processes.
• Document deltas, decisions, business impacts, and functional requirements.
• Support creation of the Materials Management (MM) and G-Invoicing portion of the functional backlog (MVP and BPR).
• Identify required simplifications or remediations related to SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) and the Universal Journal (ACDOCA).
• Conduct Fit‑Gap analysis for all MM processes (Purchasing, Goods Receipts, Materials, etc.).
• Document functional gaps in alignment with NCAPS workshop outputs.
• Create or contribute to Functional Design Specifications (FDS) for MM-related configuration changes, enhancements, interfaces, and reporting.
• Ensure MM functional requirements integrate properly with Controlling, Funds Management, Property Management, and Projects.
• Support identification of MM Data and Transactional Data objects relevant to migration.
• Collaborate with data teams to define extraction rules, mapping logic, and transformation requirements for migrating to S/4.
• Review and validate Data Profiling results for MM (data quality, consistency, missing fields).
• Confirm To‑Be data standards and support creation of data mapping specifications.
• Participate in mock conversion reviews to validate functional correctness of migrated data.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • 5+ years experience as an SAP Functional Analyst in Materials Management (MM).
    · Hands-on configuration experience in ECC MM (Purchasing, Goods Receipts, Materials, etc.).
    · Strong knowledge of end-to-end MM processes: Procure to Pay.
    · Experience participating in workshops, Fit‑Gap sessions, and functional design activities.
    · Familiarity with SAP data migration concepts, especially for Master Data and Transactional Data.
    · Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to pass NASA Public Trust background investigation.
    · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management Systems or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
    · Experience extending SAP standard functionality using ABAP Objects and other modern SAP technologies.
    Desired:
    • Experience with G-Invoicing implementation and support.
    • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting and the Universal Journal (ACDOCA).
    • Familiarity with S/4 Fiori applications for Materials Management.
    • Experience in federal government or public sector SAP environments.
    • Experience participating in S/4 migration projects (greenfield, brownfield, SDT).
    • SAP Certification preferred
    • SAFe experience and/or certification



-

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

ROLE OVERVIEW


The Manager, Reputation & Consumer Insights leads the organization’s reputation management and consumer insights programs, helping strengthen brand trust and inform enterprise decision-making. Reporting to the Director of Brand Strategy & Partnerships, this role oversees ratings, reviews, consumer feedback, and online sentiment across owned, earned, and shared platforms; manages agency and technology partners; and translates quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable recommendations. The Manager partners closely with HR, Clinician Services, Customer Care, the Enterprise Contact Center, Business Development, Communications, Operations, and other stakeholders to identify emerging trends, address reputation risks, and improve the consumer experience. Success in this role requires strong analytical and communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence while connecting consumer perceptions to brand strategy and business priorities.


Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES

  • Lead the organization’s reputation management program across owned, earned, and shared platforms, including ratings, reviews, consumer feedback, and online sentiment.
  • Oversee reputation management systems, tools, workflows, response standards, and escalation protocols.
  • Analyze ratings, reviews, surveys, social listening, and consumer research to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Translate quantitative and qualitative findings into actionable recommendations that strengthen brand trust, consumer experience, and business performance.
  • Develop dashboards and executive-ready reporting on reputation performance, consumer sentiment, and emerging themes.
  • Manage relationships with reputation management, research, analytics, and technology partners, ensuring high-quality deliverables, strategic insights, and measurable results.
  • Partner with HR, Clinician Services, Customer Care, the Enterprise Contact Center, Business Development, Communications, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to address reputation and consumer-experience opportunities.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives through influence, establishing shared accountability for reputation outcomes and consumer-experience improvements.
  • Provide insights to the Director of Brand Strategy & Partnerships that inform brand strategy, positioning, messaging, governance, creative development, and audience priorities.
  • Identify gaps between the intended brand experience and actual consumer perceptions, recommending actions to strengthen awareness, trust, preference, and consistency.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, market research, consumer insights, business, analytics, social sciences, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in reputation management, consumer insights, market research, customer experience, brand strategy, communications, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience managing ratings and reviews, online reputation, social listening, consumer feedback, or voice-of-the-customer programs.
  • Experience analyzing quantitative and qualitative data and translating findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Proven experience managing external agencies, research partners, vendors, or technology platforms.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex or sensitive findings to executive and cross-functional audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, build alignment, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong project management, critical-thinking, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively within a complex, highly matrixed organization.

  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.excerpt: At peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive.
jobs.description:
At peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive. As part of our Employer Group, we work with a variety of forward-thinking partners and are excited to share this opportunity that sits within our growing group.

Role Overview

This opportunity is for a practising AI engineering professional to bring current industry experience into a career-focused learning environment. The role supports learners developing production-ready AI engineering capability, with a particular focus on LLM-based application engineering, real-world engineering practice, career development, and industry context.

The Industry Mentor works alongside academic tutors while maintaining a distinct remit. Academic teaching, assessment, grading, and academic standards sit outside this role. The mentor focuses on connecting technical learning to how AI systems are built, operated, evaluated, governed, and hired for in industry today.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated professional software engineering experience with hands-on involvement in building and operating LLM-based systems in production.
  • Current professional experience in a role such as AI Engineer, AI Application Engineer, Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, Architect, or AI Engineering Consultant.
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs, function calling, RAG, retrieval design, agent architectures, evaluation approaches, and cost or latency optimisation.
  • Strong production engineering fundamentals, including testing, CI/CD, containerisation, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI in practical deployment environments, including governance, auditability, bias assessment, human oversight, and regulatory considerations.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, including an understanding of common failure modes and approaches for verifying AI-generated code.
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to people with different levels of technical experience.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, mentoring, and relationship-building skills, with the judgement to guide learners through uncertainty rather than provide overly prescriptive answers.
  • Comfort working with online learning and communication technologies.
  • Previous teaching, mentoring, facilitation, or online learning experience is desirable.
  • A master's degree is desirable but not essential.

    Key Responsibilities
  • Facilitate online community discussions that connect weekly technical learning and build activities to real-world AI engineering practice.
  • Design and deliver three 60-minute live industry sessions focused on the practical application of topics covered in the learning content.
  • Provide structured 30-minute one-to-one sessions, through an agreed booking process, to support learners with industry context and career direction.
  • Share practical examples and lessons from building and operating LLM-based systems in production environments.
  • Support learners in understanding routes into AI engineering, employer expectations, portfolio credibility, and professional engineering practice.
  • Collaborate with relevant delivery colleagues to flag learner concerns, share learner feedback, and contribute observations on programme content and learner engagement.
  • Help learners connect technical topics including RAG, retrieval design, agent architectures, evaluation, monitoring, responsible AI, and production engineering to real workplace scenarios.
  • Adapt industry guidance to learners entering from different starting points, including career changers, experienced coders, and practising software engineers.
  • Maintain clear boundaries around academic assessment by avoiding grading, direct correction of assessed work, or step-by-step guidance on completing assessed tasks.

Benefits

  • Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.
  • Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute current industry knowledge to the development of emerging AI engineering professionals.
  • Flexible participation in a remote learning environment, subject to the requirements of the role.

Our Recruitment Process

The peopleworth Employer Group follows a fair, transparent, and multi-stage recruitment process designed to ensure mutual fit.

  1. Application Submission: Complete the online form and answer brief application questions.
  2. Initial Screening: Your application is reviewed for role alignment; successful candidates move to the longlist.
  3. Live Interviews: Shortlisted candidates join first-round interviews (and, where applicable, second or third rounds depending on the role).
  4. Final Shortlist & Verification: Reference and background checks are completed.
  5. Offer & Contracting: Successful candidates receive formal offers and contract documents.
  6. Pre-boarding & Onboarding: Once accepted, you’ll complete a pre-boarding process before officially joining your employing organisation within the Employer Group.

Throughout every stage, we value clear communication, respectful engagement, and timely feedback.

Executive Director GPO Delivery and Optimization

What you will be doing:

The Executive Director, Delivery and Optimization owns one of five GPO Delivery pods — a team of Delivery Managers, Delivery Directors, and Delivery Senior Directors — and is accountable for that pod's collective delivery performance across every assigned account. This is the most senior presence in GPO Delivery — someone who brings executive-level polish and structured thinking to connect the GPO contracting team, portfolio SMEs, analytics, and the rest of Premier to what member supply chain clients actually need, and who holds the team to a standard of execution, not activity. The Executive Director, Delivery and Optimization operates with autonomy, sets the bar for strategic guidance and executive presence across the pod, and is judged on the team's results: contract uptake, value realization, and client trust at scale.

Key Responsibilities


GPO Portfolio Delivery Ownership and Value Creation – 35%


  • Leads the pod's execution strategy across its full portfolio of accounts, managing complex, multi-account programs through the team while also managing their own accounts
  • Works with other pod leaders to develop consistency
  • Works with the various center of excellence to drive Premier Program and contract value.
  • Oversees contract performance management across every category and account in the pod, ensuring optimal utilization and value realization at scale
  • Leverages advanced data analysis — through Premier's technology, AI, and Power BI partnerships — to synthesize analytics into strategic recommendations at the portfolio level
  • Employs analytical storytelling to communicate findings and influence decision-making with member executives, physicians, and clinicians
  • Ensures every account within the pod completes an annual growth forecast and business review, incorporating results and recommended actions into pod-level planning
  • Holds the pod accountable for a regular cadence of complete member data submissions (PO, invoice, AP, capital plans, and other required data types) across every account, to support accurate analytics and GPO growth/penetration tracking
  • Ensures the pod leverages contract analytics from the MVE and other Premier analytics resources to model contracting scenarios — costs, behaviors, market share, and lower-cost alternatives — across every account

Supply Chain Relationship Management – 30%


  • Is the point of contact and quarterback for all GPO related activities
  • Acts of main point of contact for Supply Chain and Premier to navigate all aspects of the GPO and align member messaging
  • Cultivates strategic, trust-based relationships with the most senior member supply chain executives and other supply chain leaders across the pod's portfolio, aligning Premier's GPO portfolio to their long-term priorities
  • Leads strategic initiatives and facilitates executive-level discussions across the pod's accounts to align goals, resolve conflict, and identify new opportunities

People Leadership – 35%

Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager (UK & Europe), you will manage key accounts including Waitrose, Whole Foods, Holland & Barrett and selected distribution partners. You will take ownership of account performance, build strong customer relationships and identify opportunities to increase sales, profitability and distribution.

Based in Greater London, this is a remote, work-from-home role with occasional travel.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Manage and grow key grocery and distribution accounts, delivering against revenue, profit and distribution targets.

  • Develop, negotiate and deliver Joint Business Plans (JBPs) aligned with FIJI Water’s brand and sales strategy.

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across grocery retailers and distribution partners.

  • Negotiate commercial agreements, annual trade terms and promotional plans, balancing sales growth with profitability and return on investment.

  • Analyse account performance using Northstar, EPOS and other relevant data to identify opportunities for category and brand growth.

  • Work with global marketing to deliver in-store activations, point-of-sale campaigns and digital visibility.

  • Provide accurate forecasts and demand planning inputs to support stock availability and successful promotional execution.

  • Build strong relationships with retail buyers and key decision-makers.

  • Support the Regional Sales Manager with grocery and distributor strategy, customer presentations and quarterly business reviews.

  • Track competitor activity and category trends, turning insights into practical recommendations.

  • Collaborate with finance, supply chain and marketing teams to deliver against customer requirements.

What you’ll bring:

  • 3-5 years of FMCG commercial or account management experience, ideally within beverages, premium FMCG or health and wellness.

  • Strong knowledge of the UK grocery retail market, with experience managing Waitrose, Whole Foods or Holland & Barrett highly desirable.

  • Experience developing Joint Business Plans, negotiating commercial terms and managing annual trade agreements.

  • A commercial mindset, with the ability to identify growth opportunities and manage sales, margins and promotional investment.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn sales and category data into clear actions.

  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using data analysis tools such as Nielsen or IRI.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation and communication skills.

  • The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across teams.

  • A degree in Business, Marketing or a related field is preferred.

Our FIJI Water Contribution:

  • Competitive benefits package (salary plus bonus)
  • Opportunity for development and internal mobility
  • Wonderful Giving - allowing you to donate company money to a cause of your choice
  • Wonderful Neighbor - Staff spend a day in the community helping with various projects
  • Company focused on wellness and health

This is an exciting time to be a part of FIJI Water, as we transform our business to ensure we meet our customer’s needs. This role also offers growth and development opportunities that come with working for a large, global organisation. Join a team where innovation is encouraged, ideas are celebrated, and every drop of progress matters. You won’t just manage a territory – you will help to sustain a legacy!

EEO is the law - click here for more information

FIJI® Water, natural artesian water bottled at the source in Viti Levu (Fiji islands), is the #1 imported bottled water brand and the top selling premium bottled water in the United States. A product of one of the last virgin ecosystems on the planet, FIJI Water is bottled into iconic square bottles at the source from a vast underground chamber. Through a sealed delivery system free of human contact, FIJI Water is truly untouched, until you unscrew the cap.

FIJI Water is widely available at fine restaurants and hotels, all major retail channels including grocery and convenience, and through an innovative home delivery program. Following the success of the flagship U.S. business, FIJI Water has expanded to more than 75 countries, where the brand’s iconic square bottle is increasingly visible at leading on premise and retail establishments.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior AI Engineer
Location: Remote, USA
Clearance Required: Active Secret Clearance
Position Type: Full-Time

About the Company

At VivSoft, we aim to solve complex federal problems using emerging and open technologies in a collaborative and rewarding environment. VivSoft is a diverse team of strategists, engineers, designers, and creators experienced in building high-performance, effective software, with a focus on impactful organizational design and software delivery dynamics. We build secure Software Factories based on DoD reference designs and NIST Frameworks for Cloud and DevSecOps. These factories deliver AI/ML Applications, Data Science Platforms, Blockchain, and Microservices for DoD, Healthcare, and Civilian Agencies.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) solutions within complex, large-scale data environments. This role will focus on building distributed machine learning models, developing agentic AI workflows, and integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with enterprise data platforms to support predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in software engineering, data engineering, and applied AI/ML, with expertise in distributed computing, statistical modeling, and modern AI technologies. This individual will work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and cloud/platform engineering teams to develop scalable AI solutions, optimize model performance, and deploy AI/ML capabilities within secure and disconnected environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy distributed machine learning models using Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg, applying rigorous statistical validation and classical machine learning techniques where appropriate.
  • Build and implement agentic AI workflows using LLMs, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-step planning to query and analyze enterprise datasets.
  • Develop and optimize AI-driven data analysis workflows that leverage distributed query engines such as Amazon Athena, Trino, and Spark SQL.
  • Optimize agent-generated SQL queries through partition pruning, file layout awareness, query guardrails, and distributed query performance techniques.
  • Design, deploy, and maintain self-hosted AI/ML model-serving environments using Kubernetes, including deployments within disconnected or restricted network environments.
  • Develop and orchestrate automated model training, evaluation, and agent workflows using Apache Airflow, AWS services, and Kubernetes.
  • Leverage AWS technologies, including Amazon S3, EC2, and EMR, to support distributed AI/ML processing and deployment.
  • Evaluate LLM and AI agent outputs using structured test datasets, evaluation rubrics, regression testing, and performance metrics.
  • Monitor AI/ML solutions for model drift, performance degradation, and operational failure modes.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and cloud/platform engineers to integrate AI/ML models into production data pipelines and enterprise environments.
  • Apply responsible AI principles, including bias assessment, model transparency, data handling, and risk management.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture designs, operational runbooks, and implementation guidance.
  • Communicate model behavior, limitations, and technical risks to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Qualifications & Required Skills

  • Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, or machine learning, including at least 4 years of applied AI/ML experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. Additional relevant professional experience may substitute for education on a year-for-year basis.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and deploying distributed machine learning solutions using Apache Spark, including Spark MLlib, and lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg.
  • Strong statistical background, including probability, statistical inference, regression analysis, experimental design, and model evaluation.
  • Experience applying classical machine learning algorithms and techniques to large-scale datasets.
  • Hands-on experience designing and developing agentic AI workflows involving tool calling, MCP, and multi-step AI agents.
  • Experience working with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector databases.
  • Strong understanding of distributed SQL query engines, including Amazon Athena, Trino, and Spark SQL, with the ability to optimize AI-generated queries.
  • Experience deploying and serving AI/ML models in self-hosted or disconnected environments.
  • Strong programming experience with Python.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services, including S3, EC2, and EMR.
  • Experience deploying and managing applications or AI/ML workloads using Kubernetes.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary technical teams to deploy and operationalize AI/ML solutions.
  • Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts, model behavior, limitations, and technical risks to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring junior engineers.
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including bias, model evaluation, and secure data handling.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience developing MCP servers or working with established AI agent frameworks.
  • Experience implementing LLM evaluation frameworks, automated testing methodologies, and AI guardrails.
  • Advanced knowledge of Apache Iceberg architecture and internals.
  • Experience working with AWS Glue Data Catalog.
  • Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Prior experience supporting federal or DoD AI/ML programs.
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable AI/ML solutions in secure, highly regulated environments.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (Flexible/Combined PTO, Bereavement Leave, 11 Company Paid Holidays)
  • 401K Retirement Plan with employer match
  • Professional Development Training Reimbursement

  • Virtually reviewing and updating patient medical histories, including medication lists, immunization records, and family history.
  • Assessing patients’ current health status, including vital signs when available, cognitive function, and risk factors for chronic diseases, utilizing remote monitoring tools when applicable.
  • Providing patient education on preventive measures, lifestyle changes, and available community resources to promote overall health and well-being through virtual consultations.
  • Developing and updating personalized prevention plans based on individual patient needs and physician guidance.
  • Collaborating with the supervising physician to ensure accurate documentation and follow-up on any identified health concerns using electronic health record systems.

  • Facilitating virtual referrals to appropriate healthcare services and specialists as needed.
  • Monitoring patient progress and adherence to personalized prevention plans, providing support and making adjustments as necessary through telehealth follow-ups.

  • Must be located in GA.
  • Current and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of GA.
  • Availability for PRN work Monday through Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm, aproxametly 20 hours per week.

jobs.excerpt: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure.
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Senior Compliance & Investigations Counsel to join our team. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Compliance and Responsibility, you will take ownership of building our legal investigations function while advancing critical compliance activities, from partner risk management to our training and awareness efforts. This is a key role on a growing team with a mission to embed integrity across our global operations. The position can be hybrid at our Santa Clara, CA headquarters or fully remote in the US.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Build our legal investigations function by collaborating closely with key stakeholders in our Finance and People & Culture teams to fine-tune investigation procedures and identify use cases for technology and AI to drive greater transparency, efficiency, robustness and awareness among employees, senior management and the Board
  • Take ownership of embedding our “speak up” & “listen up” values more deeply into our corporate culture while ensuring compliance with requirements of evolving global whistleblower laws and regulations
  • Manage the day-to-day operation and governance of our AI-enabled channel partner due diligence program, build additional analytics capabilities to monitor channel partner risk, and collaborate closely with our partners team to efficiently address legal compliance risks that may arise as the enterprise channel partner program continues to grow
  • Oversee and drive continuous improvement of our controls around gifts & business courtesies and conflicts of interest, including by fine-tuning how we utilize our compliance technology and developing of training and guidance approaches that optimize employee awareness
  • Revolutionize our formal training and awareness program to better measure and maximize impact while addressing concerns created by legacy approaches (such as learner seat time and administrative burden)

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner with a strong bias for action, operating with integrity and seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders and anchoring decisions in solving real-world problems.
  • You are driven by innovation, bringing curiosity to complex technical challenges and leveraging technology to build secure, scalable solutions.
  • You are resilient and adaptable, maintaining composure in high-pressure situations and guiding teams through complexity with a steady hand.
  • You champion simplicity by distilling complex regulatory and technical concepts into clear, actionable plans and precise communication.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 7+ years practicing as an attorney with significant experience in corporate investigations and demonstrated expertise in anti-corruption law and practice
  • Demonstrated experience in designing investigations or other compliance processes and implementing them using technology solutions
  • Deep familiarity with the theory and practice of driving compliance within large corporate organizations and proficiency in global legal regimes addressing legal compliance obligations
  • Basic familiarity with business processes relevant to public technology companies, including channel sales, financial and other reporting, procurement processes, systems development and maintenance, and talent acquisition and management
  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • A blend of experience working for either a law firm or as a government prosecutor and in an in-house role, preferably for a technology company
  • Subject matter expertise or demonstrated proficiency in competition law, fraud, conflicts of interest, AI governance, government procurement or contracting regulations or related compliance areas
  • Proven ability to provide pragmatic, risk-calibrated legal advice that aligns with the commercial goals and operational realities of a fast-paced, publicly-traded technology company
  • Demonstrated history of integrating AI tools to enhance legal workflows and compliance monitoring

The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of public accounting and public company experience, with expertise in U.S. GAAP, audit readiness, and leading remote teams.

Primary Job Duties:

Financial Operations & Close Management

  • Direct month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close routines to ensure accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements and reconciliations.
  • Oversee the review of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules across business units.
  • Partner with FP&A on budget-to-actual variance analyses and operational reporting to deliver actionable insights.
  • Lead financial integration activities for mergers and acquisitions (M&A) to ensure seamless onboarding and accounting alignment.
  • Direct or assist with specialized initiatives and projects as needed, demonstrating strong project management capabilities and a focus on enhancing operational processes.

  • Provide technical accounting guidance on complex transactions, including purchase accounting (ASC 805), revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), and new accounting standards.
  • Oversee the preparation of supporting accounting data, reconciliations, schedules, and technical input for SEC filings (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K) prepared by the Financial Reporting team.
  • Maintain and monitor the company’s internal controls framework to ensure full SOX 404 compliance.
  • Serve as a key liaison for external auditors, managing audit schedules, requests, and issue resolution.

•Systems, Transformation & Process Improvement

  • Serve as the functional finance lead for the upcoming ERP transition, assisting with chart of accounts design, data migration, user acceptance testing (UAT), and workflow design.
  • Identify and execute automation opportunities across existing financial software to streamline close cycles and operational routines.

•Treasury Operations

  • Support operational treasury functions, including banking relationships, electronic fund transfers (ACH/wires), account structure administration, and positive pay management.

•Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, mentor, and foster accountability across a fully remote accounting team.
  • Establish clear performance goals to foster continuous development and cross-functional alignment.

• Specialized Skills: Direct experience with enterprise ERP implementations, income tax provision oversight, or corporate treasury operations highly preferred.

jobs.description:
Performance and Resiliency Engineering Lead, Merchant Services (Senior Vice President or Executive Director)

Merchant Services is hiring an SVP/ED Performance & Resiliency Engineer to improve the performance and stability of critical, high-volume platforms. The role focuses on latency reduction, throughput/TPS improvements, capacity planning, and peak-event readiness, while also strengthening resiliency and release safety.

You will partner closely with application development teams and infrastructure/platform engineering to identify bottlenecks across the stack (application/runtime, database, network, compute, and platform), implement durable fixes, and raise engineering standards through technical leadership, mentorship, and strong cross-team collaboration.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead performance engineering efforts: load/stress/soak testing, capacity modeling, performance tuning, and regression prevention (KPIs, guardrails, and acceptance criteria).
  • Improve production readiness: observability (metrics/logs/traces/APM), actionable alerting, incident triage, and root-cause analysis leading to durable remediation.
  • Strengthen resiliency patterns: timeouts/retries, circuit breakers, backpressure/rate limiting, graceful degradation, and failover readiness.
  • Drive safer releases via canary/progressive delivery and automated rollback patterns.
  • Optimize containerized workloads across EKS (primary) and ECS/other compute where applicable; drive autoscaling strategy and right-sizing.

Qualifications

  • Senior experience in performance engineering for distributed systems and/or SRE-style reliability engineering in production.
  • Strong cloud/container background (AWS + Kubernetes/EKS; ECS exposure beneficial).
  • Experience with modern observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Dynatrace, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch or equivalent).
  • KEDA and/or Karpenter: large plus.
  • Akamai: strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, and work effectively across teams.

SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.

The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.

Responsibilities:

  • Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.
  • Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.
  • Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.
  • Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.
  • Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.
  • Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.
  • Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.
  • Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

  • 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.
  • Understanding of banking data environment.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.
  • Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.
  • Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.
  • In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.
  • Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

About MedReview

MedReview is a leading provider of payment integrity solutions that help national and regional health plans promote population health, ensure payment accuracy, reduce administrative waste, improve provider relationships, and optimize financial performance. The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Vice President of Account Management to build and lead MedReview’s Account Management function. This leader will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the Account Management team, direct oversight of MedReview’s most strategic client relationships, and development of account strategies that improve retention, client satisfaction, and revenue growth. The Vice President will create a consistent, consultative approach to account management and serve as the primary escalation point between clients and MedReview.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management Leadership
  • Build and lead a high-performing Account Management team with clear roles, coverage models, service standards, and performance expectations.
  • Develop and implement consistent account management processes, tools, meeting cadences, and documentation standards.
  • Coach Account Managers on strategic relationship management, executive communication, issue resolution, and commercial growth.
  • Establish portfolio-level visibility into client health, retention risk, growth opportunities, and profitability.
  • Promote accountability for timely follow-up, accurate communication, and coordinated client support.
Strategic Client Relationship Management
  • Serve as the senior relationship leader for MedReview’s largest and most strategic accounts, including key national health plan relationships.
  • Build trusted relationships with client executives, operational leaders, and key decision-makers.
  • Develop and execute client strategies that support retention, satisfaction, and long-term growth.
  • Lead internal portfolio reviews and ensure Account Managers deliver effective client-facing business reviews.
  • Act as the first senior escalation point for client issues, service concerns, and relationship risks.
Retention and Account Growth
  • Lead account planning to identify cross-sell, upsell, and new-solution opportunities within existing clients.
  • Partner with Business Development, Product, Operations, and senior leaders to evaluate and prioritize expansion opportunities.
  • Support new-client acquisition by contributing client insight, solution positioning, and relationship continuity during the sales process.
  • Develop retention plans for at-risk accounts and proactively address competitive threats.
  • Develop and track key metrics to assess overall account health, including growth, retention, client satisfaction, profitability, and opportunity conversion.
  • Develop and track performance metrics and KPIs to measure the effectiveness and success of the Account Management team.
  • Own adherence to client SLAs, ensuring service commitments and performance standards are consistently met.
Client Delivery and Commercial Coordination
  • Partner closely with Operations to support delivery excellence and positive client outcomes.
  • Negotiate service level agreements in partnership with appropriate internal leaders and ensure Account Managers monitor performance.
  • Coordinate resolution of claims aging, recovery execution, payment, and other issues that may affect client value or MedReview revenue.
  • Ensure the Account Management team serves as the central point of coordination between clients and MedReview.
  • Support effective implementation and transition of new clients, products, and services.
Voice of the Customer
  • Bring client feedback, market intelligence, and emerging needs into internal planning and decision-making.
  • Partner with Product Development and Operations to improve solutions, client experience, and competitive differentiation.
  • Champion a consultative approach focused on client outcomes and measurable value.
  • Identify common themes across accounts and recommend enterprise-level improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in healthcare Account Management, client success, payment integrity, managed care, revenue cycle, healthcare technology, or a related field, including significant leadership experience.
  • Proven success by retaining and expanding large, complex healthcare accounts.
  • Experience building or significantly improving an Account Management or client success function.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare payment integrity, claims operations, payer-provider dynamics, reimbursement methodologies, and service delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage executive client relationships, negotiate effectively, and resolve complex issues.
  • Experience developing account plans, leading business reviews, managing client health metrics, and driving cross-sell and upsell activity.
  • Polished, articulate communicator with strong executive presence and sound judgment.
  • Ability to work effectively across a matrixed organization and hold teams accountable without direct authority.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience supporting national health plans and large, complex payer organizations.
  • Experience with technology, SaaS, or data-enabled healthcare solutions.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 to 24 months, this leader will:
  • Build a clearly defined and scalable Account Management function.
  • Strengthen relationships with MedReview’s largest and most strategic clients.
  • Improve retention, satisfaction, and executive engagement across the client portfolio.
  • Implement consistent account planning, client health, escalation, and business review processes.
  • Develop a qualified pipeline of cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Improve coordination among Account Management, Operations, Product, Finance, and implementation teams.
  • Establish a high-performing team with clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.

At Mixpanel, we believe design excellence is a competitive moat. In a world where AI makes it easier than ever to ship, we believe the quality of the experience — how it feels, how it builds trust, how it handles complexity with grace — that separates good products from great ones.

As a Staff Design Engineer at Mixpanel, you'll sit within the design organization and lead the transformation of our design system from a component library into something far more important: the infrastructure that powers how we design, build, and ship in an AI-native world. You'll encode our craft, standards, and vision directly into the systems, tools, and workflows that every designer, engineer, and AI agent in our org builds on.

You'll work at the frontier of what design and engineering collaboration looks like when AI writes most of the code, agents prototype from intent, and the design system is less a library and more a living foundation for everything we ship.

You'll be the designer who ships production code. The engineer who holds an uncompromising craft bar. The person who sees the future of how Mixpanel will look and behave in an AI-native world, and builds the infrastructure to make it real.

Build the infrastructure for an AI-native design practice

jobs.title: Mapping and Analysis of Family Language in African Union Agreed Language and Hum
jobs.excerpt: 1.  BackgroundFòs Feminista.  Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people.
jobs.description:
1. Background

Fòs Feminista. Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. In 2026, Fòs Feminista completed a three-decade mapping of how "family" has been used in United Nations agreed language — reviewing 1,441 excerpts across 180 UN documents from 1994 to 2025. That mapping found that a substantial, underused body of UN agreed language already centers individual rights, gender equality, and diverse family forms, offering feminist advocates a propositional foundation to build on rather than only a defensive posture against anti-rights mobilization around "family."

This mapping has not yet been extended to the regional level. The African Union (AU) has its own distinct body of human rights instruments, agreed language, and political dynamics relevant to family, gender equality, and SRHR — including the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (the Maputo Protocol), one of the most progressive regional instruments globally on women’s rights, alongside AU mechanisms with an active record on ending child marriage and other harmful practices. At the same time, the AU is not insulated from anti-rights and anti-gender actors seeking to co-opt family language in multilateral outcomes.

As such, Fòs Feminista is seeking a consultant to conduct a systematic mapping and analysis of family-related language across African Union agreed language and human rights mechanisms to produce a rigorous, regionally grounded evidence base for use in African Union-level advocacy.

2. Purpose and Objectives

The purpose of this consultancy is to produce a systematic, evidence-based mapping of how "family" is defined, referenced, and used across African Union agreed language, in order to:

  • Identify where existing AU agreed language already reflects rights-based, gender-equal, and diverse understandings of family, distinguishing this from areas where family language is used restrictively or left unaddressed.
  • Produce a citable evidence base to inform feminist advocacy in African Union-level negotiations.
  • Identify patterns specific to the African regional context — including but not limited to child marriage, female genital mutilation and other harmful practices, inheritance and marital property rights, and care — grounded in the region’s own instruments and mechanisms.
  • Analyze whether language has changed over time, assessing whether it reflects advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and identifying the instruments, sessions or political context associated with such shifts.
  • Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for use in AU Summit declarations, Specialized Technical Committee outcomes, and other AU negotiating processes.

3. Scope of Work

The consultant will review family-related language across the following African Union instruments and mechanisms, at minimum:

  • The African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights (1981) and its jurisprudence.
  • The Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (Maputo Protocol, 2003), with particular attention to its marriage, family, and inheritance provisions.
  • The African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (1990).
  • Decisions, declarations, and resolutions of the AU Assembly of Heads of State and Government and the Executive Council.
  • Resolutions, General Comments, and Concluding Observations of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR).
  • General Comments and Concluding Observations of the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (ACERWC).
  • The Solemn Declaration on Gender Equality in Africa (2004) and subsequent AU gender policy instruments.
  • The Plan of Action on the Family in Africa (2004), adopted by the AU Assembly to mark the tenth anniversary of the International Year of the Family, and its 2010 mid-term review.
  • The Continental Policy Framework on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (2005, endorsed by the AU Assembly in January 2006) and the Maputo Plan of Action for its operationalization, including subsequent iterations (2007–2010 and the revised 2016–2030 Plan).
  • Outcome documents of relevant AU Specialized Technical Committees, including those on Health, Population and Drug Control; Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment; and Social Development, Labour and Employment.
  • Materials and declarations associated with the AU Campaign to End Child Marriage.
  • Agenda 2063 and associated flagship programmes, where family-related language appears.

The consultant, in consultation with Fòs Feminista, will propose a final document list and inclusion timeframe during the inception phase (see Section 5).

4. Specific Tasks

  • Review Fòs Feminista’s existing mapping and adapt methodology to the African Union context, in consultation with Fòs Feminista.
  • Define inclusion criteria, search terms, and a document timeframe appropriate to AU instruments, accounting for the African Union’s founding in 2002 and, where relevant, continuity with instruments of its predecessor, the Organisation of African Unity (OAU).
  • Systematically identify and retrieve relevant documents across the proposed mechanisms.
  • Extract all excerpts referencing family (and relevant equivalent terminology across the AU’s working languages, as feasible) into a structured, coded database.
  • Code excerpts thematically, drawing on categories established in the UN-level mapping, while remaining open to additional categories specific to the African regional context.
  • Assess the political and normative implications of each excerpt (positive, neutral, or negative) from a feminist, rights-based perspective, consistent with the coding logic used in the UN-level mapping.
  • Analyze how family-related language has evolved over the mapping period, identifying patterns of advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and the specific instruments, sessions, or political context associated with such shifts.
  • Draft a mapping report presenting findings, methodology, illustrative excerpts with full citations, and the trend analysis described above.
  • Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language formulations suited to AU negotiating contexts, grounded in specific cited instances of existing agreed language.
  • Provide updates and present final findings to Fòs Feminista and relevant partners.

5. Deliverables

  • Inception report, including proposed methodology, document list, inclusion criteria, and timeframe (due at the end of the inception phase).
  • A structured spreadsheet database of coded excerpts, consistent in format with Fòs Feminista’s existing UN-level mapping database (mechanism, document title, citation/symbol, date, page reference, excerpt text, and thematic codes).
  • A draft mapping and analysis report, for Fòs Feminista review and feedback. This should already include a set of concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for AU negotiating contexts, cross-referenced to specific cited excerpts.
  • A final mapping and analysis report incorporating feedback, including an executive summary suitable for external advocacy use.
  • A presentation of findings (virtual or in-person, to be agreed) to Fòs Feminista and partner organizations.

6. Indicative Timeline

The following is an indicative timeline of approximately 10 weeks; the final schedule will be confirmed with the selected consultant during contracting.

  • Weeks 1–2: Inception phase — methodology, document list, and workplan finalized.
  • Weeks 3–4: Document identification, retrieval, and excerpt extraction.
  • Weeks 4–6: Thematic coding and analysis.
  • Weeks 6–8: Draft mapping report submitted to and reviewed by Fòs Feminista.
  • Weeks 8–10: Revisions, finalization, and presentation of findings.

7. Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or higher) in law, human rights, gender studies, African studies, political science, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of African Union human rights mechanisms and regional legal and policy frameworks, including the Maputo Protocol.
  • Prior experience conducting legal, policy, or content analysis of agreed language, treaty text, or comparable normative documents.
  • Experience applying feminist or rights-based analytical frameworks to legal and policy texts.
  • Strong written communication skills in English; working proficiency in French, Arabic, and/or Portuguese is highly desirable given the African Union’s official languages.
  • Prior experience on gender equality, SRHR, or family law in the African regional context is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with qualitative data analysis tools (e.g., Dedoose, NVivo, or comparable software) is an asset.

8. Reporting and Supervision

The consultant will report to an assigned Senior Advocacy Officer and will maintain regular check-ins (proposed bi-weekly, to be confirmed) throughout the assignment to review progress against the agreed workplan.

9. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit the following by October 16, 2026:

  • A current CV or resume.
  • A cover letter outlining relevant experience and interest in the assignment.
  • A brief proposed methodology and workplan (no more than 3 pages), including any suggested adaptations to the approach described above.
  • A financial proposal, inclusive of a proposed daily or total consultancy rate.
  • A relevant writing sample (e.g., a legal or policy analysis, research report, or comparable output).

10. Budget

The total consultancy fee for this assignment is USD 6,000–7,000, inclusive of all costs. Candidates should submit a proposed budget within this range as part of their application; Fòs Feminista will confirm the final consultancy fee during contracting.

jobs.excerpt: About JamloopJamloop is building the next generation of performance-driven advertising for the streaming TV era.
jobs.description:
About Jamloop

Jamloop is building the next generation of performance-driven advertising for the streaming TV era.

We help brands and agencies turn CTV into a measurable, accountable growth channel, connecting advertising directly to real business outcomes, both online and offline. Our platform combines proprietary bidding, premium direct inventory, and advanced audience targeting to run high-performance CTV campaigns with precision.

We believe streaming TV advertising should do more than build awareness. It should drive business growth.

Jamloop is a lean, high-expectation team operating in a high-growth environment. The opportunity here is real: to build, shape, and scale alongside a company defining the future of performance advertising. Jamloop has also been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 500, AdExchanger Power Players, and the Stevie Awards for Tech Excellence.

Role Overview

    We’re hiring a Senior Sales Director (must be located in the United States) for Jamloop’s Large Customer team, which works directly with national brands investing $25K or more per month in CTV. These clients expect premium inventory, transparency, and measurable performance across the full funnel.

    This role owns new Large Customer business, from prospecting and relationship development through negotiation and close. In the near term, success comes from activating existing relationships, working a focused book of named accounts, and building a qualified pipeline. Over time, you’ll grow a portfolio of Large Customer clients and help shape the team’s go-to-market strategy.

    This is a hands-on, direct-to-brand hunter role that calls for an enterprise-level sales skill set. About 80% of your focus is Jamloop’s core customer profile: omnichannel and multi-store retailers with physical stores (company-owned, franchise, or both) plus online and other channels. The other 20% covers national brands that fit the Large Customer profile, including CPG, QSR, and DTC eCommerce. You’ll bring established relationships with retail marketing leaders and the ability to reframe CTV from a branding line item into a measurable driver of store traffic and sales. This is an individual contributor role.

What You'll Own

    Prospecting & New Business

  • Own the full sales cycle for Jamloop’s Performance CTV offering, selling directly to brands.

  • Focus roughly 80% of your effort on omnichannel and multi-store retailers, Jamloop’s core customer profile, and 20% on other qualifying national brands, including CPG, QSR, and DTC eCommerce.

  • Activate existing relationships to create opportunities with national brands.

  • Build and manage a book of 50–60 named accounts, at least 80% from the omnichannel retail target list, with account plans for your top accounts.

  • Convert qualified opportunities into new business, with an expectation of launching 8–10 new accounts annually once fully ramped.

    • Consultative Selling & Performance Strategy

  • Develop tailored sales narratives that connect CTV and cross-screen campaigns to customer acquisition, ROAS, incrementality, and other business KPIs.

  • Help prospective clients understand how ZIP- and store-level targeting, offline sales ingestion, incrementality (holdouts and geo-lift), and closed-loop attribution connect CTV to store traffic, online sales, and total sales lift.

  • Partner with internal teams to align proposed solutions with client objectives and measurement expectations.

  • Build trusted relationships with decision-makers through a consultative, outcomes-based approach.

  • Map and multi-thread each account’s buying committee, including the store and field marketing teams that often hold local and linear TV budgets.

  • Design pilots sized to produce a readable result, with realistic launch dates that allow time for paperwork and integration.

    • Sales Operations & Go-to-Market Collaboration

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, disciplined pipeline management, and complete, current CRM records, with deal stages that match paperwork status and launch dates that allow at least 30 days for paperwork and integration.

  • Partner with the GM/VP Sales, Product, Marketing, and RevOps to execute the Large Customer go-to-market strategy.

  • Share prospect and client feedback to inform positioning, product priorities, and the roadmap.

  • Represent Jamloop at conferences, client meetings, and industry events.

  • Partner with SDR and Marketing on account-based outreach to your named accounts, including CMO-level programs and retail conferences such as ShopTalk and eTail.

What You Bring

    Must-haves

  • 10+ years of digital media sales experience, with a proven record of closing and growing large national accounts directly with brands.

  • At least 1 year of experience selling Connected TV (could be bundled with other offerings).

  • Established relationships with marketing and media decision-makers at omnichannel and multi-store retailers, with a history of converting relationships into recurring revenue. Relationships across QSR, CPG, and DTC brands are a plus.

  • Deep knowledge of retail clients: how omnichannel and multi-store retailers are organized (CMO, digital, store and field marketing, analytics), how company-owned and franchise budgets work, and how performance and brand initiatives are planned across the retail calendar.

  • Experience with agencies (holding company and independent) and a strong understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including DSPs, private marketplaces, The Trade Desk, and CTV supply. This role sells direct, but many brands also work with an agency.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, grounded in a recognized methodology such as Challenger, SPIN, or MEDDICC, and the ability to connect media investment to measurable business outcomes.

  • A working understanding of identity resolution, closed-loop attribution, and device-graph-based measurement.

  • The ability to sell measurement: incrementality (holdouts and geo-lift), offline and store sales attribution, and store-level reporting.

  • Strong operational discipline, including CRM management, accurate forecasting, and accountability for pipeline performance.

  • The initiative to build new business and operate effectively in an evolving structure.

  • Experience collaborating across sales leadership, Product, Marketing, and revenue operations.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 20% for client meetings and industry events.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • Deeper experience selling performance-focused CTV or cross-screen advertising solutions.

  • Expertise in attribution, incrementality, and multi-touch attribution (MTA).

  • Experience helping build a new sales division or taking an emerging offering to market.

  • Experience working in a lean, high-growth advertising or technology company.

What Success Looks Like (Month 1-12)

    Month 1: Learn and plan

  • Complete product and measurement training, including in-dash incrementality, geo-lift, store-level reporting, and current case studies.

  • Take ownership of a book of 50–60 named accounts, at least 80% omnichannel retail.

  • Build account plans for your top 10–15 accounts, with buying committees mapped.

  • Activate your network and book first meetings through existing retail and brand relationships.

    • Months 2–3: Build pipeline

  • Touch 100% of your book within any 45-day window.

  • Book a steady cadence of qualified first meetings with decision-makers at top-tier accounts.

  • Deliver first proposals at $25K or more per month.

  • Keep at least 80% of your pipeline in omnichannel and multi-store retail.

    • Months 4–6: First launches

  • Launch your first one to two qualified accounts at $25K or more per month.

  • Build pipeline covering roughly three times the next two quarters’ target.

  • Design at least one store-level test with agreed measurement at a core retail account.

  • Multi-thread at least five accounts, including store or field marketing.

    • Months 7–9: Reach run rate

  • Launch two or more new brands per quarter.

  • Turn your first launch into a renewal or expansion conversation.

  • Keep forecasts accurate, with CRM records and launch dates current every week.

    • Months 10–12: Prove the model

  • Reach four to six new brand launches in year one, entering year two at a run rate of 8–10 per year.

  • Hit your year-one revenue target.

  • Deliver at least one retail result that can become a case study.

  • Have next-year account plans in place for your top accounts.

Benefits

    • Remote-first flexibility within the United States.

    • Health, dental, and vision benefits.

    • Direct access to executive leadership.

    • The opportunity to help shape Jamloop’s Large Customer go-to-market strategy and culture.

Compensation

  • Base salary: Commensurate with experience.

  • Commission: Uncapped commission with a 50/50 split between base salary and target commission.

  • Additional compensation: Meaningful accelerators and incentives for exceeding sales targets.

Undercover Tourist is the leader in family theme park and cruise vacations, engaging customers throughout the research, planning, and purchase journey. We specialize in theme park and attraction tickets, hotel and resort packages, and cruise e-commerce for premier destinations, combined with deep vacation planning content and best-in-class inbound marketing tools.
