This role can be remote in Orlando, Miami, or Austin, TX. Strong preference for this role to physically be in Austin, TX, where the Undercover Tourist team is headquartered.

This is a rare opportunity to join an established, high-growth e-commerce company experiencing significant momentum from recently launched new product categories. You'll have the autonomy to lead the entire marketing and content team along with strategic external creator partners, with full ownership of marketing strategy, budget, and P&L impact.

You'll work directly with the GM/Head of Undercover Tourist and cross-functional leadership to lead go-to-market strategy, drive customer acquisition and retention, and maintain and enhance Undercover Tourist as the undisputed leader in family theme park travel.

At Undercover Tourist, you get the 'best of both worlds': we're large enough to have resources and scale, but small enough that you'll have significant autonomy and make a direct, measurable impact on business outcomes. You'll think strategically while also rolling up your sleeves to execute. We're fun, driven, and passionate about helping families create unforgettable vacation experiences. We do this strategically by creating (free!) comprehensive Disney and theme park planning content to engage customers throughout their journey, paired with optimized theme park commerce and exceptional value when they are ready to purchase.

Essential Functions

Strategic Leadership & Business Impact (20%)

  • Own overall marketing strategy and annual planning aligned with company revenue, budgets and growth objectives

Performance Marketing & Revenue Growth (40%)

  • Explore and implement AI-driven tools to improve content production, campaign performance and customer engagement

Team Leadership & Organizational Development (20%)

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing marketing organization (currently 2 direct reports, 5 indirect reports)
  • Manage direct relationships with agency partners, freelancers, and strategic creator partners
  • Establish clear team goals, KPIs, and accountability frameworks; conduct regular performance reviews and development planning
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, data-driven decision making, continuous improvement, and customer focus

Brand, Content & Customer Experience (15%)

  • Oversee cohesive brand strategy and content roadmap that reinforces Undercover Tourist as the leader in theme park travel and exceptional customer value
  • Craft differentiated messaging and positioning; conduct competitive analysis to identify key differentiators and opportunities
  • Ensure brand consistency and customer experience excellence across all touchpoints (web, email, social, paid, events, partner channels)

Marketing Operations & Technology (5%)

  • Own marketing technology stack including UCT custom content admin, SMS platform, analytics (GA4, attribution tools), automation, and AI-powered tools
  • Evaluate and drive strategic adoption of martech solutions that improve team efficiency and campaign performance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, with demonstrated success owning marketing strategy, budget, and P&L in a direct-to-consumer and e-commerce environment.
  • Proven performance marketing expertise across paid social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), SEO, email, and SMS, with hands-on experience managing large-scale media budgets and optimizing for CPA and ROAS.
  • Deep experience building and managing creator and influencer programs, including partner identification, contract negotiation, campaign management, and ROI measurement.
  • Strong brand and content strategy instincts, with the ability to craft differentiated positioning and ensure brand consistency across all customer touchpoints in a highly competitive marketplace.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and inspire marketing teams, establishing clear accountability structures, coaching talent, and building a culture of data-driven experimentation.
  • Experience managing co-op marketing partnerships and negotiating joint promotional opportunities with major consumer brands or entertainment partners; familiarity with the theme park or travel industry is a strong plus.
  • Advanced analytical capability, comfortable with marketing attribution modeling, GA4, customer analytics, and performance reporting, with a track record of translating data into actionable strategy.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to think strategically and execute tactically; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment where autonomy and measurable impact go hand in hand.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience presenting marketing strategy and performance to senior leadership and external partners.

What Sets You Apart:

  • You have deep personal passion for travel and family experiences, and you understand intuitively why families trust a brand like Undercover Tourist with one of their most anticipated purchases of the year.
  • You enjoy theme parks and bring genuine enthusiasm and credibility to the category.

Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

Job Description:

A DXC Technology ajuda empresas globais em seus sistemas e operações de missão crítica modernizando TI, otimizando arquiteturas de dados e garantindo segurança e escalabilidade em nuvem pública, privada e híbrida. As maiores empresas e organizações de setor público confiam na DXC para implantar serviços para impulsionar novos níveis de desempenho, competitividade e experiência do cliente em suas propriedades de TI. Saiba mais sobre como entregamos excelência para nossos clientes e colegas em DXC.com.


Sobre a área

Soluções de nuvem e infraestrutura resilientes e sólidas compõem a base de qualquer ambiente de TI, garantindo serviços simplificados, otimizados e gerenciados, uma empresa sempre conectada, uma estratégia escalável, máxima eficiência em ambientes multicloud e on-premises, e muito mais. Ajudamos você a modernizar seu ambiente de TI com serviços de nuvem e a entregar recursos tradicionais críticos, seguros e econômicos de hospedagem, rede e mainframe.


Funções essenciais do cargo

  • Administrar e suportar servidores Windows e Linux/Unix em ambientes corporativos on-premises e cloud.
  • Realizar atendimento, análise, troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes de infraestrutura.
  • Executar atividades de monitoramento proativo de ambientes utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix.
  • Apoiar a administração de ambientes virtualizados VMware, garantindo disponibilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Realizar abertura, acompanhamento, alinhamento e validação de chamados junto a fornecedores para manutenção e substituição de hardware.
  • Administrar e prestar suporte a ambientes de banco de dados Oracle e Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes em nuvem, incluindo gerenciamento de recursos como máquinas virtuais, bancos de dados, aplicações web, serviços de containers, cofres de segredos, monitoramento, backup e segurança.
  • Participar de atividades de manutenção programada, atualizações e melhorias contínuas da infraestrutura.
  • Atuar em escalas de revezamento e turnos para garantir a continuidade operacional dos ambientes suportados.

Qualificações básicas

  • Experiência de 1 a 3 anos em administração e suporte de infraestrutura de TI.
  • Conhecimento em administração de servidores Windows Server.
  • Conhecimento em administração de servidores Linux/Unix.
  • Conhecimento em virtualização VMware.
  • Experiência com tratamento e resolução de incidentes de infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, preferencialmente Zabbix.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados Oracle e Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura e serviços de nuvem em pelo menos um dos provedores: Azure, AWS, OCI ou GCP.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa, organizada e orientada à resolução de problemas.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com equipes técnicas, fornecedores e clientes.

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência com aplicação e aprovação de patches utilizando WSUS, Ansible ou ferramentas similares.
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL.
  • Conhecimento em serviços de containers e orquestração, incluindo AKS, EKS e Container Registries.
  • Noções de automação de infraestrutura e Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias e processos ITIL.
  • Experiência em gestão e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Conhecimento de recursos de cloud computing, incluindo redes, segurança, monitoramento, backup e automação.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura, escrita e conversação.
  • Espanhol intermediário.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência.

  • Pricing experience is helpful, but is not required

  • Strong networking and communication skills, confident telephone manner
  • Team player who fosters excellent working culture and acts - both internally and externally - in a courteous and professional manner, with impeccable integrity
  • Ability to work with numbers and spreadsheets and produce analytical editorial copy
  • Ability to undertake business travel by plane, train or car

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Reward and benefits at Fastmarkets

We believe in fair pay and benefits that support you both inside and outside of work. Through Fastmarkets Rewards, you'll have access to a range of core benefits and a flexible allowance, giving you the freedom to tailor your package to suit your lifestyle, wellbeing and financial priorities. We know that everyone's needs are different, so we've designed our benefits to support our diverse global team wherever they're based.

Specific benefits may vary by country and role.

If the position is listed as remote this opportunity is available to applicants based in the following states:

• Illinois

• Oregon

• New York
• Pennsylvania

• Texas*

* Denotes states with office locations to support hybrid working.

Otherwise the position will be located as shown in the advert.

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit of Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced Acoustic Engineer to join our growing team, with a primary focus on delivering complex mission-critical projects, including hyperscale and enterprise data centre facilities.

Role Summary

The Acoustic Engineer will provide acoustical engineering expertise throughout the design and delivery of complex mission-critical projects. This role will focus on assessing and addressing noise and vibration challenges associated with data centres and other critical facilities, while working closely with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in acoustical engineering, with experience in noise and vibration analysis, sound control, and the development of practical acoustical solutions for complex facilities. The candidate should also have experience reviewing and understanding noise/nuisance ordinances and codes from AHJs for the purpose of creating compliance frameworks modelling constraints.

The Acoustical Engineer will collaborate closely with clients, architects, mechanical and electrical engineers, BIM/VDC professionals, and other stakeholders to ensure acoustical requirements are effectively integrated into project designs.

This role is ideal for an experienced acoustical engineer who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment and has a strong understanding of acoustical principles, building systems, and the unique noise and vibration challenges associated with mission-critical facilities and data centres.

What We Offer:

  • Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company
  • Unique, cutting-edge data centre projects
  • Comprehensive training and professional development support
  • Supportive management and a dynamic team environment
  • Career growth potential
  • Ability to work from home
  • Competitive employee benefits: Health insurance, Life insurance, Short-term and long-term disability, many other benefits, including PTO.
  • Opportunity to participate in the company’s retirement plan
  • Stock ownership / synthetic equity options

What You Will Do:

  • Lead acoustical engineering, noise, and vibration control activities for mission-critical data centre projects.
  • Perform environmental noise assessments, predictive noise modelling, acoustical calculations, and technical analyses using industry-standard tools and methodologies.
  • Assess noise generated by generators, chillers, cooling towers, dry coolers, air handling systems, pumps, transformers, fans, and other mechanical and electrical equipment.
  • Evaluate cumulative equipment noise and potential impacts at property lines and nearby noise-sensitive receptors.
  • Develop practical noise mitigation strategies, including equipment selection criteria, acoustic barriers, enclosures, silencers, louvers, attenuation systems, and other noise control measures.
  • Develop vibration isolation and control recommendations for mechanical and electrical equipment.
  • Establish project-specific acoustical design criteria and equipment sound requirements that meet the standards of AHJs.
  • Review manufacturer sound data, equipment selections, shop drawings, equipment submittals, and contractor RFIs to verify compliance with project acoustical requirements.
  • Identify potential acoustical risks during early project phases and provide recommendations before equipment layouts and selections are finalized.
  • Prepare acoustical reports, specifications, design criteria, and construction documentation.
  • Coordinate acoustical requirements with mechanical, electrical, structural, architectural, controls, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Support construction-phase troubleshooting, field noise and vibration measurements, site assessments, and post-construction verification as required.
  • Support commissioning activities to verify acoustical performance and alignment with design intent.
  • Collaborate with project managers, clients, contractors, equipment manufacturers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Serve as a senior acoustical resource, providing technical guidance and contributing to the development of acoustical design criteria, methodologies, and best practices for data centre projects.
  • Represent the client or firm when interacting with AHJs.

What We Expect:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Acoustics, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in acoustical engineering, environmental noise, mechanical equipment noise control, and/or vibration control.
  • Significant experience supporting complex industrial, mission-critical, data centre, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with data centre acoustics is strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical equipment noise and vibration control.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting environmental noise assessments and predictive noise modelling.
  • Experience evaluating large equipment installations and developing practical noise mitigation strategies.
  • Strong understanding of equipment sound data, sound propagation, attenuation, vibration isolation, and environmental noise principles.
  • Experience with industry-standard acoustical modelling and analysis software.
  • Ability to interpret architectural, mechanical, electrical, and structural drawings and coordinate effectively within multidisciplinary design teams.
  • Experience preparing acoustical reports, specifications, design criteria, and construction documentation.
  • Working knowledge of applicable acoustical standards, environmental noise requirements, building codes, and municipal noise bylaws.
  • Experience supporting projects through design, construction, and commissioning.
  • Ability to independently manage the acoustical scope of complex projects and provide senior-level technical recommendations.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to explain complex acoustical issues to clients, engineers, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation INCE Certification, and/or relevant acoustics industry credentials are considered an asset.
  • Must be legally eligible to work in Canada.

Why Join Us?

Take ownership of high-tech data center projects in one of the fastest-growing global industries, driving delivery from planning through execution.

Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. The Program Manager will serve as the senior contractor leader accountable for successful execution of the nationwide Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Transition Assistance Program (TAP), including service delivery across more than 300 installations and oversight of a geographically dispersed Benefits Advisor workforce of approximately 250-280 personnel. The Program Manager will provide executive leadership across operations, curriculum, training, analytics, modernization, quality, staffing, cost, schedule, risk, and Government stakeholder coordination.

The VA Transition Assistance Program (TAP) helps transitioning Service members and their families understand and access the VA benefits, services, and resources available to them as they transition from military to civilian life. VA delivers TAP services at more than 300 military installations across the Continental United States (CONUS) and areas Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) through a network of Benefits Advisors, supported by standardized curriculum, training, program operations, and performance management. The program is part of the broader interagency Transition Assistance Program delivered in partnership with the Department of War, Department of Labor, and other Federal agencies.

Please note that this position is contingent upon award (estimated December 2026). We expect this role to be remote, but periodic travel may be required to support program activities, customer meetings, and operations at U.S. and overseas locations. Travel frequency will vary based on program needs.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provide executive responsibility for nationwide and OCONUS TAP service delivery across 300+ installations and a Benefits Advisor workforce of approximately 250-280 personnel.
  • Provide overall leadership and accountability for program performance, staffing, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and contract compliance.
  • Lead the management structure and geographically dispersed workforce required to maintain staffing, coverage, and operational continuity across CONUS and OCONUS locations.
  • Serve as the senior contractor point of contact with VA leadership, the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), Government Program Managers, and Federal and Department of War (DoW) stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses. We help companies get high-quality support across roles like executive assistance, admin support, customer support, sales support, recruiting support, operations support, and other business functions.

Our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified opportunities, and we are hiring a Go-to-Market Associate to help create them. This person will sit at the front line of our revenue motion: identifying companies with active hiring needs, reaching out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and booking qualified meetings for our sales team.

This is a high-energy, high-ownership role for someone early in their career who wants to learn fast, build real outbound skills, and grow into bigger roles across sales, growth, revenue, or go-to-market strategy over time.

It is a great fit for someone who is competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams.

What You'll Do

    Generate Qualified Opportunities

    • Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can support, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles.
    • Use job postings, hiring signals, company growth signals, and account research to find strong-fit prospects.
    • Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit.
    • Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels.
    • Run focused outbound campaigns around active hiring needs, operational pain points, and alternative workforce solutions.
    • Hold early discovery conversations to understand a prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions.
    • Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting.
    • Book qualified appointments with companies that have a clear hiring need, relevant business use case, or strong fit for Wing.

      • Turn Hiring Intent Into Conversations

      • Monitor companies that are posting roles Wing can service.
      • Understand what the company is likely trying to solve by hiring that role.
      • Position Wing as a faster, more flexible, and more scalable alternative to traditional hiring.
      • Educate prospects who may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, offshore talent, or AI-enabled workforce support before.
      • Create curiosity with founders, executives, operators, HR leaders, recruiting teams, and department heads.

        • Support the Revenue Team

        • Work closely with the sales team to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline.
        • Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context needed to move conversations forward.
        • Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, their current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved.
        • Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM.

          • Bring the Market Back In

          • Feed what you are hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.
          • Help refine messaging and outreach based on what is actually landing with companies.
          • Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, industries, and roles where Wing is resonating.
          • Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations.

What We're Looking For

    Core Requirements

    • 1 to 4+ years in sales, appointment setting, cold calling, recruiting, staffing, lead generation, outbound marketing, growth, or a comparable role.
    • A real interest in go-to-market strategy, pipeline generation, and B2B growth.
    • Proven background in prospecting, cold calling, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound outreach.
    • Strong written and verbal communication; you can get to the point and make it compelling.
    • Comfort reaching out to companies that may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, offshore talent, or AI-enabled workforce solutions before.
    • Strong research skills and the ability to turn hiring signals into relevant outbound messaging.
    • Strong organization and the resilience to keep going when a day does not go your way.
    • The drive that comes from chasing clear goals, activity metrics, and booked meeting targets.
    • The ability to run your own desk while still collaborating well across teams.
    • A genuine eagerness to learn the product, the market, and the craft of go-to-market execution quickly.

      • Nice to Have

      • Exposure to staffing companies, recruiting firms, BPOs, outsourcing companies, virtual assistant companies, digital agent companies, or high-ticket professional services organizations.
      • Familiarity with CRM and sales engagement tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, Instantly, Clay, Close, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
      • Familiarity with auto dialers, power dialers, cold calling workflows, and high-volume outbound systems.
      • Experience prospecting into founders, executives, operations leaders, HR leaders, recruiting teams, customer support leaders, sales leaders, or department heads.

Job Description: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)

Department: Enterprise Security & Technology Risk Management Location: Regionwide

Reports To: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client from banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

  • PCI DSS Compliance Management:
    • Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.

Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.

  • Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.
  • Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCI DSS certification audits.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.
  • Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or

equivalent work experience).

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in information security, PCI compliance, or a related field.
    • Previous experience as an ISA, QSA, or a similar role is highly desirable.
  • Certifications:
    • Certified PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) or Certified PCI Professional (PCIP) certifications preferred.

Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH are a plus.

  • Skills and Competencies:
    • Deep understanding of PCI DSS requirements and data security best practices.
    • Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, encryption, etc.).
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross- functionally.
    • Proficiency in using security assessment tools and techniques (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM).

Other Requirements:

Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information confidentially.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Occasional travel may be required for audits or compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation:
    • Identify and assess potential risks to cardholder data environments and provide recommendations for risk mitigation.
    • Implement and enforce necessary security controls to address gaps identified during assessments.
    • Ensure vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security reviews are conducted to identify weaknesses and ensure continuous compliance.
  • Training and Awareness:
    • Conduct internal PCI DSS training for staff to ensure a deep understanding of the importance of compliance and security measures.
    • Provide ongoing guidance and support to departments regarding security best practices related to PCI DSS.
  • Collaboration and Communication:
    • Work closely with projects, Enterprise Security, Technology, and other relevant departments to align PCI DSS compliance with overall security policies and practices.
    • Proactively identify and/or promptly escalate risks and issues affecting PCI compliance status.
    • Stay updated on changes in PCI DSS requirements and industry best practices to ensure our client from banking industry remains compliant.
    • Present PCI DSS compliance status reports to senior management and external stakeholders.
    • Act as a liaison where necessary between our client from banking industry and external vendors or service providers involved in processing or storing cardholder data.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Principal Data Scientist to serve as the technical lead across an entire agentic AI program. This role is ideal for a deeply experienced data science and AI leader who can set direction across many workstreams at once: owning the technical vision, guiding large teams through complex design and delivery challenges, and keeping the full AI/ML program coherent, high quality, and moving at pace.

In this role, you will be the senior technical authority over every agentic AI workstream in the program, spanning a large delivery organization. You'll set architecture and evaluation standards, manage technical delivery across streams, and act as the trusted voice on technical decisions with client leadership. You'll partner closely with executives to define the AI roadmap and make high-stakes decisions that determine how agentic AI scales across the organization.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You'll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Provide technical oversight of all agentic AI workstreams, from problem framing and design through evaluation, deployment, and ongoing operation
  • Define the technical strategy and reference architecture for agentic systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, RAG patterns, vector databases, embeddings, and streaming responses
  • Manage technical delivery across streams, identifying cross-team dependencies, resolving technical blockers, and keeping quality and velocity high as the program scales
  • Set the standard for model development, experimentation, and the path from research to production across the program
  • Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks for LLM and agent performance, including quality, safety, hallucination, cost, and latency, so progress is measured and not assumed
  • Guide the design of scalable ML platforms, pipelines, and workflow orchestration that support event-driven, asynchronous operations at scale
  • Ensure AI reliability, security, and scalability across deployed systems, including observability, monitoring, and debugging in production
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as the technical face of the AI/ML program to senior client stakeholders, building trust through clear, honest communication on progress, risk, and tradeoffs
  • Co-define the AI roadmap with executive leadership, operating as a peer in strategic technical conversations
  • Translate complex technical concepts for executive, engineering, and business audiences, turning depth into decisions others can act on
  • Align data science, engineering, product, and business teams so every workstream ladders up to shared priorities and measurable outcomes

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead and influence a large, multi-team delivery organization, setting expectations for technical excellence across every stream
  • Define and champion data science and AI engineering standards that shape how the program builds, evaluates, and operates AI systems
  • Review and elevate the quality of work across teams, giving direct feedback that makes the work better
  • Mentor technical leads and senior practitioners, developing the next generation of technical leaders
  • Own high-stakes technical decisions with program-wide weight, balancing innovation, risk, and delivery speed
  • Drive technical vision, defining not just what gets built, but how agentic AI practice evolves across the program over time

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in data science and AI/ML, with a record of taking AI systems from research to production at enterprise scale
  • Proven track record leading technical delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams or teams, with influence that extends well beyond the immediate team
  • Experience leading, or technically overseeing, large multi-team programs, including managing technical risk, dependencies, and delivery quality
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including credibility with senior executives and client leadership
  • Hands-on experience with LLM and agentic systems, including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and streaming LLM responses
  • Deep expertise in model evaluation, experimentation design, and applied statistics, including evaluation approaches specific to generative and agentic systems
  • Strong proficiency in Python and the modern data science and ML stack
  • Expertise in MLOps and AI infrastructure, including model versioning, monitoring, deployment automation, and reproducibility
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, API design, code quality, and strong unit testing practices
  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and workflow orchestration tools
  • In-depth experience with AWS, especially the AWS GenAI offering (e.g., Amazon Bedrock); working knowledge of other cloud platforms
  • Familiarity with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including scalable design patterns
  • Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, and compliance considerations in production environments

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Experience supporting AI programs in regulated industries such as life sciences, healthcare, or financial services
  • Experience in a consulting or client-facing technical leadership role
  • Background in fine-tuning, evaluation automation, or agent safety and guardrails

You'll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Job Title:

Art Director

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.
Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

As Art Director, you own the visual craft and creative judgment that Orbit's automation cannot produce on its own. You set creative direction, lead the human-led steps of the production workflow (concepting, typography, art direction, and final refinement), and are accountable for the brand fidelity and executional quality of everything that carries a client's name. You are client-facing: presenting work, defending creative rationale, and building trust with senior marketing and brand stakeholders at global enterprise brands.
You are a maker and a director. You have strong personal design craft, a trained eye for composition and type, and the ability to run AI-generated output through expert correction so it meets enterprise standards. You use AI tools as a core part of how you work, as leverage, not as a substitute for judgment.


Function

Marketing &Communications Group, Marketing Solutions (Creative Services)

Location

Remote, Latin America

Client Engagement

Direct client-facing role with ongoing stakeholder interaction

Travel

Occasional; client or team offsites

Experience

7+ years art direction / senior design, with a hands-on portfolio


What You Will Do

Creative Direction & Visual Systems

  • Own creative direction. Set the visual territory for campaigns: define the creative concept, art direction, and design system that a campaign lives within, and ensure every asset produced against it holds together.
  • Direct from the brief. Interpret Orbit's pre-populated briefs and translate business objectives into clear, on-brand, commercially accountable creative, validating and adjusting the brief where creative judgment is required.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, brand kits, templates, and component libraries (Canva brand kits, Figma modular systems, Affinity/InDesign editorial templates) so downstream production scales without drifting off-brand.

    Hands-On Design & Production Craft
  • Make the work. Produce and direct client-ready design across digital and print: brand campaigns, HTML email, IAB display, social static and carousels, sales and marketing decks, landing pages, and long-form

editorial (white papers, reports).

  • Lead typography. Own human-led typography: type hierarchy, scale, tracking, and legibility across render contexts (email preview panes, the full IAB size cascade, mobile feed, print). Typography is brand defining and stays under human control.
  • Direct and refine AI output. Direct AI image generation and correct it. Run Adobe Firefly (and Firefly Custom Models for on-brand consistency), then use Photoshop Generative Fill / Generative Expand and Illustrator Generative Vector to fix AI-tells, remove hallucinated elements, integrate brand environments, and reframe compositions.
  • Own quality. Apply an AI-tells checklist and a brand-adherence review to every asset before release: composition, spatial hierarchy, color fidelity, type integrity, and production readiness.

    Client Partnership & Stakeholder Management
  • Present and defend the work. Serve as a creative point of contact for assigned accounts: present work, walk stakeholders through creative rationale, and manage revision cycles with professionalism.
  • Engage senior stakeholders. Communicate confidently with senior client contacts, including VP- and Csuite-level marketing and brand stakeholders, on creative direction and executional decisions.
  • Balance strict brand-standards compliance with creative ambition, working within guardrails without producing generic output.

    AI-Augmented Execution
  • Be the craft layer. Serve as the human judgment and craft layer over Orbit's automated pipeline: the signal-to-brief-to-generation flow is AI-led, but concept, composition, typography, art direction, and final

sign-off are yours.

  • Work AI-native. Use AI tools (Adobe Firefly and the Adobe Creative connector, Claude, Canva, Midjourney for concepting only) as a standard part of your production workflow for ideation, generation, and iteration.
  • Contribute to the refinement of Orbit's creative workflows, prompting standards, brand-token systems, and creative governance so quality scales as volume grows.

Craft Leadership

• Act as a recognized expert on creative craft within the Orbit team and the broader Marketing Solutions function, contributing to new approaches, standards, and best practices as the model matures.
How You Will Work

This role operates inside an AI-native delivery model. You are a skilled creative professional who uses AI to extend your capacity while providing the art direction, design craft, brand instinct, and client-relationship

management that AI cannot replace.

You will work closely with Creative Strategy, copywriters and AEO specialists, and client-facing program leads. Work is reviewed and approved in collaboration with client stakeholders. Speed, quality, and defensibility matter equally: we expect enterprise-grade creative delivered at the pace of an AI-augmented team.

What You Bring
Required

  • 7+ years of art direction or senior design experience, ideally in B2B, agency, or embedded team environments serving enterprise brands.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating hands-on creative production and art direction across digital and print. Creative direction or brief-writing alone is not sufficient. The work must show personal craft.
  • Demonstrated command of typography, composition, color, and brand systems, with the ability to hold quality across multiple client accounts and formats.
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma; working proficiency in Canva for brand-kit-driven production.
  • Practical, established experience using generative AI in professional design work, including directing and correcting AI-generated imagery to enterprise standards.
  • Proven client-facing experience: presenting creative, defending rationale, and navigating senior stakeholder feedback.
  • Accuracy is paramount. Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to proof your own work and catch errors before they ship. Every asset carries a client's name.
  • Brand fidelity. Firm command of brand voice and the ability to interpret and apply brand guidelines faithfully across formats, accounts, and edge cases the guidelines do not spell out.
  • Self-directed and collaborative. A self-starter who works well autonomously and within a team, able to set direction on ambiguous briefs while collaborating cleanly with strategy, copy, and program leads.
  • Discipline across type, color accuracy, asset naming, version control, and production readiness.

Preferred
•Motion design or video experience (After Effects, Premiere Pro, or equivalent), a meaningful differentiator in this role.

  • Experience with Adobe Firefly Custom Models, the Adobe Creative connector, or comparable brandtuned generative pipelines.
  • Affinity suite (Designer, Photo, Publisher) as an alternative production toolset.
  • Print production and pre-press control (InDesign paragraph/character styles, baseline grid, ICC profiles, PDF/X export) for long-form editorial and client-distributed documents.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior creative talent.

• Comfort building process in ambiguous environments where playbooks are still being written.

Candidates must have demonstrated, hands-on experience with the following tools. Proficiency will be assessed during the interview process.

Primary production suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, including

Generative Fill, Generative Expand, and Generative Vector for AI-tells

correction and brand-environment integration.

Custom Models trained on brand assets; accessed directly and via the

Claude Adobe Creative connector for Orbit-integrated generation.

layouts, responsive variants, and Dev Mode handoff.

workflows.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Customer Support Manager

Location: Remote

Reports To: VP of Operations, BEC Legal Systems

Travel: Estimated 5-10%: periodic visits to the Cincinnati office, occasional client sites, and industry conferences (e.g., ILTACON)

About BEC Legal Systems

BEC Legal Systems has served the legal community for decades, evolving from its roots in Cincinnati, Ohio into a trusted provider of enterprise software for law firms and corporate legal departments nationwide. Our BEC CoreRelate Framework - including MatterLink, Docket Enterprise, LegalBar, and Assemble-It - helps legal teams manage attorney calendars, track matters, and automate document creation directly within the Microsoft Office environment they already rely on.

Our clients stay with us because our team knows their firms, their workflows, and their deadlines. As we modernize our support organization - new tooling, a real knowledge base, and AI woven into how the work gets done - we are hiring a leader to own that function and make responsiveness a competitive advantage.

About the Role

As Customer Support Manager, you will lead BEC's Support team and own the client experience from the moment a request arrives through to resolution. You may come to this from software support, or have experience working as a docket manager or specialist, paralegal, legal assistant, or legal technology coordinator who lived in systems like ours. You will define how we classify, prioritize, escalate, and measure support work - while carrying a queue yourself.

This is deliberately a hands-on leadership role, roughly half player and half coach. You will personally handle Tier 1 and Tier 2 inquiries across our product suite and refine the team’s processes and infrastructure: SLA targets, escalation path into R&D, a trusted knowledge base, and a working cadence with R&D and Cloud Ops. You will also lead the evaluation of the existing system of record for support.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Support Delivery (approximately 50%)

  • Own the queue: Act as a product expert and respond directly to Tier 1 and Tier 2 client inquiries by email, phone, and callback request across MatterLink, Docket Enterprise, LegalBar, Assemble-It, CoreRelate Cloud, and CoreRespond.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve: Diagnose functional and technical issues, reproduce defects, and collaborate with R&D and Cloud Ops on anything that needs engineering involvement.
  • Escalate where needed: Serve as the escalation point for the team's most complex or most sensitive client situations, including issues raised by firm administrators, IT directors, and managing partners.
  • Communicate under pressure: Keep clients informed during outages, defects, and long-running issues, maintaining consistent communication with clients.

Team Leadership, Process, and Systems (approximately 50%)

  • Team Leadership and Development: Manage, coach, and develop the Support team through regular 1:1s, ticket reviews, and structured feedback; set clear expectations and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ticket Classification: Define and roll out a classification scheme by tier (L1/L2) and by product, pilot it on new tickets, and enforce it consistently so that reporting reflects reality.
  • SLA Definition and Tracking: Establish baseline response and resolution targets by severity, develop the appropriate tracking mechanisms, report against it weekly, and revise the targets as required.
  • Escalation Path to R&D: Document and operationalize a formal escalation process into R&D - entry criteria, required information, ownership, and expected turnaround creating a defined workflow.
  • Support Systems Evaluation: Lead the evaluation of the support system of record, including needs assessment, identification of the right vendor based on the businesses’ requirements, workflow configuration, implementation of a new system, and team training and change management.
  • Reporting and KPIs: Build and maintain the operational reporting that leadership and the team rely on - volume, backlog and ticket ageing, response and resolution times, recurring defect clusters, and client-level and product-level trends.
  • Knowledge Base Ownership: Establish a sustainable process for creating and maintaining Online Help and internal documentation, using AI to accelerate authoring and to keep content aligned to current product functionality rather than letting it go stale.
  • AI Adoption: Drive practical adoption of AI across the Support team - drafting client responses, triaging and routing incoming tickets, summarizing threads, and surfacing knowledge gaps - and audit AI-assisted output for accuracy and tone before it reaches a client.
  • Cross-Functional Cadence: Establish and hold a regular working rhythm with R&D, Cloud Ops, and Professional Services covering escalations, release readiness, known defects, and at-risk clients.
  • Client Health and Retention: Partner with leadership to own the support side of client health - identifying at-risk accounts from support signals, closing the loop on NPS and survey responses, and driving proactive outreach to maintain healthy client relationships and drive increased retention.
  • Continuous Improvement Projects: Take ownership of a recurring improvement initiative each quarter - automation, deflection, QA scoring, self-service content - with a defined outcome and measurable result.

Core Competencies

  • Legal workflow fluency: Bring a working understanding of how our clients use BEC and use it to interpret requests, process severity, and represent the client’s reality. Deeply understands the needs of a docketing team, paralegal or legal assistant, and can earn the trust of our user base by speaking to their reality.
  • Player-Coach Balance: Comfortable resolving tickets personally and simultaneously coaching, reporting, or presenting to leadership, giving the appropriate attention to each key responsibility.
  • Process and Playbook Building: Creates repeatable structure (classification, SLAs, escalation paths, documentation standards) and manages adoption in a small team.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Uses ticket and performance data to assess team performance, identify trends and risk areas early, and make the case for change in a data-driven manner.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Thinks critically and diagnoses methodically across application, integration, and environment issues; knows when to keep digging and when to escalate.
  • AI Fluency and Judgment: Uses generative AI tools to improve speed and quality of support work, and applies the judgment to know where AI output needs verification before a client sees it.
  • Client Communication: Writes and speaks clearly and professionally to sophisticated legal-industry clients, particularly in challenging situations.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Works effectively with R&D, Cloud Ops, and Professional Services, aligning them around shared client outcomes.
  • Adaptability and Resourcefulness: Operates effectively in a lean, close-knit organization, balancing daily delivery with building in a resource-constrained environment.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Post-secondary degree, or an equivalent combination of experience and education.
  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical support role, including at least 2 years leading, supervising, or mentoring a support team.
  • Hands-on experience with legal practice management, matter management, or document automation platforms (e.g., BEC's suite — Docket Enterprise, MatterLink, LegalBar, Assemble-It, CoreRelate Cloud — or comparable tools) as a user, administrator, or support resource.
  • Track record of introducing structure to a support function - ticket classification, SLAs, escalation processes, knowledge management, or QA - and getting it adopted.
  • Hands-on experience with a helpdesk or ticketing platform, including reporting; experience implementing or migrating one is a strong advantage.
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to improve personal productivity, optimize workflows, or improve client communication.
  • Capability to excel in a data-driven, metrics-oriented environment, and to build the metrics where they do not yet exist.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong listening skills and a genuine service orientation.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely, in a lean organization where leaders are both strategic and hands-on.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Outlook, Word, SharePoint) and with document management systems such as NetDocuments or iManage.
  • Experience deploying or tuning an AI support agent, chatbot, or automated deflection channel in a live client-facing environment.
  • Experience owning a knowledge base or help centre, including content standards and a maintenance cadence.
  • Exposure to cloud operations or hosted application support environments.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few.   • Contribute to and help execute the product-led growth (PLG) strategy for the product portfolio, identifying opportunities to expand adoption and usage through the product experience.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, biology, engineering, or a related field.

Experience with ambulatory regulatory and quality programs, including ONC Health IT Certification (CEHRT), CMS incentive and quality programs (MIPS/MACRA and Promoting Interoperability), clinical quality measurement (eCQMs), information-blocking compliance, and value-based care and patient-engagement capabilities.

jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

Responsibilities

Architecture. Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

Team leadership. Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer. Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement. Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

Managed inference at scale. Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

Observability and operations. Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

Partners and vendors. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

Internal consumers. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

Hiring. Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.

Requirements

Must have

  • Experience. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Slurm at scale, hands on. Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.

  • GPU fleet operation on bare metal. NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn-in and acceptance.

  • High-performance interconnects. InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR-IOV, and diagnosing multi-node NCCL performance problems.

  • Linux systems depth. Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute-heavy workloads.

  • Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment: control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi-tenancy design.

  • HPC storage and data movement. Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.

  • Observability and operations. Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post-incident review.

  • Working fluency in JavaScript and sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature-development requirement.

  • A shipped platform with real users. A multi-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user-facing API and CLI surfaces.

  • Leadership that stays in the code. People management across time zones, cross-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.

  • Location. Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

Desirable

  • Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

  • Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade-offs, GPU memory planning.

  • VM and container isolation for multi-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA confidential-compute mode).

  • Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.

  • Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.

  • Peer-to-peer or distributed-systems background.

  • Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

Important information for candidates

Pak jij de kans om samen met twee collega's te ondernemen in een groeiende technische detachering? Bij SD Worx Technics ga je vakspecialisten verbinden aan een opdracht waarin zij echt het verschil maken. Je krijgt hierin volop de vrijheid, het vertrouwen en de verantwoordelijkheid om impact te maken: op klanten, op technici én op je eigen carrière.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Recruiter Techniek ben je de spil tussen onze technici en opdrachtgevers. Jij weet hoe je de beste technici binnenhaalt en samen met je collega plaatst bij je klanten. Vanzelfsprekend bouw je aan je relaties met je kandidaten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

· Recruitment: je bouwt aan je kandidatenpool met de beste technici. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan elektromonteurs, maintenance engineers, servicetechnici en werktuigbouwkundige.

· Technici en opdrachtgevers matchen: Ook na het matchen blijf je de eerste contactpersoon van zowel de klant, als de begeleider van je kandidaat gedurende de opdracht.

· Targets behalen: Je werkt toe naar het behalen van jouw persoonlijke doelstellingen. Dit omvat zowel kwantitatieve als kwalitatieve targets.

· Netwerk verder uitbouwen: Je gaat zelfstandig actief opzoek naar nieuwe opdrachtgevers.

Wat bieden wij?

SD Worx Technics heeft een informele werksfeer waarin gestuurd wordt op output. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatieven. We bieden jou de vrijheid en flexibiliteit om de regie over je werk in handen te nemen. Zo krijg je de ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris tussen de €2900,- en €4500,- bruto op basis van 40 uur afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Een netto onkostenvergoeding van €75,- en een netto internetvergoeding van €25,- op basis van 40 uur

  • Leaseauto die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Een kwartaalbonusregeling

  • 8,5% vakantiegeld

  • 25 vakantiedagen, 6,5 adv dagen (of 2,5% extra salaris) & een vrije dag op je verjaardag

  • Een pensioenregeling waarbij SD Worx 60% van de premie betaald

  • Korting op je sportschool abonnement en op een nieuwe fiets

Wat neem jij mee?

Als Recruiter Techniek is het van belang dat je een commerciële drive hebt. Het gaat om een zelfstandige functie die vraagt om proactiviteit. We zoeken daarbij iemand met:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Ervaring in de technische sector en/of detachering

  • Resultaatgerichtheid en ervaring met het behalen van individuele en teamtargets

  • Klantgerichtheid en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden

  • Oog voor de marktontwikkelingen en deze weet te vertalen naar kansen voor kandidaten

Technics

SD Worx Technics is een specialist in het matchen van technische vakmensen met uitdagende projecten. Wij bieden een persoonlijke benadering en leveren maatwerkoplossingen voor zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers. Onze cultuur is open en informeel, met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en innovatie. Bij ons staan kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en integriteit centraal.

Bij SD Worx werken we als één team en groeien we samen, van beter tot best. Diversiteit staat centraal in ons bedrijf, omdat het ons inspireert en innovatie stimuleert. We verwelkomen sollicitaties van gekwalificeerd talent, ongeacht afkomst, nationaliteit, geslacht, huidskleur, etnische en sociale achtergrond, religie, leeftijd, handicap, seksuele geaardheid en levensfase.

Hier kun je volop groeien, leren en innoveren. Join the team en ervaar het zelf!
