jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are building a cloud-native data platform that ingests, governs, and serves data to product and analytics teams across the company.
jobs.description:
Overview

We are building a cloud-native data platform that ingests, governs, and serves data to product and analytics teams across the company. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two tightly connected sides of that platform: the sourcing of data into the platform, and the experience of the internal teams who consume it. You will decide which data sources we onboard and how, define the contracts and standards that keep that data trustworthy, and treat the platform's internal consumers — product engineering, analytics, data science, Agentic AI, and operations teams — as your primary customers.

This is a high-leverage role. The quality, coverage, and usability of the platform directly shapes what dozens of downstream teams can ship. You will translate ambiguous, cross-functional needs into a clear roadmap, and you will be measured on adoption, data reliability, and the speed at which internal teams can build on what you provide.

Responsibilities

What You'll Own

  • Data sourcing strategy — prioritize and manage the pipeline of internal and third-party data sources to onboard; weigh coverage, cost, licensing, quality, and effort to decide what gets ingested and in what order.
  • Source onboarding — define the intake process for new sources, from evaluation and vendor/provider assessment through ingestion, validation, and go-live; partner with data engineering on connectors, schemas, and SLAs.
  • Data contracts & standards — establish the schema, freshness, quality, and metadata standards that every source must meet, and the governance for changing them without breaking consumers.
  • Consumer management — own the relationship with the internal teams that consume the platform; run intake for their requests, maintain a clear prioritization framework, and keep a feedback loop that turns their needs into roadmap.
  • Adoption & reliability — define and track the metrics that matter — source coverage, data freshness and quality, consumer adoption, and time-to-onboard a new consumer — and act on them.
  • Roadmap & stakeholders — maintain the platform roadmap, communicate trade-offs and timelines, and align sourcing investments with the priorities of the teams you serve.
  • AI-forward delivery — use AI tools as a default part of how the work gets done — accelerating source evaluation, requirements, documentation, and consumer support — and champion AI-assisted workflows across the platform and its consumer teams.

Qualifications

What You'll Do Day to Day

  • Interview and shadow internal consumer teams to understand how they use data and where the platform slows them down.

  • Write clear requirements and data contracts, and partner with engineering to size and sequence the work.

  • Evaluate new data sources — internal systems and external providers — and make the call on what to onboard.

  • Triage and prioritize the consumer request queue against a transparent framework.

  • Report on platform health and adoption to leadership and to the teams who depend on you.

  • Reach for AI to move faster — drafting specs and docs, summarizing consumer feedback, prototyping, and profiling new data sources — and share what works with the team.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in product management, with meaningful time on data, platform, infrastructure, or API products serving internal or technical users.

  • Data platform fluency — comfortable reasoning about data pipelines, warehouses/lakes, schemas, data quality, and governance; you can hold a credible technical conversation with data engineers.

  • Cloud-native context — familiarity with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., object storage, managed warehouses, streaming/ELT, orchestration) and the trade-offs they carry.

  • Internal-customer orientation — a track record of treating internal teams as real customers, managing their demand, and driving measurable adoption.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity — you can turn a noisy set of cross-team requests into a defensible, communicated roadmap.

  • Strong communication — you write clearly, align stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • AI-forward mindset — you actively use AI tools to do your best work and raise your team's leverage, and you stay current as the tooling evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Real estate / proptech experience — familiarity with property, leasing, or real estate data is desired but not required.

  • Experience defining data contracts

  • Familiarity with data catalog, lineage, or self-service analytics tooling.

  • SQL fluency and comfort exploring data directly.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Growth in the number and quality of data sources available on the platform.

  • Data freshness and quality against agreed SLAs.

  • Adoption by internal consumer teams and reduction in time-to-onboard a new consumer.

  • Consumer satisfaction and a shrinking backlog of unmet data needs.

SALARY AND BENEFITS RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.
Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. jobs.description:
Job Title: Information Security Analyst

Job Type: Full-Time/Contract - 2 years (renewable)

Location: Trinidad and Tobago (Remote)

RoleSummary:

Working collaboratively with the Information Security team and third-party service providers, the Information Security Analyst will contribute to the protection of the Banks information assets. The incumbent will assist in identifying and analysing security anomalies and applying mitigating actions as instructed by management. The Analyst will also assist in the management of information security risks related to the use, processing, storage, and transmission of information and the systems and processes used for those purposes.

The incumbent will assist with the embedding of policies, standards and procedures related to the effective management of the Banks security posture and will assist in the execution of security tests, risk assessments, exercises, simulations, initial investigation of security breaches, user training and other security activities as deemed necessary. The Analyst will be part of a team of information security professionals working closely with server and network operations to ensure stability of the Banks information security posture and may also be required to liaise with internal and external auditors and assist in audit reviews throughout the year.

KeyResponsibilities:

Governance and risk management:

  • Supports the manager with the completion of IT risk assessments, including information security assessments (ISAs), threat risk assessments (TRAs), vulnerability scans, penetration testing, etc., follows up on open issues, validates completion of agreed mitigating tasks and other related tasks as requested by the manager
  • Assists with the validation of identified vulnerabilities as directed by manager
  • Monitors compliance of information security policies and standards as requested by the manager. Raises incidents of non-compliance / adherence with the manager and / or relevant parties to ensure resolution and learning

Incident and problem management:

  • Assists with the collection and evaluation of information required to investigate and remediate, as necessary, alerts received from the onsite security tools and third party providers of information security services, e.g. IBM ISS.
  • Immediately informs manager of all critical events identified
  • Compiles all required information for further investigation of identified incidents
  • Provides incident response support, including assisting manager with mitigating actions to contain activity

Secrets management, as directed by the manager:

  • Assists with requests for new / modified security profiles; reviews requests to ensure completeness and prepares draft profiles for review and approval by manager
  • Assists the manager with the maintenance of the security matrices; researching changes to users authentication with the application owners and confirming the results of the security matrices tests.
  • Assists with processing requests for certificates, tokens and keys; reviews requests to ensure completeness and prepares responses for review and approval by manager

General:

  • Collects and collates data for the generation of key performance indicators and key risk indicators, as requested by manager
  • Assists with the testing of new computers, software, switch hardware and routers before implementation to ensure security posture is maintained. This includes running vulnerability scans and running configuration compliance (hardware / databases / operating systems, etc.), scans and escalating significant issues to be addressed to responsible managers.
  • Reviews and actions security compliance alerts within service level agreement (SLA) to ensure that anomalies / vulnerabilities are escalated / mitigated.
  • Other tasks that may be assigned by manager

Application and Cloud Security:

  • To ensure application code implemented meets the established secure code standards and the cloud deployments are secured, thus mitigating the risk of unauthorised access to the bank and customers data:
  • Assists, as instructed, with application security testing, coordinates tests with third party providers, and ensures that results are logged within applicable systems.
  • Undertakes cloud security tasks as assigned by the manager, coordinates tests with third party providers, and ensures that results are logged within applicable systems

jobs.description:
Senior Business Development Lead (maternity cover)

Salary: £40,964 to £44,094 (dependent on experience)

About Voice 21

Voice 21 is the national oracy education charity. We exist to empower every child to use their voice for success in school and life. Our work transforms learning and life chances through talk by increasing access to a high-quality oracy education for those that need it most. Follow the links to find out more about why oracy is so vital and the impact Voice 21 has.

Your opportunity

Tackle a vital challenge, with great people. Voice 21 exists to transform children' s learning and life chances through talk and we are aiming to be working with 2,000 schools a year by 2025. To reach this goal we recruit great people and give them real responsibility, training and support.

Output focused culture, with flexible working opportunities. We have an agile and flexible approach – our team can work when and wherever works best to deliver the requirements of their role. For staff working at home, we support them to create a workspace and provide technology that enables them to work effectively.

Real development opportunities. We believe in supporting people to develop the skills they need to be excellent – whether this means funding external training, finding a mentor to support them or giving them the time to learn from others in the organisations through our regular CPD sessions. We also offer paid study leave for team members taking part in formal studies outside of work.

Great benefits. 33 days holiday (inclusive of bank holidays) and additional Christmas closure period. Holiday entitlement increases linked to length of service, 5% employer contribution to pension, interest-free season ticket, cycle and technology loans, employee assistance scheme.

Remuneration. Our pay is a band and spine point approach where there is up to 7 years progression available (depending on starting point).

Your purpose

To lead Voice 21's conversations with schools and trusts from first contact through to signed membership, helping more schools, especially those serving disadvantaged communities, give their pupils a high-quality oracy education. The Senior Business Development Lead will manage a portfolio of opportunities using MEDDPICC and HubSpot, build strong regional relationships, and help shape how we grow in the years ahead. The core competencies we are looking for are ability to ethically sell the value proposition in a short window at high volume and to be a completer-finisher in terms of your workload.

Your responsibilities

  • Close Sales Qualified Leads and Opportunities into customer schools through online meetings with school, trust and sector leaders
  • Manage a portfolio of schools and trusts from first conversation through to signed membership contract
  • Qualify and progress opportunities using the MEDDPICC framework, keeping deal records accurate and up to date in HubSpot - training will be provided on MEDDPIC and HubSpot
  • Lead consultative conversations with headteachers, senior leaders and trust leaders to understand their priorities and show how oracy supports them
  • Prioritise schools serving the most disadvantaged communities, contributing to our organisational reach targets
  • Develop group opportunities with multi-academy trusts, local authorities and school networks
  • Build local relationships and school champions in your region, supporting our regional Oracy Showcases
  • Deliver presentations, webinars and calls to prospective schools, and represent Voice 21 at sector events
  • Partner with Marketing to convert leads into opportunities, sharing insight from schools to sharpen campaigns and messaging
  • Forecast accurately and contribute to regular pipeline and deal reviews
  • Contribute to the end-of-cycle review and the development of next year's growth strategy

Your progression (link these to measurables that can be considered during the probation period and used as a measure of ‘passing’ probation)

Within 1 month, you'll have:

  • Familiarised yourself with Voice 21's membership offer, our MEDDPICC approach and the HubSpot sales pipeline
  • Completed a handover with the current Senior BD Lead and taken ownership of live opportunities
  • Met key colleagues from across the organisation
  • Begun building relationships with schools and trusts in your region

Within 3 months, you'll have:

  • Been independently managing a full pipeline through our spring recruitment peak
  • Closed your first memberships and kept all deal records accurate in HubSpot
  • Contributed to planning and delivery of at least one regional Oracy Showcase

Within 6 months, you'll have:

  • Consistently converted opportunities in line with agreed targets
  • Established a network of school champions and local partners in your region
  • Shared insight from school conversations that has shaped our marketing and messaging

From 6 months onwards, we expect you to be:

  • Leading complex group deals with trusts and networks
  • Playing an active role in the end-of-cycle review and shaping next year's growth strategy

This job is for you if...

  • You have a strong track record in consultative or relationship-led sales, ideally in education
  • You're confident talking with headteachers and trust leaders, and you understand the pressures schools face (experience working in or with schools is a real plus)
  • You're comfortable with a structured qualification approach such as MEDDPICC, and with using a CRM like HubSpot
  • You're organised, self-motivated and enjoy owning targets
  • You're proactive, collaborative and motivated by Voice 21's mission to transform education through oracy
  • You enjoy both the trust of autonomous working and the dynamism of working in a small and collaborative mission-driven team
  • You want to develop your expertise in MEDDPIC sales methodology

Who you’ll work with:

  • As part of our Operations Directorate, you'll work in the Growth team with our Head of Growth and colleagues across Business Development and Marketing
  • You'll work closely with our Member Success, Events, Comms and Programmes teams as well as the wider Ops Directorate

Where you’ll work:

Remote, ideally based in the South West, North East or Yorkshire (not essential), with sporadic regional and national travel to visit schools and attend Development Days/meetings, including some overnight stays.

Contract: temporary position, linked to maternity cover.

Terms: Full Time

Application details

To apply:

Please send your CV and a short cover letter including;

Your cover letter should briefly:

  1. Tell us why you want to work at Voice 21 and what it is about our mission that excites you (max. 400 words).
  2. Making direct reference to the job description, outline the three main reasons why you would make an excellent Senior Business Development Lead (max. 600 words).

We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the UK.

Closing date: Midnight, 27th October but we will be actively interviewing and may close the advert early if we find the right candidate. This is particularly important if you are a teacher who may need to resign before the 31st October for a January start.

Interview date: TBC but beginning as soon as suitable candidates are found.

Start date: From December and ideally before mid January.

Questions: If you have any questions about the role, or would like to discuss it before submitting an application, please contact John Stabler-Wright, Head of Growth ()

Valuing every voice

Voice 21 believes that every voice should be heard and valued. We are committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and do not condone discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership.

We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join Voice 21.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on full-stack Software Engineer who will focus primarily on security remediation. Your first priority will be owning the remediation of vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing: not just reporting findings, but digging into the codebase, session traffic, and infrastructure to fix the underlying issues and prevent them from recurring. You will work closely with engineering and design teams to translate real-world security findings into concrete, testable requirements in our Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs), and you will personally implement or oversee the fixes.

This is an engineering role first. As the security backlog comes under control, you will have the flexibility to contribute to application development across our Ruby on Rails and React platform, bringing a security-minded perspective to the features you build.

Key Responsibilities

Security Remediation

  • Vulnerability Remediation: Own end-to-end remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced by penetration tests and other security assessments, from triage through verified fix.
  • Traffic and Session Analysis: Use browser-based code inspection tools to examine session traffic between the front end and back end, identify cases where excessive or sensitive information is being exposed, and translate those findings into concrete design and engineering requirements.
  • TRD Input: Feed vulnerability findings and remediation requirements directly into the Technical Requirements Document (TRD) process so fixes are captured as durable design requirements, not one-off patches.
  • Session Management: Review and harden session management practices across the application stack.
  • Full-Stack Remediation: Work within a Ruby on Rails and React codebase and across containerized services (AWS, Fargate) to implement fixes at both the application and infrastructure layers.
  • API and Real-Time Systems: Assess and secure real-time and API-driven features, including those built on Pusher and AnyCable, and RESTful APIs generally.
  • Documentation: Produce clear, thorough documentation of vulnerabilities, root causes, remediation steps, and verification results.
  • Compliance Support: Contribute security context and vocabulary to FedRAMP-related discussions and requirements, partnering with compliance and engineering stakeholders.

Application Development

  • Feature Development: Design, build, and ship features across the Ruby on Rails back end and React front end alongside the broader engineering team.
  • Secure by Design: Apply what you learn from remediation work to new development, helping the team avoid reintroducing known classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Code Quality: Participate in code reviews, testing, and technical design discussions, with an eye toward both security and maintainability.

Requirements

Engineering Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with broad full-stack work across multiple applications and technology layers.
  • Working proficiency in Ruby on Rails and React.
  • Experience with containerized environments, AWS, and Fargate.
  • Solid API experience, including RESTful API design and security considerations.
  • Hands-on experience with Pusher and AnyCable, or comparable real-time messaging technologies.
  • Knowledge of Ruby data models and how schema and query design affect performance and scalability.

Security Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a security engineering or closely related role.
  • Proven experience remediating vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing.
  • AWS Security certification(s) (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty).
  • General familiarity with FedRAMP: enough understanding of the vocabulary and framework to contribute meaningfully to a FedRAMP-related project.

Analytical Skills

  • Comfortable using browser developer/code inspection tools to inspect network and session traffic.
  • Able to identify when too much information is being exposed between backend and frontend, and to explain the risk clearly to engineering and design stakeholders.
  • Able to translate security findings into actionable design requirements that feed directly into the TRD.

Coding and Technical Skills

  • Working proficiency in Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience with containerized environments, AWS, and Fargate.
  • Solid API experience, including RESTful API design and security considerations.
  • Solid understanding of session management principles and common pitfalls.
  • Hands-on experience with Pusher and AnyCable, or comparable real-time messaging technologies.
  • Broad, full-stack experience across multiple applications and technology layers.
  • Knowledge of Ruby data models and how schema and query design affect performance and scalability.

Documentation

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document vulnerabilities, remediations, and technical requirements clearly for both engineering and non-engineering audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Python experience.
  • SQL skills.

Lead Strategy. Manage Risk. Drive Matters to Resolution.


At Valet Living, the Director, Litigation Counsel will manage and support a broad portfolio of disputes and contested matters on behalf of the company.


Reporting to the Vice President, Assistant General Counsel, with a dotted-line relationship to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, this role will handle pre-litigation labor and employment claims, commercial contract disputes, regulatory filings and disputes, mediations, collections, intellectual property matters, privacy and data protection matters, and workers’ compensation claims.


This is a highly cross-functional role for an attorney who can move fluidly across practice areas, assess risk early, and drive matters toward efficient resolution. You’ll combine direct handling of matters with oversight of outside counsel while partnering closely with business leaders, Human Resources, Finance, Risk Management, Operations, and Compliance.


Compensation & Work Environment Details:


Salary Range: $115,000 - $157,000

Bonus: 15% of annual salary

Work environment: Remote‑first; Tampa‑based candidates preferred

Travel: Approximately 10%


What You’ll Do


  • Manage Labor and Employment Claims: Manage and defend employment-related claims and administrative charges involving discrimination, harassment, retaliation, wage-and-hour, wrongful termination, and leave or accommodation disputes. Advise Human Resources and management on litigation risk and oversee outside employment counsel.
  • Resolve Commercial Contract Disputes: Handle disputes arising from commercial agreements, including breach-of-contract, indemnification, and payment matters. Evaluate claims and defenses, quantify exposure, and develop resolution strategies from negotiation through trial.
  • Lead Regulatory Matters: Prepare and manage regulatory filings and responses to inquiries, investigations, and enforcement actions. Represent the company in contested regulatory and administrative proceedings, including matters involving fire code application, subpoenas, civil investigative demands, and information requests.
  • Guide Mediations and Settlements: Represent the company in mediations and alternative dispute resolution proceedings. Prepare mediation statements, evaluate settlement ranges, develop negotiation strategies, secure settlement authority, and draft or review agreements and releases.
  • Support Collections: Partner with Finance and Accounts Receivable on affirmative collection matters, including unpaid accounts, nonpayment claims, and judgment enforcement. Evaluate cost-effectiveness and pursue demand letters, litigation, or other recovery methods as appropriate.
  • Manage Intellectual Property Matters: Handle trademark, copyright, patent, and trade-secret disputes in which the company is a defendant or claimant. Manage cease-and-desist demands, infringement claims, and specialist outside counsel.
  • Address Privacy and Data Protection Risk: Manage disputes, claims, investigations, and regulatory inquiries involving consumer data rights, data incidents, and the company’s collection, use, sharing, and protection of personal information.
  • Partner on Workers’ Compensation and Third-Party Claims: Support Risk Management in defending workers’ compensation and third-party claims. Coordinate with Human Resources, Operations, insurers, third-party administrators, brokers, and outside counsel, and use claim insights to recommend improvements to safety, training, documentation, return-to-work processes, and loss prevention.
  • Own Matters From Intake Through Resolution: Lead case assessment, discovery, motion practice, hearings, and trial preparation while implementing litigation holds and coordinating e-discovery and document preservation.
  • Manage Outside Counsel and Spend: Select, direct, and manage outside counsel while controlling litigation budgets, strategy, and settlement posture.
  • Advise Business Leaders: Translate complex legal issues into practical, business-oriented guidance for executives and cross-functional partners.
  • Report on Risk and Exposure: Prepare periodic reporting for senior leadership on matter status, exposure, reserves, and key developments.

What We’re Looking For


  • Litigation Experience: Approximately 4–7 years of litigation experience in a law firm, corporate legal department, or a combination, with the ability to manage matters independently from intake through resolution.
  • Broad Practice Exposure: Substantive experience across several relevant areas, particularly employment, commercial, privacy, consumer protection, regulatory, intellectual property, or workers’ compensation matters.
  • Strategic Judgment: Strong command of litigation strategy, procedure, mediation, and negotiation, with sound judgment in assessing risk and exposure.
  • Business Partnership: Ability to translate legal issues into practical advice and communicate clearly with executives, business teams, and external stakeholders.
  • Caseload Management: Ability to manage a high-volume, multi-practice caseload and prioritize effectively across competing deadlines.
  • Outside Counsel Oversight: Experience selecting and managing outside counsel, litigation strategy, budgets, and spend.
  • Advocacy Experience: Excellent written and oral advocacy skills. First- or second-chair trial, arbitration, or hearing experience is preferred.
  • In-House Perspective: Prior experience supporting a corporate legal department is preferred.
  • Privacy and Consumer Protection Knowledge: Familiarity with major privacy and consumer protection regimes, including state comprehensive privacy laws, the FTC Act, and analogous state statutes, is preferred.
  • Education and Licensure: Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one state bar where the company operates. Ability to obtain any required admission or in-house counsel authorization.
  • Multi-Jurisdiction Capability: Admission in multiple jurisdictions is preferred.
  • Collaborative Approach: Self-directed, collaborative, and comfortable operating with limited supervision in a fast-paced environment.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us


At Valet Living, we don’t just provide essential services, we build careers, create opportunities, and cultivate a culture of excellence. As part of our team, you’ll experience a workplace where leadership is about service, growth is the norm, and every detail matters.


Comprehensive Benefits


  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, plus HSA with employer contributions and Flexible Spending Accounts.
  • Flexible Time Off: No preset accruals. Manage your time and work-life balance your way, plus 10 company-paid holidays.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) with company match, life and disability insurance, AD&D, and business travel coverage.
  • Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 per year and access to our online education center.
  • Additional Perks: Referral bonuses, pet insurance, associate assistance programs, discount programs, rewards, recognition, and free access to Torch Fitness virtual programs.

Physical Requirements: Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing while working on a computer.

jobs.title: Teamleiter CRM / E-Mail Marketing REMOTE (d/w/m)
jobs.excerpt: Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt.
jobs.description:
Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt. Aktuell hängen zu viele Entscheidungen an zu wenigen Köpfen — und unsere Account Manager:innen brauchen jemanden, der sie führt, nicht nur jemanden, der über ihnen steht.

Deshalb bauen wir die Ebene der Key Account Manager aus. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Team und ein eigenes Kundenportfolio — und gestaltest mit, wie Betreuung bei MAILODY in Zukunft funktioniert.

Wir sagen offen dazu: Diese Rolle ist gerade die anspruchsvollste im Unternehmen. Du bekommst Druck von oben (Wachstumsziele) und von unten (ein Team, das sich erst einspielt). Wir wissen das, wir lassen dich damit nicht allein — aber wir tun auch nicht so, als wäre es bequem.

Aufgaben

Führung

  • Du führst 3–5 Account Manager:innen fachlich und disziplinarisch.
  • Du führst wöchentliche 1:1s nach klarer Struktur (Fortschritt / Probleme / Pläne) und verantwortest die Gesundheit deines Teams.
  • Du entwickelst deine Leute aktiv weiter — Schulungen, Feedback, strukturierte Einarbeitung.

Kunden

  • Du verantwortest Entwicklung und Ergebnis deines eigenen Kundenportfolios (Richtwert 6–8 Accounts, ausschließlich unsere anspruchsvollsten Kunden). Das Tagesgeschäft liegt bei deinen AMs.
  • Du bist geschätzter Ansprechpartner auf der Senior-Entscheiderebene deiner Kunden und platzierst Themen aktiv in Kunden-Calls.
  • Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, entscheidest die Gegenmaßnahmen für dein Team und drehst gefährdete Accounts zurück in Wachstum.

Fachlichkeit & Prozesse

  • Du bist die fachliche Rückfallebene deines Teams — Klaviyo- und CRM-Architektur beherrschst du in der Breite.
  • Du coachst deine AMs fachlich und baust ihre Fähigkeiten auf, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten.
  • Du ownst einen unternehmensweiten Prozess rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden (z. B. Onboarding oder Offboarding).
  • Du stimmst Standards mit den anderen Key Account Managern ab und teilst Learnings aktiv.

Qualifikation

  1. Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM; davon idealerweise ein Teil in einer Agentur oder im E-Commerce.
  2. Tiefe Praxis in Klaviyo oder einem vergleichbaren System (Braze, Emarsys, Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Du hast komplexe Set-ups selbst gebaut, nicht nur begleitet.
  3. Erste Führungs- oder Mentoring-Erfahrung— du hast schon einmal Verantwortung für die Arbeit anderer getragen. Das muss nicht disziplinarisch gewesen sein.
  4. Sicherheit im Kundenkontakt auf Entscheiderebene— du hast schon mit Geschäftsführung oder Marketingleitung auf Augenhöhe gesprochen.
  5. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.
  6. Wohnsitz in Deutschland(steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlich zwingend).

Und was wir uns wünschen, aber nicht voraussetzen: Du gibst Feedback direkt und nimmst es genauso an. Du fragst nach dem Warum hinter den Zahlen eines Kunden. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand einen Prozess gibt.

Das ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • … du Führung als Beförderung siehst und nicht als eigenes Handwerk, das man lernen muss.
  • … du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.
  • … du eine fertige Struktur erwartest. Wir bauen sie gerade — mit dir.
  • … du unangenehme Gespräche aufschiebst. Ein Teil dieser Rolle besteht daraus.
  • … du im Homeoffice Struktur von außen brauchst. Wir arbeiten vollständig remote.

Benefits

  • Ein Team, das dir gehört — und die Freiheit, es zu formen.
  • Klarheit über deinen eigenen Weg: Wir haben eine ausformulierte Level-Matrix. Du siehst schwarz auf weiß, was auf deinem Level erwartet wird und was der nächste Schritt ist.
  • Halbjährliche Entwicklungsgespräche mit echtem Feedback statt Formularen. Gehalt wird bei uns nach System vergeben, nicht nach Verhandlungsgeschick.
  • Führungskräfte-Ausbildung mit einem externen Coach, der Führungsteams bei Meta und in mehreren Scale-ups aufgebaut hat.
  • 100 % remote, überall in Deutschland — plus regelmäßige Team-Offsites und Workations.
  • MacBook, bei Bedarf zusätzliche Hardware.
  • 50 € monatliche Sachbezugskarte nach der Probezeit.

Sechs Sätze, an denen wir uns messen lassen — auch als Führungskraft:

Be confident.

We don't need all the answers to start, just the grit to find them first.

Be curious.

Let's be obsessed to find the ‚Why‘ to unlock the ‚How‘.

Keep growing.

Treat yourself like brilliant software: ship a new upgrade every month.

Be accountable.

Openness over cosiness. We own our words.

Act entrepreneurial.

Don't just do tasks: own real business impact.

Over-deliver where it matters.

Promise what's possible. Then challenge these boundaries.

jobs.title: Content Ingestion Assistant – Night Shift
jobs.excerpt: Samba is a media intelligence company.  We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen.
jobs.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.

Live events don't wait for business hours.

The captures start at 6 p.m. Central European Time, most of them are US sports and events, and every one needs a human to press record. Right now that's three people in Poland and one in the US, and they're good. But contractors take days off, and every time they do, there's a hole in the schedule: weekend nights, mostly.

That hole is the job.

The team captures live and on-demand video from streaming platforms and turns it into clean, checked, ingested content. The volume of live events is going up, and the bench has to grow with it.

What you'd actually do

You start the live captures and then you watch them. When something breaks (the player stops, a VPN drops on our servers, the stream buffers), an alert fires and you fix it, following our internal guidelines.

No one is awake at 3 a.m. to hold your hand, so you learn the guidelines properly. It's easier than it sounds until a live event is on the line. Live events have a lot of rules, and missing one costs us the capture.

Between live events you handle long-form recordings: capturing on-demand content, editing the video when it needs it, running quality checks against our rules, and ingesting it into our database.

You'll work in our own web apps, jump onto remote machines, and use spreadsheets. Nobody arrives already knowing our platform, because you can't hire for it on the market. We teach it.

What you need to already be good at

    • English you can work in every day. It's the one hard requirement.

    • Comfortable with computers: remote machines, spreadsheets, learning new web tools fast.

    • Real office or data-entry experience. You've done repetitive, detail-heavy work before and didn't hate it.

    • Experience working remotely and staying on task with nobody watching. We have the tools to see your KPIs, but we'd rather not need them.

    • Reliable on nights and weekends. Saturday and Sunday are the priority.

      • Bonus points

      Content management or media operations · data entry at volume · video editing basics · troubleshooting streams, VPNs or recording tools · previous night-shift or follow-the-sun work.

      Not for you if

      • You want to do the work and forget the schedule. Weekend nights are the job.

      • You need someone checking in on you every hour. You'll be alone with the stream, and you're the one fixing it.

      • "Easy" sounds like a promise. A live capture that fails can't be redone.

The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About the Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Marketing, the Product Marketing Manager owns Trintech's Analyst Relations program, with a heavy emphasis on market and competitive research, and leads middle-of-funnel activities that deepen current customers' understanding of the features, functionality, and capabilities of Trintech's products. We are a Māori-owned adventure tourism business based in Rotorua, New Zealand, with more than 25 years in the tourism industry. We are looking for a capable, organised and tech-savvy remote team member who can support our digital marketing, social media, online presence and day-to-day operational administration. This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable moving between creative marketing tasks, technology, data and general business administration.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We’re looking for a Digital Marketing, AI & Operations Coordinator to become an extension of our New Zealand-based team. The role will have four main areas of responsibility:

● Social media and digital content

● Rotorua Combos website and digital channels

● Operational and administrative support

● Email marketing and AI integration. ● Facebook

● Instagram

● TikTok

● YouTube

● Monitor comments, messages and engagement where required.

● Assist with reporting on social media performance and identifying what content is working.

2. Website & Social Media (hibernated website)

Take responsibility for helping maintain and grow the digital presence of Rotorua Combos. This includes:

● Maintain and update the Rotorua Combos website.

● Keep product information, pricing, imagery and links current.

● Upload and update website content as required.

● Manage Rotorua Combos social media channels.

● Create and schedule social content promoting Rotorua experiences and combination products.

● Work with supplied content from tourism partners and operators.

● Support basic SEO and ensure website content is search-friendly.

● Identify outdated or incorrect content and proactively arrange updates.

● Help build Rotorua Combos into a useful digital platform for visitors planning activities in Rotorua.

3. Operational & Administrative Support

Provide remote administrative support to our operational team, including:

● Monitor and respond to allocated business emails.

● Assist with customer and agent enquiries.

● Complete basic invoicing and invoice administration.

● Enter and maintain accurate business data.

● Update our Master Report and other internal reporting systems.

● Assist with booking and customer data entry.

● Maintain organised digital records and files.

● Assist with online reviews and customer responses where required.

● Complete other routine administrative tasks that can be handled remotely.

● Identify repetitive administrative processes that could be simplified or automated. Accuracy and attention to detail are particularly important in this part of the role.

4. Email Marketing Support regular communication with customers, agents and our wider database. Responsibilities will include:

● Create and format email newsletters.

● Assist with planning a simple email marketing calendar.

● Prepare promotional emails for products, seasonal campaigns and special offers.

● Help segment customer and trade databases where appropriate.

● Maintain clean and accurate email lists.

● Track basic newsletter performance such as open rates, click-throughs and engagement.

● Repurpose existing website and social media content for email campaigns.

We actively want to use AI to make the business more efficient.

This person does not need to be an AI developer, but they should be confident using AI tools and interested in finding practical ways to integrate them into everyday business processes.

This may include:

● Use AI tools to assist with social media content and content repurposing.

● Assist with video, image and written-content workflows.

● Use AI to help draft and improve newsletters, blogs and website content.

● Identify repetitive administration that could be automated or streamlined.

● Help develop simple AI-assisted workflows for email, reporting, data entry and marketing.

● Research new AI tools that could save the team time.

● Document successful workflows so they can be repeated by the wider team.

● Look for practical ways to connect our existing systems and reduce double-handling.

We are particularly interested in someone who naturally thinks, “There must be a faster or smarter way to do this.

● Strong understanding of Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

● Strong written English.

You are a collaborative, strategic leader who thrives on building high-performing teams and delivering exceptional customer outcomes. Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Hebrew-English Video-Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Hebrew Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $15 - $17 per hour.

  • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.
  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.

  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.

  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.

  • Employee Referral Program.

  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.

  • Interpreter support.

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:

The HebrewVideo-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Hebrew and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.

  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.

  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.

  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inHebrew and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.

  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.

  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.

  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.

  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.

  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.

  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.

    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.

    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.

    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

  • Restricted brands:

    • Kaspersky products.

    • Huawei hardware.

  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.

  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.

  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.

  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.

  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.

  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.

  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for One Hundred Eighty (180) days from the posting date of May 18, 2026.

Should you require accommodations to complete this application and/or the interview process, please let us know immediately.

The Support Group & Peer Mentor Coordinator is responsible for coordinating Parkinson Canada's peer support programs, including support groups and peer mentoring initiatives. The Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for volunteer facilitators, peer mentors, and program participants, ensuring they have the training, resources, and support needed to provide positive peer support experiences.

Working closely with the Manager, Peer Support and Volunteer Engagement, the Coordinator supports the delivery, growth, and continuous improvement of peer support programs through volunteer recruitment, onboarding, training, mentor matching, and relationship management. The Coordinator provides regular updates on program activities, emerging needs, volunteer engagement, and participant feedback, and works collaboratively with the Manager to identify opportunities to strengthen volunteer capacity and enhance program effectiveness.

Position: Operations Coordinator
Company: Global Sports Travel (Chawla Group Pty Ltd)
Location: India (Remote)
Engagement Type: Full-Time and Exclusive (six-month performance review)
Reports To: Director
Department: Operations
ABOUT GLOBAL SPORTS TRAVEL
Global Sports Travel is a premium sports travel and hospitality company, offering official ticketing, curated hospitality packages and complete travel programmes across the world’s biggest sporting events. We provide official, verifiable access for corporate clients and private travellers at marquee events including the Ashes, the 150th Anniversary Test, all ICC tournaments – including the ICC Cricket World Cup 2027 – Formula 1 and Wimbledon. We are officially appointed and accredited within the programmes we sell, and everything we deliver runs through authorised channels – that is the foundation of our brand.
Global Sports Travel is part of Chawla Group Pty Ltd, an Australian company operating across Australia, India and international event markets.
ROLE PURPOSE
The Operations Coordinator owns the end-to-end delivery of the Company’s premium tickets, hospitality packages and travel programmes – from confirmed booking through to post-event reconciliation. The role coordinates clients, suppliers and internal systems so that every booking is delivered exactly as sold, on time and on margin, and acts as the operational backbone between the sales team, suppliers and clients across India and Australia. The role reports directly to the Founder & Director.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage all bookings across concurrent events, from confirmation through to post-event reconciliation
  • Act as the day-to-day operational contact for clients; respond to queries within 4 hours and escalate unresolved issues within 24 hours
  • Track payment milestones, trigger invoices on schedule and flag payment delays within 48 hours
  • Raise, revise and cancel client invoices in Xero on request from the sales team; issue invoice links, receipts and payment confirmations to clients the same day
  • Chase outstanding client payments to agreed deadlines and, where payment is not received, cancel invoices and release held inventory with written confirmation to the client
  • Process amendments, upsells and add-ons with accurate, real-time pricing updates
  • Confirm hotel, transport, hospitality and ticket allocations with suppliers against hard deadlines
  • Maintain supplier scorecards covering price, reliability and responsiveness
  • Reconcile supplier invoices against bookings and purchase orders; flag discrepancies and overspend immediately
  • Reconcile supplier booking acknowledgements (e.g. Cricket Australia Travel Office, AFL Event Office) against internal booking sheets and invoices; log booking reference numbers and flag any name, guest-count or category discrepancies the same day
  • Source and negotiate hotel room rates, inclusions and extras directly with properties in Australia and India for group and VIP itineraries, presenting options in a clear per-room, per-night comparison
  • Build and cost complete event packages – tickets, accommodation, flights, transfers and hospitality – for individual clients and groups, with correct room configurations and per-person pricing for two-, three- and multi-person bookings
  • Build day-by-day itineraries and issue client updates at 7 days and 48 hours before each event
  • Build and maintain hotel rooming lists and allocation trackers in Google Sheets, kept current and shared with management and suppliers
  • Prepare travel manifests, ticket delivery schedules, emergency contacts and contingency plans
  • Resolve live operational issues during events, including missed flights, no-shows and supplier failures
  • Maintain accurate, same-day records of all bookings and transactions in Zoho CRM and Xero
  • Provide weekly pipeline, delivery and cash-collection reporting to management
  • Track post-event profitability and flag margin erosion by cost line
  • Support the sales team with sale-to-delivery handovers, delivery proofs and client references
  • Research and compile event, ticketing and hospitality options (availability, categories, pricing) across cricket, AFL, NRL, rugby and other codes, delivering verified comparisons with a recommendation – not raw search or AI output
  • Draft client-facing and marketing collateral (booking confirmations, package summaries, press releases) that accurately reflects the Company's official appointments and brand
COMPENSATION AND TERMS OF ENGAGEMENT
  • All-inclusive monthly fee, commensurate with experience and confirmed at offer stage, payable against a monthly invoice
  • The fee is inclusive of all costs; the contractor is responsible for their own taxes, equipment, phone and internet
  • No additional allowances or reimbursements unless approved by the Company in writing in advance
  • The engagement is full-time and exclusive to the Company for its duration; no concurrent employment, contracting or client engagements are permitted
  • Performance and remuneration review at six months against agreed KPIs
  • Opportunities for domestic and international travel to major sporting events, with pre-approved expenses covered by the Company
Global Sports Travel is an equal opportunity employer and makes engagement decisions based on merit and qualifications, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status or any other basis prohibited under applicable law.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Sports Management or a related field
  • Minimum 3–5 years’ hands-on experience in travel, hospitality, events, ticketing or high-touch client service operations – this is not a trainee role
  • Proven experience building travel and hospitality packages – combining tickets, accommodation, flights, transfers and hospitality into priced packages for singles, couples and groups of two, three or more, including correct room configuration (single, twin, double, triple) and per-person vs per-room costing
  • Fluent in travel-industry terminology and conventions – hotel room and occupancy types, meal plans (RO/BB/HB/FB), check-in/out and release dates, cancellation policies; airline fare classes, PNRs, ticket rules, baggage and change conditions; and ticketing categories and allocations
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple suppliers, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets – lookups, pivot tables, data validation, conditional formatting and error-checking – with a track record of building accurate, duplicate-free trackers and reconciliations
  • Demonstrated working proficiency in Xero (invoicing, credit notes, receipts, reconciliation) and Zoho CRM (pipeline, workflows, reporting) – required, not preferred
  • Experience with supplier booking portals, hotel reservation systems and ticketing platforms (e.g. official event travel offices, Ticketmaster, GDS or bedbank systems)
  • Working knowledge of workflow automation and integration tools (Zoho Flow, Zapier, Google Apps Script or similar) to reduce manual data entry between CRM, accounting and spreadsheets (desirable)
  • Confident using AI tools as an accelerator, with every output verified against source data, analysed and accompanied by a recommendation before it is submitted
  • Willingness to work Australian business hours from India, including evenings, weekends and holidays around major events
SKILLS
  • Obsessive attention to detail – names, dates, amounts and deadlines
  • Technically fluent – comfortable owning systems, spreadsheets and data flows end to end, and quick to learn new platforms without hand-holding
  • Checks before sending – every invoice, list and summary is verified against source data; errors that reach a client or supplier are not acceptable
  • Calm and decisive under pressure; events do not wait
  • Hands-on and self-sufficient – spots gaps and fixes them without being asked
  • Discretion and professionalism when handling premium clients and confidential pricing
  • Strong organisational discipline; reports hard numbers, not hopeful ones
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-value, deadline-driven environment
