jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.excerpt: Driftrock is hiring a Head of Product to set the direction for our platform and lead the team building the products that help automotive brands and dealers deliver the world's best experience for finding, buying and owning a car.
jobs.description:
Driftrock is hiring a Head of Product to set the direction for our platform and lead the team building the products that help automotive brands and dealers deliver the world's best experience for finding, buying and owning a car.

Quick facts

  • Team: Product, leading our Product team and working daily with Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Commercial
  • Product: The whole Driftrock platform across Capture, Convert and Connect, plus our internal tooling
  • Reports to: CEO
  • Direct reports: Our Product Manager(s), with room to grow the team
  • Location: Fully remote, UK or abroad, with a few hours of daily UK overlap
  • Contract: Full time, permanent
  • Salary: £85,000 to £105,000, plus share options
  • Start date: As soon as you're ready

Why this role exists

Driftrock powers customer acquisition for some of the world's biggest automotive brands and dealers, including BMW, BYD, Mercedes-Benz and Volvo. Since 2013 we've built a platform that captures enquiries from every channel a car buyer touches, validates them in real time, nurtures them through messaging journeys, and measures everything through to the vehicle sale.

That work enables billions of euros in vehicle sales every year and makes buying a car a better experience for consumers.

The next 12 months are set to be the biggest in our history. We're preparing to launch our boldest products yet, growing across Europe, bringing our platform to more customers, and putting AI at the heart of how our products work.

This calls for a product leader who can set a clear direction, make the big calls on where we focus, and build a product team that turns strategy into shipped, measured outcomes. As our Product team scales, this role will take increasing ownership of product direction and decision-making from the CEO. Reporting to the CEO, you'll shape the future of the platform and help define how car buyers and car sellers connect.

What you'll own

You'll be accountable for Driftrock's product strategy and the results it delivers. That means deciding why and what we build across the whole platform and our internal tooling, leading and growing the product team that delivers it, and making sure every major bet ships and moves the metrics that matter to our customers and our business. You'll work closely with the CEO as ownership of day-to-day product leadership transitions into the Product team.

*Your first 90 days*

  • By day 30: you've met customers, partners and every team, used the platform end to end, got to know the Product team, and mapped the current landscape: our products, how brands and dealers use them, how product work flows today, and where the biggest opportunities sit.
  • By day 60: you've agreed a product strategy and 12-month roadmap with the CEO and leadership team, set up a clear product operating rhythm with Engineering and Design, and agreed goals and development plans with each person in your team.
  • By day 90: discovery to delivery runs on a predictable cadence, the whole company can see what's coming and why, your first measurable product win has shipped, and you have a plan for how the product team grows next. You and the CEO are aligned on the direction for the next stage of Driftrock's product growth.

What you'll be doing

  • Set the product vision and strategy for the Driftrock platform, turning company goals into a clear, evidence-backed roadmap the whole company understands.
  • Lead, coach and grow the Product team, setting high standards for discovery, decision-making and delivery, and hiring well as the team expands. We're open to strong Senior or Lead Product Managers who are ready to step up into broader product leadership.
  • Make the big prioritisation calls across customer-facing products and internal tooling, balancing customer value, commercial impact and technical health so Engineering always works on what matters most.
  • Take new products from first discovery to market, each with a clear launch plan and success measures.
  • Solution design alongside Product Managers and other stakeholders. We are a small team, so this Head of Product role is a chance to be hands-on whilst leading and growing the team.
  • Stay close to customers, spending time with brands, dealers and partners every month so real evidence shapes every major decision.
  • Build a product operating model that scales, with shared rituals, metrics and tools that help a remote team move quickly and stay aligned.
  • Partner with Commercial, Marketing and Customer Success on pricing, packaging, positioning and launches, so what we build lands well and grows revenue.
  • Report on product performance to the CEO and board, showing clearly what we shipped, what it changed and what we learned.

What you'll bring

  • A track record of leading product for a B2B SaaS platform, ideally combined with experience in consumer product or product-led growth, with a strategy that measurably grew revenue, retention or a core customer metric.
  • Experience managing and developing product managers, and building a team where people do their best work. Strong Senior or Lead Product Managers ready to take this next step are encouraged to apply.
  • Evidence of taking a new product or major bet from first discovery through to a successful launch.
  • Strong product judgement: you make clear, well-reasoned calls on what not to build as well as what to build, and bring people with you.
  • A habit of regular customer discovery, and comfort combining customer insight with product and commercial data to make decisions. You have a strong experimental and data-driven mindset.
  • The ability to work closely with engineering and design leaders on technical trade-offs, sequencing and delivery.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, from a one-page strategy to a board update, in a remote, async-friendly team.
  • Comfort being hands-on when it helps, from writing a brief to digging into the data yourself. You take a collaborative, pragmatic approach to leadership and are comfortable getting into the details when needed.
  • Experience working in a smaller, fast-growing company rather than exclusively in a large, highly structured enterprise environment.

Bonus points

  • Experience with marketing technology, lead generation, messaging or CRM-adjacent products.
  • Knowledge of the automotive or e-mobility industry, especially how brands and dealers work together.
  • Experience shipping AI-powered products, or using AI tools heavily across discovery and delivery.
  • Experience launching products into new markets.
  • Experience shaping pricing and packaging for a SaaS product

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We value different perspectives, backgrounds and career paths, and we're interested in what you could bring to the role, not just whether you've followed a traditional route into product leadership.

Why Driftrock

Driftrock's mission is to become the world-leading automotive and e-mobility marketing software platform, and help accelerate the transition to clean transport.

We work with some of the world's biggest brands, including BMW, BYD, Mercedes-Benz and Volvo, and partner with the world's leading platforms, including Meta, Google, mobile.de and Auto Trader.

We've been building since 2013, and our work enables billions of euros in vehicle sales every year.

We're a close, fully remote team of 45 people across engineering, design, customer success, performance and commercial, spread across the world.

That means your work has a real, visible impact on our product, our culture and how we operate.

We're at the cutting edge of marketing technology, with plenty of room to unlock value from data and to help speed up the shift to electric vehicles.

How we work is shaped by four values:

  • We care: about our team, our customers, and the people who see the marketing messages that we power. Work isn't done until we can prove it's useful to both the consumer and the customer.
  • Be that person: if something needs fixing, fix it. It's never someone else's problem.
  • People-first: we put people at the core of everything, and never compromise security or privacy for results.
  • Be better today than you were yesterday: we bake learning and continuous improvement into everything we do, for ourselves and our customers.

In practice, this looks like weekly Monday Showcases where we share what we're learning, regular retros, a budget to attend the courses and conferences that grow you, Donut coffee pairings to stay connected, and an annual company Summit that brings the whole global team together in person.

What's in it for you

We're remote-first and flexible about how and where you work, with co-working space available if you want it. Alongside your salary:

  • Share options in Driftrock, on founder-friendly, tax-efficient EMI terms, including the option to retain vested options after leaving (at board discretion).
  • Comprehensive Vitality health cover: medical, dental, vision, hearing, mental-health support and therapy, cancer cover, a free Headspace subscription and Vitality rewards.
  • 24 to 28 days' holiday (24 + 1 extra each year, capped at 28), plus bank holidays.
  • Pension contributions, life assurance (3x salary) and income protection.
  • Electric car salary-sacrifice scheme (Octopus): save up to ~40%, with insurance, servicing and a charging perk included.
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.
  • A learning budget for books, courses and conferences, plus time for personal goals.
  • Perks and discounts via CharlieHR, and a BMW Group employee discount programme.

Outside the UK?

We're remote-first and hire globally. While some UK-specific benefits are delivered differently abroad, we strive for genuine parity. Wherever you are, the standard package includes a comprehensive health plan, pension contributions, paid time off including local bank holidays, share options, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, a learning budget, and our flexible working culture. International team members are employed compliantly via an Employer of Record (Remote.com).

Our hiring process

  1. A short intro call with our team.
  2. A conversation with our CEO about the role and how you lead the product.
  3. A live, interactive workshop or pairing session based on a real Driftrock product challenge, rather than a take-home task.
  4. A final conversation with the team, including Engineering and Product.

Inclusion at Driftrock

Driftrock is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background, identity and life experience, and we're building a team that reflects the people our marketing reaches. We don't make decisions based on age, disability, gender, gender identity, marital status, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process to do your best, just let us know, and we're glad to help.

We will not be considering recruitment agencies for this role.

By applying for this job you give us permission to store your data on our secure applicant tracking system and to contact you about Driftrock job opportunities. We process your data for recruitment purposes only and keep it until this role is filled, after which we will delete it or, with your agreement, keep it for similar future roles for up to 12 months. See our privacy policy at driftrock.com/privacy-policy for how we comply with GDPR, including how to access, correct, delete or restrict the data we hold. You can lodge a complaint with the UK supervisory authority (the Information Commissioner's Office), or contact our DPO for any concerns.

The role also leads the end-to-end development process in partnership with internal teams and franchisees, including market planning, site approvals, design, remodels for existing markets, and first store openings in new markets.

Key Accountabilities Include:

Market development strategy and pipeline management

  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of target markets, contiguous markets, and expansion priorities in existing markets.
  • Develop market entry strategies and multiyear development roadmaps, including format strategy by location type, asset type, and site configuration.
  • Monitor external conditions that impact development decisions, including macroeconomic conditions, foreign exchange implications, trade barriers, and real estate market dynamics

Partner sourcing, diligence, and governance

  • Identify, source, and qualify new brand partners for international growth.
  • Lead partner diligence across operational capability and financial capacity to fund initial and ongoing development.
  • Prepare and present new franchisee applications and partner recommendations to the Executive Review Committee.
  • Build and maintain relationships with banks, real estate brokerages, third party brokers, and relevant industry associations to represent the brand and expand the partner pipeline.
  • Direct company participation in international franchise expos, including development of sales materials and collateral, and hands on participation as needed by geography.

Development agreements and development obligations

  • Lead negotiation of development agreements with new and existing partners, aligning obligations to market potential and partner capability.
  • Ensure existing franchisees meet or exceed development obligations, and drive actions when commitments drift.
  • Partner with the ADQ Legal department to ensure development and legal processes are followed, and that local registration and compliance obligations are met.

Development execution, real estate, and build enablement

  • Lead the international development process across site selection and approval, closure approval, renewals, and franchisee approvals, consistent with company process.
  • Lead design, real estate and site selection, and construction enablement for international franchisees, in partnership with internal stakeholders and franchisees.
  • Direct leadership of project management for first sites in new markets, including opening readiness and coordination across functions and the franchisee.
  • Coordinate site selection work, including in market site visits when required, and preparation of site approval reviews supported by analysis and market conditions.

Franchise finance and transactions

  • Lead the international development finance scope, assessing franchisee financial health, capital structures, and growth readiness.
  • Partner with new franchisees to build business plans and capital and financial models, and to align development pace to returns and funding realities.
  • Lead transactional work tied to development outcomes, including acquisitions, divestitures, investments, and workouts, coordinating with internal partners as required.

Fees and cross functional coordination

  • Assist with collection of area and store fees across international markets, working with internal partners as appropriate.
  • Coordinate effectively with internal departments to deliver outcomes on time, including Concept Development, Marketing, Supply Chain, R and D, and Legal.

DECISION RIGHTS AND ACCOUNTABILITY

  • Accountable for building the market and partner pipeline, and for bringing partner recommendations and supporting diligence to the Executive Review Committee.
  • Accountable for negotiation of development agreement terms, and for ensuring internal legal and compliance processes are followed before execution.
  • Accountable for running the development approval process (site approvals, closures, renewals, franchisee approvals) and for escalating decisions that require committee or executive approval per company process.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

  • Higher quality partner pipeline, with partners that have the operational depth and financial capacity to develop and sustain growth.
  • Signed development agreements that match market potential and partner capability, with clear obligations and enforceable follow-through.
  • First sites in new markets opened with disciplined planning and cross functional coordination, without avoidable surprises in real estate, build, or compliance.
  • Franchisee capital plans and growth readiness assessed early, and development plans adjusted before problems show up in execution.
  • Existing development obligations tracked and enforced, with early intervention when performance drifts.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Special projects as assigned.

jobs.title: Threat Researcher II (Remote, IRE)
jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role

The Threat Analyst joins the Emerging Threats and Security Validation team within the CrowdStrike Malware Research Center (MRC). This team plays a critical role in understanding today's threat landscape, identifying gaps in Falcon's detection capabilities, and helping improve CrowdStrike's protection through threat research, automation, AI, and machine learning.

Working closely with Threat Research, Engineering, Data Science, and Red Team teams, you'll investigate emerging threats, validate detection coverage, and translate technical research into product improvements that better protect our customers. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems while making a direct impact on our products.

What You'll Do:

  • Research and analyse emerging malware and cyber threats to understand how they impact our customers.

  • Investigate malware across the full attack lifecycle (adversary kill chain) to ensure Falcon detects and stops threats at every stage.

  • Distinguish genuine threats from background noise by analysing data from multiple internal and external sources.

  • Validate and improve CrowdStrike's detection capabilities by identifying gaps and working with engineering teams to strengthen our protections.

  • Support external security testing and certification programmes (such as AV-Test, AV-Comparatives, and SE Labs) by analysing test results and helping address any missed detections.

  • Respond to newly discovered threats by performing technical investigations and recommending the best approach for detection and prevention.

  • Partner with Threat Research, Engineering, Red Team, and Machine Learning teams to translate research into product improvements.

  • Help design and improve automation that reduces manual effort and accelerates threat analysis.

  • Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering and response teams to enable faster and more effective action.

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of Falcon by combining malware research, automation, AI, and machine learning to improve customer protection.

What You'll Need:

  • Strong understanding of disassembly and structured programming principles.

  • Deep knowledge of at least one major operating system and its internals to support behaviour-based analysis.

  • Strong understanding of the adversary kill chain and attacker behaviour, with experience applying red team methodologies to validate defensive coverage. Certifications such as Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) are desirable.

  • Experience collaborating with engineering teams to turn research into production capabilities.

  • Ability to develop small automation or scripting projects to solve immediate technical challenges.

  • Experience contributing to public security testing programmes (such as AV-Test, AV-Comparatives, or SE Labs) is a plus.

  • Experience working with large datasets and tools such as Splunk, Elasticsearch, or Kibana is a plus.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

About the Malware Research Center:

The CrowdStrike Malware Research Center is the core of Falcon’s malware detection and response capabilities. The team has a focus on understanding the threat landscape and sets the target for what Falcon should be identifying and preventing. Additionally, the MRC is responsible for understanding our capabilities, and mapping how well our machine learning and behavioral protection capabilities are doing against those threats. Where there is a gap, the MRC takes action to improve our detection stance, and improve our overall protection story. MRC also performs pathfinding research to enable technology development using innovation, prototyping and bleeding edge machine learning to support our flagship Falcon product. There are many parts of CrowdStrike working towards protecting customer environments, and the MRC works across all of them to ensure we are on target and providing the best protection for our current Threat landscape.

Emerging Threats and Security Validation Team:

Leading the charge for understanding the activity of malware today is the Emerging Threats and Security Validation team. With a focus on malware research, the primary role of the team is to understand the threats and malware that are affecting our customer’s businesses. The challenge is the enormous scale of malware today and the sheer number of samples required to be addressed, which requires a more creative approach than traditional Anti-Virus research. Using the data amassed from CrowdStrike’s capabilities and products, we take a holistic view of the threat landscape and identify the emerging threats that are likely to affect our business in the short to medium term. Human efforts are bolstered by automation, AI enrichment, and machine learning to protect our customers when they need it most.

About Perle

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Perle is hiring a freelance transcriptionist fluent in Welsh for a remote transcription role. This is a paid contract position open to qualified contributors worldwide.

1. Role Overview

You will transcribe 2-speaker, channel-separated audio recordings in Welsh. Each file has two clearly separated speakers. Your job is to produce a clean, accurate, sequentially ordered transcript with speaker labels and timestamps.

2. What You Will Do

  • Listen to 2-speaker audio recordings in Welsh
  • Type out what each speaker says, accurately and in full
  • Label each speaker turn as Speaker 1 or Speaker 2, matching the audio channel
  • Add timestamps at the start of each speaker turn (format: HH:MM:SS)
  • Ensure transcripts are sequential with no unexplained gaps

3. Requirements

  • Native or near-native fluency in Welsh (spoken and written)
  • Strong written Welsh — accurate spelling, punctuation, and grammar
  • Ability to work independently and meet daily output targets
  • Access to a computer with a stable internet connection
  • Availability for at least 4 hours per day
  • Prior transcription experience is a plus but not required — all contributors must pass a qualification test

4. Quality Standard

  • Word Error Rate (WER) of 5% or less on all delivered transcripts
  • Zero speaker label errors — Speaker 1 must always correspond to Channel 1
  • Transcripts reviewed on a rolling basis; feedback provided promptly
  • Files that do not meet the quality threshold will be returned for correction

Job Title:NetSuite Functional Administrator

  • Department: IT
  • Location: Remote / Offshore

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled, execution-focused NetSuite Technical Administrator to drive the development, configuration, and day-to-day optimization of our NetSuite ERP ecosystem. This is a strict "hands-on-keyboard" role requiring a candidate who can pivot seamlessly between writing production-ready SuiteScript, developing midmarket integrations, and resolving complex functional tickets.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in a SaaS environment, with a proven track record of building automated billing schedules, setting up payment/EFT gateways, and directly building and maintaining bi-directional integrations between Salesforce and NetSuite via Celigo.

Key Responsibilities

SuiteScript Development & System Customization

  • Custom Code Deployment: Design, develop, test, and deploy production-ready SuiteScripts (Client, User Event, Map/Reduce, Suitelet, Restlets, and Workflow Action scripts) to automate business processes.
  • Form & Workflow Engineering: Customize NetSuite forms, fields, subtabs, and custom records. Configure multi-level, role-based approval workflows with complex status transitions and automated email notifications.
  • Release & Deployments: Manage code and configuration migrations across environments using the SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) and sandbox accounts.
  • Documents & Templates: Design and develop Advanced PDF/HTML templates and custom email templates for multi-subsidiary invoices, statements, and forms, consolidating functional printouts into clean, uniform layouts.

Order-to-Cash (O2C) & SaaS Billing Automation

  • SaaS Billing Architecture: Develop and automate recurring billing processes, standard/custom billing schedules, and usage-based billing workflows driven by external platform data.
  • Payment & EFT Gateways: Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot NetSuite payment instruments and integrations (e.g., Fortis, Stripe, or similar gateways). Investigate daily production payment failures, gateway declines, and validation errors.
  • Electronic Payments: Own the EFT Payment SuiteApp setup. Configure bank formats, payment files, entity details, and handle Payment File Administration (PFA) error resolution.

Core Integrations (Salesforce & Celigo)

  • Celigo Development: Directly develop, configure, and deploy bi-directional data integrations between Salesforce CRM and NetSuite utilizing Celigo (Integrator.io).
  • Pipeline Monitoring & Optimization: Actively monitor integration flows, map data fields, write transformation rules, and debug sync errors to maintain absolute data integrity across systems.

Technical Support & Operations

  • Ticket Queue Ownership: Own and resolve daily technical support tickets, diagnosing script failures, workflow bottlenecks, and transaction processing issues.
  • Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Maintenance: Maintain the technical configurations supporting purchasing, vendor approvals, and automated 3-way matching.
  • Data Hygiene: Minimize data entry errors by leveraging automated validation rules and executing clean data modifications via mass CSV imports.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on NetSuite administration and development experience within a SaaS or recurring revenue business model.
  • Technical Mastery: * Strong proficiency in SuiteScript 1.0/2.x and native SuiteFlow.
    • Direct experience developing and deploying integrations via Celigo (specifically Salesforce-to-NetSuite).
    • Hands-on experience with the NetSuite EFT Payment SuiteApp and merchant payment gateways.
  • Certifications (Preferred): NetSuite Certified Financial Associate, BI and Reporting Associate, or Administrator.
  • Execution Style: A builder mindset. You thrive on technical execution, clean documentation, unit testing, and taking direct ownership of the system's operational heartbeat.

Career Growth Opportunities: Senior NetSuite Functional Admin; NetSuite Business Analyst

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritise candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

What is an Employer of Record (EOR)

An Employer of Record (EOR) is a service provider that allows companies to legally hire and work with employees in foreign countries without establishing their own legal entity in that country. This is made possible through a legal arrangement where the EOR establishes its own legal entity in the country and hires employees on behalf of the client company. This arrangement offers a viable solution for companies that wish to expand their global reach without investing in setting up a legal entity in every country where they operate.

About the Role

As an HR Advisor, you will play a pivotal role in supporting Rippling’s Employer of Record (EOR) service across APAC. You will partner with customers to hire and manage employees across multiple countries, guiding them through the employee lifecycle—from onboarding to off-boarding—while navigating employee relations, claims, and compliance considerations.

This role is regionally scoped rather than country-specific, requiring you to quickly ramp on new countries with the support of internal training and resources. You will be expected to independently research and apply country-specific requirements using Rippling’s internal knowledge base, SOPs, and tools.

Additionally, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine workflows for hiring, onboarding, and transitions, ensuring Rippling delivers a seamless, technology-driven HR solution at scale.

This is a unique opportunity to be a key contributor to Rippling’s growth across APAC.

Key Responsibilities

Regional HR Advisory Support

  • Provide HR advisory support across multiple countries within a region, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and employment practices.
  • Apply existing frameworks and SOPs to new countries, identifying gaps and escalating risks where needed.

Policy and Procedure Development

  • Draft and implement compliance-driven policies and SOPs across multiple jurisdictions, including leave management, performance management, investigations, terminations, and statutory processes.

Employee Relations and Risk Mitigation

  • Manage complex employee relations issues across countries, including terminations, leave, and regulatory risk scenarios.
  • Assess risk in unfamiliar jurisdictions by leveraging internal resources and guidance.
  • Represent Rippling before relevant government authorities where required, including for labor reconciliation, statutory filings, and compliance-related matters

Workflow and System Setup

  • Partner with product, engineering, and compliance teams to configure and test workflows for hiring, onboarding, transitions, terminations, and statutory benefits across multiple countries.

Customer- and Employee-Focused Support

  • Respond to customer and employee inquiries across a range of countries, delivering accurate and timely guidance.
  • Develop scalable resources (e.g., help center content, templates, policies) to support regional operations.

Knowledge Development and Scaling

  • Rapidly build expertise in new countries using internal documentation, training, and self-directed research.
  • Contribute to improving internal knowledge bases and documentation for broader team use.

Process Optimization

  • Design and refine scalable processes that support regional delivery and reduce country-specific dependencies.

POA Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated Power of Attorney (POA) for relevant entities, including signing documentation and ensuring compliance with local requirements.
  • Represent Rippling before relevant government authorities where required, including for labor reconciliation, statutory filings, and compliance-related matters

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of HR Advisory, consulting, or internal HR experience in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience supporting multiple countries: Strong knowledge of employment law and HR practices in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and Australia are highly desirable.
  • Proven experience supporting Malaysia, with exposure to employment law, employee relations, and HR processes in other countries will be required for this position.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply HR practices in new countries, including navigating ambiguity and unfamiliar regulations.
  • Strong ability to self-serve and research, leveraging internal knowledge bases, SOPs, and tools to find accurate information.
  • Solid understanding of core HR fundamentals (employee lifecycle, ER, compliance), even if country-specific depth varies.
  • Experience managing employee claims (e.g., leave, disability, workers’ compensation, grievances) in at least one jurisdiction.
  • Proficiency with HRIS systems and comfort navigating multiple tools and workflows.
  • Ability to interpret pay statements, understand payroll basics, and perform simple calculations in multiple countries.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with attention to detail and ability to prioritize across multiple countries.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Professional working proficiency in English; additional regional languages are a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting HR processes across multiple regions (EMEA, APAC, AMER).
  • Experience in EOR, global mobility, or international HR operations.
  • Experience with benefits and pension administration across multiple countries.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. jobs.title: Senior Medical Director, Product Safety Physician Lead
jobs.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

The Senior Medical Director serves as the Lead Product Safety Physician for multiple or large complex strategically important developmental programs (often multi-indication) and creates and maintains a single interpretation of global safety data for developmental. With the support of Safety Physicians and Safety Scientists identifies and manages the documentation and communication of safety concerns and together with teams engaged in BeOne sponsored studies, ensures the safety of patients.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Accountable for oversight of benefit/risk safety profile of allocated products through the product life cycle with a principle focus on early development

  • Actively leads and enhances knowledge of safety profiles for allocated products, including both BeOne and competitor products

  • Identifies and actively leads management of safety concerns for developmental and approved BeOne products

  • Actively leads Development and, as required, Medical Affairs product teams in the identification of, and handling of product safety concerns

  • Governance:

  • Chairs Safety Management Team (SMT) meetings for assigned products, reviews SMT materials, develops & represents safety perspective in SMT meetings

  • Represents the SMT and participates in Company Safety Committee (CSC) meetings, support meeting preparations, develop & proposes review topics/ CSC agenda items

  • Actively leads communication of recommendations to labeling group/other stakeholders

  • Actively participates in meetings as required in External Safety Monitoring Committees (DMC) meetings through provision and review of safety data, insights and leadership and provides input to DMC Charters

  • Actively leads Internal Safety Monitoring Committees (SMC) meetings (e.g., dose escalation safety meeting) & supports as needed. Provides input to safety charters

Product Labeling, as Required for Work on Later Development Programs

  • Actively leads communication of CSC recommendations for labeling amendments, participates in Labeling Working Group meetings, leads communication of Safety outcomes to relevant stakeholders

  • Actively leads the development and maintenance of the Company Core Safety Information (CCSI), proposes edits and manages approval of amendments

  • Presents the CCSI to the labeling committee, contributes viewpoint to CCDS development, and reviews company core data sheet

  • Provides safety insights to development of Package Insert and Labeling Updates, develops labeling update impact summaries for use by RA, develops labeling prose text updates, based on internal aggregated reports

Issues Management

  • Leads and manages escalation of potential issues to the SMT, ensures internal notification and provides updates

  • Leads and develops strategy for issue management and facilitates internal approval of plans

  • Leads the review of issue data and closure on recommendations, leads the drafting of an issue response document, reviews, and manages approval of issue response documentation and responses

  • Leads the formulation of a rapid response procedure, triage of potential issues to safety committee, executes Crisis Management response plan, reviews ongoing issue and plan

  • Reviews regulatory inquiry to lead strategizing the nature of response, best course of action and determines data specifications, Reviews relevant data required for response

  • Leads responses and contributes to formal response provided to regulatory agencies, reviews draft response, and manages approval of response

  • Actively leads the incorporation of latest updates and findings from ongoing pharmacovigilance and epidemiological analysis

  • Actively leads BeOne safety in face-to-face regulatory meetings

  • Actively leads and develops an evaluation of safety enquiries (Internal, External, HCP & consumer), leads the assignment of response drafting responsibility, determines data required for response, reviews response data & drafts response and manages approval of responses

  • Guides and leads medical review of SAEs and provides immediate input to escalated reports, determines, and executes further escalation within BeOne as needed

Commercialization Support and Liaison with Other Functions

  • Leads and develops strategic plans for safety differentiation of BeOne products, provides training BeOne employees on product safety profiles/issues, provides input into commercial publications strategy, reviews publications, including abstracts, manuscripts, and speaker presentations, provides input for potential in-licensing opportunities as requested

  • Leads product liaison for BeOne functions (Legal, Bus Dev, Operations, Marketing, etc.), executes appropriate communication of safety data and interpretation to BeOne and external parties, globally, facilitates communication with country office medical directors as required.

  • Leads EU/International Safety Communication & Co-ordination training to BeOne employees on product safety issues and profiles

Trial Safety Support

  • Accountable for the collaborative authoring of safety content in clinical trial documentation, including but not limited to protocols, IBs, and ICFs. Able to collaborate and advise on technical aspects of trial design including escalation and expansion design, DLT criteria, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and risk monitoring and management aspects.

  • Accountable for safety data, reviews and provides advice on Safety Endpoints, safety related inclusion and exclusion criteria data to capture during trial, key review activities and timing, reviews and leads input on product program wide safety issues, protocols, and protocol updates. Expected to demonstrate and model responsive and collaborative medical review of ICSRs and aggregate safety reviews with cross functional colleagues.

  • Accountable for the content of safety sections of the Development Safety Update Report (DSUR), reviews and approves

  • Accountable for development and maintenance of RSIs, contributes to the safety sections of the IB, ICF and updates and manages any needs to reconsent subjects in ongoing trials based on emergent safety data assessment

  • Actively leads and develops expectations of expected, anticipated statistical analyses to run over trial for the SAP and provides product program wide input on safety statistical elements required for analysis

  • Accountable for data requirement recommendations and safety section for clinical data management plan for capture during clinical trials, supports the review and update of data management plan based on updates to integrated safety viewpoint during trial

  • Accountable for the determination of safety data required for capture in CRFs during clinical trials, reviews and provides product program wide input to CRFs

  • Leads the formulation safety criteria and review of study specific medical monitoring plans

  • Participates in investigator meetings, as needed, accountable for product safety profile and reviews, approves and updates of safety presentation content

Developmental Product Safety Monitoring and Surveillance (Protocol Specific)

  • Accountable for output/summary report for inclusion into clinical, filing

  • Accountable for daily, weekly, and monthly review of SAEs and abnormal labs, protocol specific review of aggregate SAEs and specific analysis of aggregate CTDB (AE tables, shift tables, listings)

Submission Filing Safety Support, as Required for Work on Later Development Programs

  • Proactively, reviews and interprets study safety data, supports Clinical Study Report narrative generation, leads the interpretation-based safety sections of reports, reviews draft report

  • Accountable for drafting the safety sections of the Summary of Clinical Safety and ISS

  • Leads 120-day update plans and activities

Extra-Departmental Liaison & Co-ordination

  • Represents and promotes safety at the product development team as core team member, contributes to development strategy for allocated compounds

  • Leads the preparations for and attends clinical team meetings

  • Actively leads contribution to development of differentiation of BeOne products, provides training guidance to marketing training materials, reviews, and contributes to marketing materials

Internal Global Patient Safety Department Development Interfaces

  • Leads GPS product co-ordination, chairs product group meetings across GPS

Pharmacovigilance

  • Leads and manages safety PV processes for BeOne and competitor products

  • Accountable for the development of Product Safety Strategy and the writing and maintenance of the Safety Surveillance Plans

  • Actively leads safety Issue Assessment and documentation, develop determination of issue scope, execute risk assessment

  • Accountable for development and update summary of competitor safety profile labelling, FOI, and issues

  • Accountable for development and maintenance of product safety profiles and develops Events of Interest

  • Presents data at scheduled and ad hoc product safety reviews, chair review meetings, identifies safety issues for escalation to SMT, determine if a safety concern needs escalation to management, facilitates closure on recommendations

  • Accountable for development and maintenance of updates to Product Surveillance Plans

  • Actively leads the scope, strategy, and content of responses to HA assessment reports, contribute to authoring of relevant sections

  • As required for work on later development programs:

    • Actively leads the definition of Risk Management Plan (RMP) drivers & content, reviews core RMP & local RMPs (or REMS) and leads execution of RMP elements, documentation of evidence of RMP execution, evaluates potential risks for evidence of risk confirmation and leads recommendations for RMP/REMS update

    • Actively leads the development of safety Post Approval Commitments (PAC) proposals, facilitates the design of PAC proposed safety study, executes PAC studies

    • Leads and manages the definition of events of interest, defines case follow-up needs

    • Accountable for development and implementation of product launch plans

  • Accountable for development of a publication plan, contributes to draft papers

  • Contributes to and promotes the development of a global Pharmacoepidemiology (PE) strategy

Compliance, Standards, Training & Project Management:

  • Actively leads the evaluation of current processes and assesses alignment with regulatory expectations, guidelines, mandates for regulatory inspections

  • Trains and mentors Safety Physicians and Safety Scientists

  • Actively leads and maintains an environment of continuous improvement within the team and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives across GPS

Required Qualifications

  • MD (or internationally recognized equivalent) plus accredited residency, with 6 + years’ pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry experience in Clinical Research, Clinical Development and 4 + years' experience in safety in Phase 1 and Phase 2

  • Accredited fellowship with 1-year clinical experience with patients in a relevant therapeutic area specialty, with significant knowledge of general medicine is preferred.

  • Experience in oncology in the preapproval space is preferred

  • Prior matrix management team experience

  • Prior experience as a product safety physician

  • Pharmaceutical product development experience, including individual study design and filing plans.

  • Experienced in global regulatory requirements for pharmacovigilance

  • Appropriate experience with Regulatory Agency and KOL interactions

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This position may have safety scientists/physicians reporting to them depending on the program / portfolio being led. The Senior Medical Director serves as Product Safety Physician Lead for multiple or large complex strategically important developmental programs. Works closely with the other Safety Science and Epidemiology Physicians and Safety Scientists as part of a flexible matrix team to conduct robust safety assessments and safety risk management activities, based on ICH standards, for developmental product safety upon which marketed product safety surveillance may be based. The Senior Medical Director is expected to mentor and develop junior staff and offer them support and advice to advance their work.

Computer Skills:

  • Intermediate knowledge working with a safety database for retrieval of safety information; Advanced knowledge of MedDRA; MS Office Suite: Advanced application capability with Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Familiarity with data mining tools and exploratory analyses tools such as Spotfire.

Travel:

  • Less than 10%

Education Required:

  • MD (or internationally recognized equivalent) plus accredited residency

BeOne Global Competencies:

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Collaborative Spirit, Bold Ingenuity and Driving Excellence, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork

  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback

  • Self-Awareness

  • Acts Inclusively

  • Demonstrates Initiative

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset

  • Continuous Learning

  • Embraces Change

  • Results-Oriented

  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis

  • Financial Excellence

  • Communicates with Clarity

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

Salary Range: $298,200.00 - $368,200.00 annually

BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. About Us

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software.

We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. Our work blends clean architecture, practical engineering, and a startup mindset.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

What You'll Do

Backend & Integrations

  • Build and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django/FastAPI), .NET (C#/), Golang, or comparable frameworks, powering dispatch, service orders, billing, and asset workflows.

  • Design relational schemas, migrations, and high-performance queries against SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

  • Ensure API performance, reliability, and security across high-volume operational workloads.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Good proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM-backed automation) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile consulting environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

  • Experience with Azure (App Service, Functions, Service Bus), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

  • FSA/HSA options

  • BYOD reimbursement

jobs.excerpt: The SailPoint customer success serves as the strategic advisor to our customers to get maximum value out of SailPoint products and services.
jobs.description:
The SailPoint customer success serves as the strategic advisor to our customers to get maximum value out of SailPoint products and services. You will be responsible for driving measurable business value through the adoption, expansion, and ongoing value realization of our identity security platform. Operating within an AI-augmented engagement model, you will translate SailPoint’s identity security capabilities—spanning human, machine, and AI agent identities—into quantified business outcomes that secure long-term retention and growth. This role carries commercial accountability for net revenue retention and expansion influence, partnering closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services and Customer Support to deliver coordinated customer value.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage a portfolio of customer accounts with direct accountability for net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion revenue influenced.
  • Design and execute value roadmaps for each customer that articulate measurable business outcomes—risk reduction, compliance coverage, operational efficiency—tied to specific SailPoint platform capabilities.
  • Conduct quarterly executive business reviews that deliver strategic identity security advisory, benchmark customer maturity against industry peers, and present documented ROI.
  • Monitor AI-driven customer health scores, usage analytics, and risk signals, interpreting predictive indicators to make proactive intervention decisions.
  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including cross-sell into non-human identity governance, cloud entitlements, and SailPoint Atlas migration, partnering with Account Executives to progress opportunities.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources (Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product) to resolve complex customer challenges and accelerate time-to-value.
  • Guide customers through the evolving identity security landscape, providing advisory on non-human and AI agent identity governance and emerging regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Capture and communicate voice-of-customer insights to inform SailPoint’s product roadmap and strategy.

Required Skills & Mindsets

  • Identity Security Domain Mastery: Deep understanding of Identity Governance, cloud entitlement management, and non-human identity governance. Ability to discuss identity security architecture with CISOs and IAM Directors.
  • Commercial Acumen & NRR Ownership: Comfort with revenue-adjacent accountability, including expansion identification, pricing conversations.
  • Data Literacy & AI Fluency: Ability to interpret AI-generated health scores and risk signals to make strategic decisions. Comfort operating within AI-augmented CS platforms (e.g., Gainsight).
  • Strategic Advisory & Executive Communication: Skill in conducting executive business reviews that focus on strategic roadmaps and articulate value in the language of risk reduction and operational efficiency.
  • Platform Breadth: Working knowledge across SailPoint’s full platform, including IdentityIQ, Atlas, cloud entitlements, and non-human identity management.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to orchestrate internal resources across Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product without positional authority.
  • Analytical Storytelling: Ability to translate quantitative data (usage metrics, risk scores) into compelling narratives that demonstrate business value and influence renewal/expansion decisions.
  • Resilience & Proactive Risk Sensing: Capacity to monitor subtle signals of customer disengagement and intervene before risk crystallizes.

Month 1 Milestones

  • Product Mastery: Upon completing SailPoint specific trainings, deliver a 15-minute presentation or a mock customer call to your leader covering core value, features, and use cases, focusing on high-level market outcomes and demonstrating curiosity about our products and customers.
  • Tool Proficiency: Demonstrate proficiency in SailPoint’s CRM tool, and articulating the value of Success Plans in delivering customer results.
  • Stakeholder Mapping: After meeting with key stakeholders (cross-functional and within the Customer Success Department), create and present a stakeholder map to demonstrate your understanding of how to maximize partnerships and collaboration workflows, including defining each member's role and responsibilities within accounts.
  • Process Curiosity: Identify one current process or customer approach to challenge, along with "what if" alternatives to provoke further discussion and exploration.
  • Engagement & Soft Skills:
    • Ask thoughtful questions that reflect a genuine interest in understanding not just outcomes, but the underlying drivers.
    • Actively listen, seek clarification, and reflect understanding to ensure others feel heard and accurately represented.
    • Maintain professionalism and composure while onboarding, learning products, processes, and customer contexts.
  • Ownership: Take ownership of your ramp-up by completing required training, applying learnings in early customer interactions independently, and reaching out for help proactively.

Month 2 Milestones

  • Opportunity Identification: Identify adoption and expansion opportunities in 1–2 accounts using data-driven insights and present a mock QBR use case to leadership.
  • Account Prioritization: Demonstrate customer prioritization by categorizing your assigned accounts based on their needs, health score, and product maturity, then devise a tailored cadence of touchpoints based on this prioritization.
  • Portfolio Analysis: Complete a thorough account review for 5 accounts using Gainsight data to demonstrate an understanding of success plans for key accounts, analyzing customer health and churn risk.
  • Adaptability & Growth:
    • Respond constructively to feedback, ambiguity, and change, adjusting your approach without loss of engagement.
    • Actively seek feedback from managers, peers, and available resources to accelerate learning, and apply new skills, tools, or techniques to improve customer engagement, execution, and outcomes.

Month 3 Milestones

  • Sales Alignment: Identify and draft a plan of how to engage with Sales for an example of upsell, cross-sell, and expansion within one key existing account, along with expected close dates and a plan to translate that into a qualified lead.
  • Risk Sensing: Be fully able to identify renewal and forecasting risks across your book of business.
  • Strategic Courage: Demonstrate courage by asking uncomfortable, difficult, or "big" questions to both internal teams and customers to drive progress.

Month 6 Milestones

  • Advocacy Pipelines: Identify 3 customers in your portfolio for advocacy and articulate your data-backed thought process for selection.
  • Value Delivery (QBRs): Conduct at least two (2) Quarterly Business Review (QBR) meetings with the key stakeholders of your key accounts and your manager to uncover deeper insights into usage trends, key wins, challenges, and areas for improvement.
  • Enablement Goals: Ensure 100% of customer accounts in your portfolio are enrolled in SailPoint training subscriptions.
  • Commercial Impact: Identify and present your CSQL progress and pipeline generation in your accounts over the past 6 months.
  • Success Plan Execution: Present an account review to the management team showing implemented success plans for all accounts, ensuring they are on track and delivering documented customer outcomes.
  • Retention Excellence: Present your comprehensive renewals plan to ensure you are on track to meet or exceed a 92% renewal rate with on-time completion.

This role combines full-stack web application engineering with hands-on AI and machine learning development, enabling you to deliver both the user-facing systems that serve federal employees and retirees and the AI-powered capabilities that make those systems smarter and more efficient over time.

Join us to build software that makes an impact and implement human-centered solutions that we can be proud to say we worked on together.

If you’re passionate about improving lives through digital products and services, Coforma is a great company for you.

$150,235 to $169,146 Annual Salary + Benefits + Growth Potential

To honor our company-wide equitable pay system, the posted salary range and corresponding tier salaries are non-negotiable.
This is a US-based remote position open to applicants in the states listed below. Some travel may be required.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

You will be working on building a retirement benefits management system for federal government employees. Key areas this role will be responsible for include:

    • Design and implement secure, scalable APIs using TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, or Java (Spring Framework).

    • Optimize database access and performance using SQL Server and Entity Framework Core.
    • Add observability through structured logging, metrics, and tracing and support incident response with clear runbooks.
  • AI and Machine Learning:
    • Design and implement AI agents and large language model (LLM)-powered applications that automate and enhance retirement data workflows.
    • Build, evaluate, and maintain machine learning models for classification, prediction, and anomaly detection.
    • Integrate LLMs into production systems using prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic frameworks.

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidates bridge two worlds well: they can reason about a React component and a retrieval pipeline in the same conversation. Preferred Qualifications and Experience

AI-Powered Quality Engineering & Intelligent Testing

Enterprise Consulting & Technical Leadership

DevOps, CI/CD & Engineering Excellence

jobs.title: Principal AI Architect
jobs.excerpt: We’re looking for a Principal Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-domain systems spanning cloud, data, and AI.
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Principal Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-domain systems spanning cloud, data, and AI. This role is ideal for a deeply experienced engineer who owns the hardest architectural challenges, sets technical direction, and serves as the senior technical voice on the engagements they support.

In this role, you will operate as the senior technical authority on a cross-functional team, defining architecture across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads. You’ll partner closely with leadership and clients on technical strategy, mentor experienced engineers, and own high-stakes decisions that shape the long-term success of the systems you build.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Define technical strategy and lead architectural design across cloud, data, and AI/ML systems for end-to-end engagements
  • Architect scalable cloud-native solutions, including multi-cloud and hybrid strategies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes)
  • Design data architectures including warehouses, data lakes, and pipelines for batch and streaming workloads (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka)
  • Design AI/ML systems including model serving, MLOps pipelines, feature stores, and LLM-based applications (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face)
  • Define infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and DevOps standards across engagements (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions)
  • Drive performance, scalability, cost, and reliability optimization across deployed systems
  • Ensure architecture meets security, governance, and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Lead cloud migrations and platform modernization initiatives
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with senior leadership and clients as the principal technical voice on strategy and direction
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders alike
  • Engage closely with engineering, data, AI, and product teams to align architecture with broader business priorities
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, standards, and guidelines

Leadership & Influence

  • Define and champion architectural standards and best practices on the engagements you support
  • Mentor experienced engineers and architects, helping them grow their technical judgment and impact
  • Own the most difficult architectural and integration challenges, serving as the senior technical decision-maker
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend tools, frameworks, and patterns that improve architecture over time

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in technical leadership roles
  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms and cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Strong background in microservices, serverless, containers, and event-driven systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, Lambda, EventBridge)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code and CI/CD (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, GitHub Actions)
  • Strong data architecture expertise across relational, NoSQL, and big data systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka)
  • Hands-on experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, dbt)
  • Strong experience designing AI/ML systems for production, including LLMs, MLOps, and model serving (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Solid understanding of networking, security, identity, and access management in cloud environments
  • Experience with governance, compliance, and observability frameworks
  • Strong software engineering skills (Python, APIs, containerization)
  • Track record of senior technical leadership and mentoring experienced engineers
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate technical depth across audiences
  • Demonstrable usage of AI-forward tools such as Claude and Cursor
  • Multi-cloud architecture experience, AI ethics or responsible AI experience, or enterprise architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP) is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Experience designing AI/ML solutions that integrate with SAP EAM data structures (e.g., Equipment Masters, Work Orders, or Notifications) via SAP BTP or cloud-native APIs.

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $ $165,604 - $228,491 USD.  We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. To możliwość realnego wpływu na rozwiązania wykorzystywane na wielu rynkach oraz współpracy z zespołami biznesowymi i technologicznymi przy inicjatywach o strategicznym znaczeniu.

Zakres usług

  • Współtworzenie roadmapy technologicznej dla obszaru Omnichannel oraz koordynacja jej realizacji we współpracy z zespołami zaangażowanymi w poszczególne inicjatywy.

  • Współtworzenie globalnych standardów technologicznych w obszarach Voice, Digital, Unified Desktop oraz VoIP/SIP i dbanie o ich spójne stosowanie w organizacji.
  • Zapewnianie zgodności rozwiązań Contact Center z normami bezpieczeństwa i regulacjami, w tym RODO, PCI-DSS i HIPAA, oraz współpraca przy weryfikacji procedur.
  • Zarządzanie relacjami z dostawcami i operatorami telekomunikacyjnymi, w tym monitorowanie realizacji umów oraz uzgodnionych SLA.
  • Zapewnianie spójności współpracy z Contact Center Solution Designers poprzez uzgadnianie priorytetów, standardów oraz oczekiwanych rezultatów realizowanych inicjatyw.
  • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w koordynowaniu współpracy zespołów IT lub realizacji projektów technologicznych, z umiejętnością dbania o standardy, jakość i terminy.
  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu roadmapą produktową i koordynowaniu rozwoju platform Contact Center.
  • Rozwinięte kompetencje w zakresie koordynowania współpracy z zespołami technologicznymi, uzgadniania zakresów odpowiedzialności oraz dbania o jakość rezultatów.
  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu budżetem, optymalizacji ROI oraz prowadzeniu negocjacji z dostawcami.
  • Umiejętność budowania partnerskich relacji z interesariuszami biznesowymi oraz partnerami technologicznymi.
  • Podstawowa znajomość rozwiązań NLP/GenAI oraz platform takich jak Vertex, AWS, Azure czy HuggingFace, pozwalająca wykorzystywać ich możliwości jako kontekst przy podejmowaniu decyzji technologicznych.

W ramach współpracy oferujemy

  • Udział w projektach kluczowych dla transformacji procesów Customer Care w Europie oraz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju architektury Omnichannel.
  • Wysoki poziom autonomii i partnerskiej odpowiedzialności za powierzony obszar.
  • Współpracę przy strategicznych projektach realizowanych w skali międzynarodowej.
  • Środowisko wykorzystujące nowoczesne rozwiązania technologiczne, chmurę i automatyzację.
  • Długoterminową współpracę w modelu B2B

Jak pewnie wiesz, w InPost bardzo dużo się dzieje! Głównym corem naszej działalności są urządzenia Paczkomat, które od lat produkujemy i projektujemy we własnym zakresie. Dodatkowo, stale rozwijamy nasze portfolio usług i wprowadzamy nowe rozwiązania, takie jak InPost Fresh, Fulfillment czy InPost Pay, ułatwiające życie milionom naszych klientów.

Praca w naszej firmie to praca wśród najlepszych liderów w międzynarodowym środowisku. Jako InPost Group działamy pod dwoma markami InPost i Mondial Relay, na rynku w Europie, w tym w Polsce, Francji, Wielkiej Brytanii, Hiszpanii, Portugalii, Włoszech i w krajach Beneluxu. Jesteśmy innowacyjni, konkretni, proaktywni, a przede wszystkim, zorientowani na efekt biznesowy naszych działań.
